tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pa'i rtags kyi yi ge gos rdeb dmod mo brjod pa'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/'khor bya rog mi 'khor nyams grib che zhes yod (e)(nyi)pa'i ga
pa'i rtags kyi yi ge gos rdeb dmod mo brjod pa'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/'khor bya rog mi 'khor nyams grib che zhes yod (e)(nyi)pa'i ga

tei:div.tei:p: pa'i rtags kyi yi ge gos rdeb dmod mo brjod pa'i mtha' can/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'khor bya rog mi 'khor nyams grib che zhes yod (e)(nyi)pa'i gtor len bya rog brtag pa tshig rkang drug ma sgrub pa bskyar gyi mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ sgrub pa po dag gi zhal bzhi pa'i 'khu ldog dang zhes yod pa'i 'khu (sgo)(glo)ldog dang cho 'phrul mi 'byung zhing las myur du sgrub pa'i yi ge bsams pa ni man ngag dam par gsungs so 'di spel ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam mo'i mtha' can/ 'gor rtsa ba'i 'khor lo ni rtsibs drug ces yod pa'i rtsa ba (e)(sgo)dang gnad 'bebs dang las tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams sdig pa'i sa bon byed pas gsang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'di rdzong pod na'ang yod ngor lugs la 'di kha'i nang gi rab gnas de zur du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa yin/ 'gor thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa 'di yin te zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo dang ling tshe dang ling ga'i (sgo)(glo)zhal shes rnam smin che bas gzhan la ma spel gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'di rdzong pod na'ang bzhugs shing 'khor lo dang ling ga'i zhal gdams chos tshan logs su mdzad 'dug 'gor man ngag 'di'i 'khor lo bri bar 'dod na zhes yod pa'i 'khor lo'i bri thabs 'di gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du nyis ldab 'dug (sgo)(nyi)gang bsgo ba de nges par 'grub gsung ba'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor sa i yaṃ yod pa'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang (sgo)tsakra la bri gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'khor lo'i skabs su rtsibs drug dang zhes yod (sgo)pa'i 'khor lo'i sngags bkod tshul sngags ring rdzogs par bri gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ bsnyen sgrub/ sri'u/ shwa bzlog gtad ling*/ gtor ling*/ rta phyugs gsod pa sogs las tshogs 'ga' zung gi 'khor lo'i man ngag de rjes ling ga la'o'i mtha' can/ 'di rdzong pod na'ang bzhugs shing yang gsang thugs kyi nying khu zer/

las sbyor skabs su 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma hā kā la'i gsang sngags (e)(sgo)(nyi)thung ba zhes yod pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor gsang sngags ring ba ni zhes yod (e)(sgo)(nyi)pa tsa turmu kha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa bka' rgyas gdab bo'i mtha' can/ 'gor kha sbyor dbye ba'i man ngag ni rang yi dam lha zhes yod pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba bzhi'i man ngag (e)(sgo)(glo)zab mo dam du sba'o 'di ni rab tu gsang ba'i gnas so'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor las sbyor gyi tshe ling ga zhes yod pa'i las sbyor gyi yig chung (glo)ling tshe bco lnga pa sngags can bcug par bya'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod 'gor mngon spyod bsad las sgrub na 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i mngon spyod bsad las kyi yig chung gsang sngags rnam pa gcig pas zab bo'i mtha' can/ 'gor nag po chen po'i sgong zor zhes yod pa'i sgong zor gyi yi ge bsdus (e)(sgo)(glo)pa las kyi mthar thug bla ma gnyan gyi man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na mchan dkyus la shor 'dug sgong zor gyi yi ge rgyas pa ldong ston thig le 'bar nas brgyud pa'i man ngag dmod mo bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'phang ba khyu mchog ces yod pa'i rwa zor gyi yi ge 'bring po yin bla ma (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)gnyan gyi u pa da sha 'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor tā ra la na mo/ las sbyor gyi mthar sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na thab khru gang brus (nyi)pa'am zhes yod pa'i las mtha'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge rgyas pa gong mas mdzad pa drag po'i las mthar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor las mtha'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas 'brub khung khru gang ba brtsigs pa'i phyi zhes yod pa'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge bsdus (e)(sgo)(glo)pa sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga i thi'i mtha' can/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor ho dpal nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma zhes yod pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba'i dmod bskul (e)(sgo)dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i dmod bskul i thi'i mtha' can/ spogs chog gi skabs su 'gor ma hā kā la la na mo/ dang por chos thams cad stong par bsgom zhes yod pa'i ma 'chun na rang nyid zhal bzhi par bskyed pa'i man ngag ak+ṣo bh+yas dbu brgyan no'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor bdag nyid ye shes kyi mgon po gdong bzhi pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgom zhes yod pa'i rtsa dbu ma chos 'byung dang bcas (e)(nyi)pa'i gnad dbab rtsub pas tshod blang gin bya'o gar thod thod du mi bya gdams ngag yin no'i mtha' can/ gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du mgon po mdun dang rtsa nang du bsgom pa man ngag tshan pa gnyis su bris 'dug 'gor las mi byed na shi sa bstan pa ni zhes yod pa'i shi sa bstan pa'i man (e)(sgo)(glo)ngag 'di shin tu rdugs na bya zhing gar thod thod du mi rung ngo'i mtha' can rnams so/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ gsum pa phran bu'i skor la/ 'gor dpal gdong bzhi pa la phyag 'tshal lo// chos skyong la gtsug lag khang zhes yod pa'i mgon po la gtsug (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)lag khang gtod pa'i cho rdzong pod na'ang yod/ ga gtor ma lnga la sogs pa rgyas par bya'o'i mtha' can/ ngor lugs dang gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du 'di gnyis chos tshan gcig tu sbrel 'dug de'i gsal byed 'gor gtsug lag (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)khang gi rten mchod dang zhes yod pa'i lcags par ma la'ang 'di bzhin bya ba yin no// gtsug lag khang gtad pa'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po la rang dang slob ma zhes yod pa'i rang dang slob (e)(sgo)(glo)ma gtod pa'i yi ge thugs dam ma g.yel cig ces gsol ba gdab bo'i mtha' can/

'gor nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas dang mal cha dang zhes yod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)bsrung ba'i yi ge mchod gtor la brtson par bya'o gnas mal dang nor rdzas bsrung ba'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor nor la ngan gyi gdams pa ni zhes yod pa'i nor (sgo)gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i man ngag mis mi mthong bar sbas na 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ 'gor sri'u gso na kham phor so ma gtang ba zhes yod pa'i sri'u gso ba'i 'khor lo'i man ngag (e)(sgo)(nyi)ma hā kā la'i las kyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las kha tshar zhig bstan te zhes yod pa'i sri'u gso ba bram ze kha spu can gyi gdams pa thugs dam dpang du bzhag ste dam bcas pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na maḥ nag po chen po yid bzhin nor bu zhes yod pa'i nor sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)kun la kha lo sgyur ba'ang gnyan lo tsā ba'i gdams pa'i man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i las zhes yod pa'i dbang sdud gri lag (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)g.yob pa dar thogs kyi man ngag rjes la sngags thung nyer gcig bzlas so shin tu gsang ba gal che'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor nag po chen pos bsgrub bya zhes yod pa'i rdzas rnams skad shan sbyar ba'i sgrub bya dbang (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)du bya ba nges par 'ong ngo bla ma gnyan gyi man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'dod yon lnga la brten nas spyod lam (e)(sgo)(glo)dbang du bya ba'i cho ga rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ seng phur la brten pa'i gtum po'i shwa (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)bzlog de 'dra gcig nas lnga'i bar gyis bzlog gi mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha ye zhing skyong 'di'i sgo nas zhes yod pa'i dgra (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)la ltas ngan gtong ba'i man ngag chig brgyud ma bka' rgya'o'i mtha' can/

bya 'ug rta nag gi rdzas dang phag thod la brten nas cho 'phrul (sgo)dbab pa'i man ngag rdzong pod na'ang yod/ a mu ka'i thems 'og tu gzhug go bla ma gnyan gyi gdams ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po'i las gang gi zhes yod pa'i dgra bo cham la 'bebs pa'i rdzas sbyor gyi man ngag gzhan las khyad 'phags i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ grong khyer bskyod pa'i sngags la zhes yod pa'i bskrad pa'i las mthar (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)thug yin gyi mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ de'i zhal shes (e)(sgo)(glo)dmigs pa'i 'khor lo dri mar bcas sogs tshig rkang drug pa chos tshan 'di gnyis dkar chag na gcig tu bsdoms/ ngor pa'i der bar 'dir bskrad 'khor 'dri tshul zhig 'dug dang rdzong pod na'ang yod/ zhal shes ni sha (e)(sgo)(glo)shun la zhes sogs 'khor du mi gzhug pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor ngag gnon par 'dod na zhes yod pa'i ngag mnan (e)(sgo)(nyi)pa'i las mthar thug gnyan gyi gdams ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ ma hā kā la la brten nas 'dre btsan thabs su mnan (e)(sgo)(glo)pa bzlas pa mi dgos btsan thabs su gnon pa'i man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ ngor lugs la sgab 'dre gnon thabs zhes snang ba nor bar 'dug go /de'i gsal byed (nyi)'gor tsa turmu kha la na mo/ de'i bka' sdod ma hā bā la zhes yod pa sngags bzla zhing sa bcag go'i mtha' can rnams so/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal bas gong gi 'phros su gtogs sam snyam/ lnga pa 'phral du nye bar mkho ba gtor chog dang bskang ba bstod bskul gyi skor la/ gtor chog bskang ba/ bstod bskul dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po mchod pa ni lcags kyi snod du zhes yod pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga gnyan gyis nye gnas dar ma seṅge la byin pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ de'i kha skong 'gor 'di sgrub gang zag des zhes yod pa'i mchod tshul (nyi)dang bstod pa mi rtog dbyings las ma dang bcas pa gtor ma dgra phyogs su gtong ngo dge slong gnyan gyi gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ yi dam gang byed du bsams la mdun du rdo'i maṇ+ḍal zhes yod pa'i mngon rtogs dang sngags ring bstan pa dharma pā la u pa de sha i thi'i mtha' can/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal rdzong pod na gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs zer/ 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa yab yum gyi zhes yod pa'i gtor chog bla ma kha'u pas mdzad pa mgon po zhal gzigs nas bstod pa'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di bsgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gtor chog (nyi)sa chen gyis mdzad pa dngos grub ci 'dod kyi phrin las bcol gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas dpal sa skyar bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ stobs 'phrog nag po mnyes par byed pa'i mngon rtogs sam gtor chog bla ma'i gsung bzhin dmar chos kyi rgyal pos bsdebs pa/ 'gor bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gtor chen byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i drag (nyi)po'i gtor chen gyi man ngag yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa su la yang mi sbyin no zhes brgyud pa rnams gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'di'i gsham na seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon par zhus dag bgyis zer ba las mdzad byang mi 'dug de'i phyag len gtor bzlog lhan thabs bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gi bkas bskul ba la brten nas rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos kha'u brag rdzong du mdzad pa rnams so// gnyis pa bskang ba la/

dam rdzas kyis bskang ba khyed mthun ma (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)spyan 'dren lha mchog ma dang bcas pa gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du tshig zur mi 'dra ba cung zad snang zhing lha mchog ma hā kā la man gyi spyan 'dren rnams lhag por 'dug go/ gnyan los mdzad pa/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan bca' thabs (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)dang 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad stobs chen shugs drag ma/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i gtor (e)(glo)(nyi)bskang dur khrod gnas brgyad ma/ stobs 'phrog nag po'i gsang (sgo)(glo)(nyi)mdos mgon po nyid kyis bla ma kha'u pa la dngos su gnang ba rnams so/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ gsum pa bstod bskul la/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa srin gzugs ma/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa srin po'i gzugs can ma/ bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa (sgo)(nyi)dpal ldan mgon po sh+lau ka nyi shu pa gnyan lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i bstod pa (sgo)mi rtog dbyings las ma/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bstod pa paṃ (e)(sgo)(nyi)pad raṃ nyi ma/ deng sang 'di dang yum gyi bstod pa g.yas phyogs ma gnyis so sor bris pa mang yang 'di kha'i mur 'thud nas mdzad byang bris 'dug go/ kha'u pas mgon po zhal dngos su gzigs (e)(sgo)(nyi)dus bstod pa rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ mal lo tsā bas rmi lam du mgon po zhal gzigs dus bstod pa zhi rgyas dbang drag ma/ sa chen gyis bstod pa (sgo)(nyi)'jigs byed dpa' bo ma/ sa paṇa gyis sa skyar mdzad pa'i bstod pa (sgo)(nyi)dpal ldan dbang ldan ma/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'phags pa rin po ches shing kun tu mdzad pa'i bstod pa (sgo)(nyi)sangs rgyas gcig bsdus ma/ 'di'i rjes su dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa zhig yod 'dug pa ma thob/

chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa (nyi)stong nyid snying rje ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa srid gsum (sgo)(nyi)dbang sgyur ma/ gtor chog bstod bskul dang bcas pa zhes mdzad byang na 'dug 'jam dbyangs grags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa bde chen dur khrod ma/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos bstod pa dpal ldan ma hā kā la ma/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston gyis chu bzang dben gnas su mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba kun gyi ma/ bkra shis don grub kyis bstod pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas ma/ dharma shrī bha dras sron lung bsam gtan rdzong du sbyar ba'i bstod pa khyod thugs zhi ba ma/ mkhan chen gnas drug pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa mthu chen (glo)(nyi)sdang dgra ma/ bh+ya wa na yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi don bstod dus mtshan chen po ma/ sngags 'chang gzungs pas sa skyar mdzad pa'i bstod pa sku (sgo)(nyi)gsum mngon gyur ma/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i thun (sgo)gsum bsten cing ma/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan par chos skyong gis rmi lam du bskul nas kha'u skyed lhas su mdzad pa'i bstod pa ha ha dgod pa ma/ shrī mān bha dras rtsa sngags dang mthun par rin chen sgang mgon khang du bstod pa chos dbyings mthing nag ma/ bzang po'i mtha' can gyis rin chen sgang bla brang du bstod pa'i lha chen thugs kyi ma/ zhal bzhi pas bskul nas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zur shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rab 'jigs dur khrod ma/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi drag (nyi)bskul nag po chen po ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod bskul (sgo)(glo)mngon spyod rol pa lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod bskul (sgo)las kyi rgyal po tshigs bcad dpal ldan mgon po ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i bskul (nyi)legs ldan nag po ma/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal ba gong gi bstod bskul gyi sdebs su 'gro rgyu yin nam brtag des mdzad pa'i dmod bskul las kyi rgyal po zhes pa tshig lhug dpal ldan nag po ma/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i dmod bskul lo ston thig le la gnang ba tshig lhug dpal ldan mā hā kā la ma rnams so// de'ang dkar chag tu/ snyan brgyud khrag mtsho'i ljongs nas 'ong*// mngon spyod sbrul gdug kha rlangs can// srog gi mthar byed 'di mthong tshe// bstan dang bstan 'dzin la 'khu ba'i// mi dang mi min gang ci'ang rung*// bag yod dus la bab min nam// zhes gsungs par dpags na phyi sgrub yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas snod ma brtags par bab col du 'chad pa'ang mi rung bar mngon no// gnyis pa nang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa gsang ba'i man ngag la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge tshigs bcad ma (glo)bla ma'i man ngag bzhin gab dkrugs med par dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ yig rnying 'di lta bu yod pa mig dang rna ba'i yul du ma gyur par rtag brtan sprul sku kun dga' snying pos tshar chen gyi gur mgon gyi khrid las dpe blangs pa'i rang bzo yin zhes ngan smras kyi than skad phyogs brgyar sgrog pa ni rang gi nang cha gsal bar ston pa'o zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos gsungs so// gsang sgrub kyi khrid gzhung ngam man ngag thun mong ma yin pa snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa ka zha dka' bcu dang rong po dka' bcu sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba la brten nas mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/

gsang ba'i khrid yig zung 'jug rnam par rol pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa chen po zhes bya ba mdo khams lho phyogs pa dbon chen chos rgyal mtshan dang bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bskul nas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ des kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ru 'dren gyi pho brang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bsam gtan khang bur mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa rgyal ba kun dngos ma rnams 'di skor ni gtso bor mchog gi dngos grub zung 'jug gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i gsang lam zab mo yin pas/ dkar chag tu/ lhan skyes rdo rje lus kyi zhing skyong che// bde chen 'od stong 'bar ba'i 'dzum zhal la// rnal 'byor yid kyi dga' ma ji bzhin du// 'bral med rtse dgas rol 'di ngo mtshar rmad// e ma tshe 'di'i chos brgyad kun dor nas// gcig pur dben pa'i nags kyi sman ljongs su// rgyal ba'i thugs bcud rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i ro// myang pa'i spyod tshul de la snying nas spro// zhes pa rdo rje'i gsung bla na med pa yin la/ zhar byung du las bzhi ka dang khyad par mngon spyod kyi las spros pa la ma bltos par 'bad med du 'grub pas/ e dbyings sde brgyad dbus su bsgrub bya'i gzugs// lus la zhing skyong bkod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// rtsa 'bral khams gsol rnam shes 'phrog pa yi// zhes dgra bo rnams ring por mi thogs par mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyel ba'i zab gnad kyang shin tu che'o// gsum pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gyi man ngag la/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas bla ma gnyan la gdams pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i shog dril nyer gcig de las zab pa'i yig chung dang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang dang zhes yod pa'i srung bzlog bsad mnan tshe sgrub dang bcas (ldong)pa'i shog dril gtor mdos man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha'

1 can/ 'gor dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang zhes yod pa'i rten gsum/ gnad 'bebs/ bsnyen pa/ las sbyor/ rtags/ sreg mnan (e)(sgo)rnams ston pa sbas te 'dzam gling du ma grags pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i shog dril 2 / 'gor chos skyong zhi bar zhes yod pa'i bsnyen dus kyi mgon po la brten pa'i chos skyong zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'i shog dril sgrub lugs yin no rdzogs so'i mtha' 3 can/ 'gor bud+dhā ya shrī ba shaṃ ku ru zhes yod pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nang tsit+ta la brten nas zhal dngos su blta ba'i shog dril rdzogs so'i mtha' can 4 / 'gor dpal mgon po gdong bzhi pa bsgrub pa la zhes yod pa'i phyi'i sgab 'dre bdud mo shān+tiṃ ro zan ma gnon pa 'brug mgo can gyi shog dril 5 / 'gor byad ma'i ngag mnan pa ni zhes yod pa'i nang gi mal 'og bsrung ba byad ma'i ngag gnon pa'i shog dril 6 / 'gor man ngag 'di'i zhal gdams ni zhes yod pa'i gsang ba rang srog rten gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor shog dril zhar byung du dam tshig 'khu ldog 'ching ba/ gnyen po/ rig sngags go ldog rnams kyang zur tsam bstan pa tsakra'i gdams pa i thi'i mtha' can 7 / 'khor bsrung zhing mi 'khu mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i shog dril i thi'i mtha' 8 can/ 'gor yum chen khros ma'i zhal gdams la/ dang po rdzas bsag pa ni zhes yod pa'i yum chen khros ma'i shog dril (e)(sgo)dam tshig med pa la gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 9 rdzong pod na'ang yod/ bum pa la brten nas nag po chen po'i 'chi med (glo)tshe sgrub kyi shog dril bla ma ben+da pas lung bstan thob nas bsgrubs pas lo phyed dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa'i che ba can 10 / rdzas sngags 'khor lo gsum la brten pa'i nag po chen po'i dgos 'dod nor bu sgrub pa'i shog dril sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can 11 / rdzas sngags srog 'khor gsum la brten pa'i sku dngos su blta ba'i shog dril i thi'i mtha' rten snying gi rgya can

12 / rdzas sngags lha sgom pa gsum la brten pa'i (glo)nag po chen po'i cho 'phrul ltas ngan dbab pa'i shog dril gtang ba i thi'i mtha' can 13 / rdzas sngags 'khor lo gsum la brten nas nag po chen pos dgra srog myur du gcod pa'i srog rtsa rnon po'i shog dril gzhan la spel na bka' chad 'byung sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can 14 / rdzas sngags bca' gzhi gsum la brten nas nag po chen pos dgra mkhar rmang nas sgyel (rdo rje)ba nag po mkhar sgyel gyi shog dril mkhar bshig pa'i spu gri nag po zhes bya ba sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can 15 / rdzas dang sngags kyi bzla thabs la brten nas ser ba dbab pa gdong bzhi pa'i spu gri ngar ma'i shog dril bcol bskul gzhung dang mthun no'i mtha' can 16 / 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po 'jigs par byed pa yi zhes yod pa'i rdzas sngags gnyis la brten nas zhing sel 'jug pa spu gri so 'debs so'i mtha' can gyi shog dril 17 / 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos skyong gi bsnyen pa byas pas cung zhig rtsub nas zhes yod pa'i tsa turmu kha gcun thabs nyi zla can gyi shog dril gnad la dbab pa'i gdams pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can 18 / 'gor lha mo nag mo'i zhal gdams zhes yod pa'i gnad la (ldong)(sgo)(glo)dbab pa lha mo nag mo'i shog dril ting 'dzin zhal shes legs par thugs la chongs kyi mtha' can 19 / 'di la dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i man ngag ces pa gong gi gsal byed 'dra ba gcig na mo gu ru gnyis pa bgyis so zhes dang*/ a ma ra zhes pa yod pa gcig dang bcas pa'i nang gses chos tshan bzhir dbye ba 'dra zhig 'dug kyang dkar chag tu bsdoms par snang ngo*// rdzong pod na'ang bzhugs/ 'gor dpal mgon nag po chen po ma 'chun na zhes yod pa'i ma 'chun 'khu ldog byed na mnan pa'i shog dril sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can 20 / 'gor dpal nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa dgra bo la 'gro ma nyan cing zhes yod pa'i las byed (glo)du mi 'dod na ar gtad kyi shog dril shin tu sbas pa'o'i mtha' can rnams dus gcig la mang por mi spel ba'i chig brgyud

21 gras/ shog dril dang po'i gsal byed 'gor bla ma dang dpal ldan mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun ku sa li zhes yod pa rje btsun (dbang)rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa bzlog pa sogs gzhan du shes so'i mtha' can/ shog dril dang po'i rgyun gyi nyams len ngag 'don gsal bar bkod pa rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rjes mdzad pa rnams so// gnyis pa de las zab pa'i yig chung la/ tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub (ldong)(rdo rje)thabs zhar byung rjes gnang gi yig chung dang bcas pa snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa bka' rgya i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor gnyis pa rnal 'byor pa nor spel (ldong)(rdo rje)na zhes yod pa'i ser po rgyas pa'i yi ge 'gor gsum pa dgra bgegs sgrol na zhes yod pa'i nag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i yi ge zhal du (ldong)(rdo rje)gsol bar bsam mo'i mtha' can/ 'gor bzhi pa dmigs bya dbang du bsdu (ldong)(rdo rje)na zhes yod pa'i dmar po dbang sdud kyi yi ge 'gor tā ra la na mo/ mgon po dkar ser dmar nag ces yod pa'i las (ldong)(rdo rje)bzhi mgon po'i mngon rtogs kyi gsal byed u pa de sha gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ mgon po ser po'i byin rlabs kyi yig (ldong)(rdo rje)chung tsit+ta'i dkyil du sbas so sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ las bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs tā ming rgyal po chen po'i bkas bskul ba ltar theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos pho brang twa'i tu'i hwo'i sde chen por sbyar ba/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa dkar po'i tshe sgrub zla ba'i chu rgyun (ldong)rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku sa li chen mos gnyan lo bod du 'byon khar 'gro chos su gnang ba'i bram (rdo rje)ze dmod pa'i srog mthu 'di phyi bram ze ltar sgrub pa'i man ngag yin nam snyam/

dgra bo'i srog gi bshan pa dmar po snying khrag thang la 'pho zhig sa ma ya na ra skan gyi mtha' can/ ngan sngags dgra srog gi spu gri dmar po yang zer/ lam bar gyi chom rkun brtag pa'i phyir du gdong bzhi pa'i bka' sdod drang srong nag po'i pra se na dbab pa'i man ngag mkhar nag dge bshes nas brgyud pa shin tu gsang ba gal che'o'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal shes snying gi dkyil du chongs kyi mtha' can/ bla ma gnyan bod du byon khar mgon pos lung bstan pa la brten nas zhus pa'i tsa turmu kha'i cho 'phrul (rdo rje)than 'gyed gnyan gyi mgul khug mar grags pa chig brgyud snying gi dum bu bka' rgya dang bcas pa i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor ḍā ki ma bzhi zhes yod pa'i yum chen bzhi'i than (rdo rje)'gyed gnyan gyi mgul khug bka' rgya ma sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ rnal 'byor pa mtshan ma thob nas zhes yod pa'i gnyan (rdo rje࿊)mgon gyi par bu'i cho ga'i man ngag zhal gdams bka' rgya ma i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ mgon po'i nor sgrub ni zhes yod pa'i gnyan mgon lha dgu'i sgrub (rdo rje)thabs thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud kun la ma grags pa'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu shin tu gsang rgya'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ rdzas kyi sbyor ba zhes yod pa'i rdzas kyi sgo nas dgra gsod pa'i las sbyor bla ma'i zhal las shes so sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ gtad bya ba ni zhes yod pa'i rdo nag (rdo rje)yig dmar gyi sgrub mthu gser zho re'i bka' rgya yod sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor khang sel zhing sel la zhes yod pa'i khang sel nag po zla phyed tshun la 'jig pa swā hā sngags so i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag la dgra glo bur zhes yod pa'i dgra bo zla ba gcig la gsod pa (glo)mdze pho nag po'i man ngag 'di ka la gsod i thi'i mtha' can/

dgra bo klu la gtod pa reg pas chog pa drag po'i btsan dug gtad khram gyi yang snying gnyan gyi nā ga stobs 'phrog tu grags pa/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ mon pa zhes yod pa'i mon pa nag po nor bsher gyi 'di brtsegs zhal gyi las tshogs/ man ngag rgya gar nas bod du byon pa la 'di las zab pa med do rtags thon thon pa yid ches par gyis shig gi mtha' can/ dar lung gi brag spre'u dmar 'dzing 'dra ba'i rmang du bla ma gnyan gyis sbas pa kha'u pas bton pa'i zangs khab dmar po'i bsad las khar lce myug ge bya'o'i mtha' can/ gdong brnyan can la brten pa/ 'gor dpal rje btsun stobs 'phrog nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba zhes yod pa'i sreg byed me'i sbyor ba bla ma kha'u pa chen po'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod pa la/ nag po chen pos bzod par mdzod cig sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bstan pa ni zhes yod pa'i gcun pa'i mthar thug sdig pa nag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gtso 'khor gsum bsgom mo'i mtha' can rnams so// gzhan yang gdong bzhi pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba rgyud rin chen spungs rgyan gyi gdams pa mngal bsrung ba'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ bu 'tshol ba'i man ngag (ldong)(nyi)ltas kyi le'u 'o'i mtha' can/ mngal bsrung ba'i gdams (ldong)(nyi)pa dbang phyug dang pad+ma la brten pa gnyan gyi u pa de sha'i mtha' can/ ma hā kā la'i sku gzugs (nyi࿊)la brten nas sri'u gso ba/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ zhal bzhi pa'i sgo nas srid med pa srid dang phrad pa 'di la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i srid med pa 'tshol ba lung skam chu 'bebs/ klung log bu mor 'ong bas srid pa lte ba bsgyur ba/ yod pa gso ba'i gdams pa rnams kyi yi ge bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa bka' rgya ma/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ nag po chen po'i sgo nas chung sri zhes yod pa'i chung sri 'dul (nyi࿊)ba gnyan lo'i man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/

dkar chag na 'di gong ma'i khongs su bsdus pa las zur du med/ zhal gdams snying gi dum bur grags pa'i nang tshan la 'gor tā ra na mo/ tsa turmu kha'i zhal gdams snying gi dum bu zhes yod pa'i spu gri so 'debs kyi gdams (ldong)pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i zab chos gzhan la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya dam po yod do'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ tsa turmu kha'i rang srung gnad kyi 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i rang srung phra mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhal gdams gcig las mang ba la mi spel gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo/ bla ma'i zhal nas spyir 'di la zhes yod pa'i rten gyi zhal gdams phyi nang gnyis ka la rtsub gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor na maḥ gtor ma bzhi zhes yod pa'i gtor ma'i zhal gdams mtha' yas pa bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dang ma hā kā la la na moḥ snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma gcig ces yod pa'i sngags kyi zhal gdams sngags sgrigs sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor shrī ma hā kā la pu dze ta zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi zhal gdams rnam 'gyur 'di tshe bag thung ba yin no'i mtha' can/

dkar chag na 'di gong gi khongs su bsdus pa las zur na mi gsal/ dgra bgegs bsad pa/ gzhan srung ba/ rang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i zhal gdams rdo rje 'dzin pa shrī wān ma tis bsam gling dgon par bris pa/ de'i zhar byung 'gor bla ma'i zhal nas bod rbad bsad gsum zhes yod pa'i rang srung gi yi ge man ngag dngos su bkod pa'o'i mtha' can rnams so/ 'di dkar chag na mi gsal ba gong ma'i khongs su bsdus sam snyam/ de yang dkar chag tu/ sngon chad gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma grags pa// sngon gyi mkhas grub gnyan lo'i thugs bcud 'di// bdag gi 'dren mchog kun spangs chos rje las// gzhan na yod med gzu bo'i blos ltos shig /'di lta'i man ngag snying khrag zhun ma 'di// spel ba'i gnas med bse brag dmar por sbos// cis kyang spel na snod ldan gcig nyid la// bka' rgyas thob la mgon po dpang du tshugs// zhes 'byung ba ltar sa bcad gsum pa'i skor 'di kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams las kun la ma grags pa'i zab cing gnyan pas snod dang ldan nges la chos skyong dpang du btsugs nas ston dgos pa'i tshul 'di snying gi dpal be'ur bcang bar bya'o// zhar byung dpe ris kyi skor la/ gtum po rang srung gi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ chung ba gri gug ma/ 'og gi 'khor bsrung ba'i dpe ris kyang dbyibs 'di kha la 'dri tshul gyi khyad par cung zad yod/ rang srung phra mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dpe ris rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ 'di gsum gyi dbye ba zhal las shes dgos/ dkar chag na/ rang srung 'khor lo che chung gsum gsungs pa'i chung ba shog dril nyer gcig gi 'khu ldog bsrung ba'i rang srung 'khor lo gri thod ma'am sku gsung thugs 'khor du grags pa/ zhal bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang srung yang zer/ gtum po'i sgo nas mi ma yin drag po srung ba'i 'khor lo/

'khor srung ba'i gri gug can/ shog dril nyer gcig gi gsang ba rang srog rten gyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug kha sbyor lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa/ yi ge rnying pa las byung ba'i bsad pa'i 'khor lo ling tshe nyi shu pa dang*/ bco lnga pa/ dmar gyi bzhed pa gcig ling tshe rkyang pa bco lnga pa dang*/ nyi shu pa/ ling ga 'khor lo can/ ling ga ling tshe can 'khor lo yod med gnyis/ chos rje sa paṇa la mgon po nyid kyis gdams pa'i ling tshe nyi shu pa dang bco lnga pa/ de'i bzhed pa'i rang srung 'khor lo ling tshe nyi shu pa dang bco lnga pa/ de'i bzhed pa'i ling ga 'khor lo can gnyis/ de'i bzhed pa'i ling tshe rkyang pa gnyis/ de'i bzhed pa'i ling ga ling tshe can gnyis/ gzhan yang gong dang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i ling tshe nyi shu pa gtor ma la 'dzugs rgyu'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ ling ga sngags bkod lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis dang sngags med gcig rdo nag maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor dang bcas pa'i shom/ phyag mtshan/ las khung*/ rdo zor/ rwa zor/ mda' zor/ thun khung*/ rlon thun/ sbyin sreg gi thab khung mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rdza'i an dha mu sha la cha'i an dha mu sha 'bru nag gi sdig pa/ sgab 'dre 'brug mgo can gyi mnan 'khor mal 'og bsrung ba'i ngag mnan 'khor lo/ ma hā ba la/ de'i rgyab yig ling ga rgya gram/ glang dmar gyi rwa/ tshe sgrub kyi bca' gzhi'i mchod rten/ nor sgrub kyi bum pa/ dbang sdud gri lag lam srung gi rde'u dang rdo rje rgya gram rtse mor phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ shwa bzlog phur thod/ bya rog bskrad 'khor gyi 'khor lo ling ga dang*/ bya rog gi gzugs/ ma chun spre'u'i 'khor lo/ lha mo nag mo'i dpe/ mngal srung pad+ma'i pho 'khor mo 'khor dbang phyug gi gzugs/ nā ga stobs 'phrog gi ling ga sāts+tsha/ bum pa/ rgya gram/ yang ling ga 'khor lo can lugs gcig klu sgrub rgya gzhung gi sham bu brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor ling ga

thun snod dang bcas pa/ nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda' 'phang*/ pho gdong mo gdong*/ ri rab gling bzhi/ gdugs sogs mdos kyi cha lag rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dpe ris rnying pa na med pa'i mgon po che chung gi dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma/ dpal gyi zhal zas/ dzam+bu+u ti ba/ bshos bu dmar nag gur gyi bsnyen sgrub rjes gnang gi gtor dpe/ dud sol ma'i gtor ma/ zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gso dang rtag gtor/ pu tra'i gtor ma/ beg tse'i gtor ma/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ dmar chen gtor ma/ mgon po che chung gi gtor ma'i dar gur/ zangs gri can gyi zor gtor/ zhal gyi gtor chen gyi dpe rnams rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi zhal bkod ma rnams so// gnyis pa dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i skor la/ phyi sgrub dang khyad par gyi man ngag la mkho ba'i skor/ gsang sgrub kyi skor/ phyi sgrub kyi snying por gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i snying thig ha la nag po'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'gor gdong brnyan can la gtor ma 'bul na/ paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzas pa bsgyel zhes yod pa'i glang ('bum)gdong phyag drug pa'i gtor 'bul e ka dza ṭī hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'o i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// zhes sogs kyi mchod brjod sh+lau ka gnyis mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dri med don gsal ji lta ba la de nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung la dpang po byas zhes yod pa'i gdong ('bum)brnyan gyi bsnyen pa'i yi ge 'phags pa klu sgrub snying po'i rgya gzhung ltar bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o'i mtha' can/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos bskul nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i zhing skyong stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa las sbyor gyi mgon po gdong brnyan can 'khor mang dang bcas pa la bstod cing (dbang)'phrin las gsol ba bdud dgra'i srog 'phrog dam nyams kyi tsit+ta dmar 'byin/

'gor bla ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya kun la blo gros rab rgyas shing*// zhes yod pa'i gdong bzhi pa'i lo rgyus dkar chag bskyed chog mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba dang bcas ston pa'i yi ge bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa mngon sum nyid du grub pa'i las mdzod cig gi mtha' can/ 'di'i 'go'i mchod brjod la bdag chen rje'i mtshan spel yod pa de rdo ring rin po che'i gsung yin pa 'dra zhes yig char snang ngo*// 'gor rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhes yod pa'i brgyud 'debs (glang)kyi lo rgyus zung ldan gyi rgyan dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa blo gsal rgya mtshos kha'u brag rdzong nag por mdzad pa/ des mdo khams pa dbon po dpal grub dang bsod nams mchog grub gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar na lan+dar (ldong)mdzad pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang dngos grub rgya mtsho/ bskul ba po dang mdzad po gong ltar gyi dpal stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa sgrub (ta)dus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang chig brgyud gser chos kyi yig chung*/ sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal khra can gyi rjes gnang gi khog phub bsnyen dus sgrub dus thun mong ma yin la/ dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ma yin pa/ dmar po dbang sdud/ ser po rgyas byed lha dgu/ sngon po bgegs 'joms dang bcas pa rnams kyi tho yig (ngag)mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ des rtse gdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar mdzad pa'i dpal mgon gdong brnyan ('bum)(ngag)can gyi rjes gnang go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ 'di chig brgyud ma gtogs ye mi byed do zhes yod pa'i gnad dbab (ā)kyi mgon po nang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge dkyus dang 'dra'o'i mtha' can tshar chen gyi gsung*/

de'i gsung 'gor tā ra na maḥ bram ze mngags pa'am bran du gtad pa zhes yod pa'i bram ze nag po mngags gtad kyi rjes (braṃ)gnang 'chol bar spyad na dam tshig nyes pa chen por 'gyur/ de bas gsang zhing sba bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ rdo nag po mi gcig gis theg mi theg cig ces yod pa'i sgrub dus kyi las khrigs gsal byed kyi yi ge rnying pa zhes spel ba ni man ngag dam pa'o'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma zhi ba dam tshig bskang ba'i gtor skyong dang gtor ma'i las tsam gyis dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i tshe bya ba drag po gtor chen gyi tshul lhan cig tu gsal bar ston pa'i cho ga gnam lcags (rdo rje)'bar ba zhes bya ba mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan zhes yod pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig bskang gso/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung (ku)rgyun phyag len ltar mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros kyis zin bris su mdzad pa nag po chen po mche ba can sogs kyi bskul bya'i mtha' can/ 'gor a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs zhes yod pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor ma drag po'i cho ga (rdo rje)bsgrigs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa gnod byed tshar bcad par bsam mo'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gtor chen gyi (rdo rje)'chams yig thu btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i gtor chen gyi rnga brdung bstan pa ni zhes yod pa'i gtor chen 'chams (rdo rje)yig gi zhal shes mthar dgu brdung 'ba' zhig gis sdud do'i mtha' can/ dpal mgon khyung zhal can gyi rjes gnang (shī)gi yi ge las sbyor gyi mgon por gtags gsung ngo'i mtha' can/

dpal mgon seṅge nag po'i gtor chog (badz+ra)las dang po pa 'ga' dang rang gi rgyun gtor gyi phyir phun tshogs gling du bris pa/ de'i rjes gnang 'gor (badz+ra)mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong 'phros pas zhes yod pa ga ga na dharma shrīs bris pa/ 'gor dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i srung (dbang)(sa)(glang)'khor tshe sgrub ces yod pa'i yi ge rin po che rta rwa ba'i gsung la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis reg zig mdzad pa de tsam ma gtogs rgyun khyer ji lta bas khrid mdzad kyi 'dug go'i mtha' can/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i srung (mus)'khor tshe sgrub kyi yi ge bdud rtsi 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ gnyis pa gsung gi mgon po dmar po'i nyams len snyan brgyud zab mo'i bdud rtsi rnal 'byor (ldong)(dbang)(sa)(glang)dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i rgyas pa gtso 'khor dgu'i khrid gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos bla ma dam pa'i bka' (ldong)(dbang)(sa)(glang)dang bshes gnyen dam pa 'ga'i ngor bkod pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i gsum pa rgyas pa'i las sgrub na yon tan gyi mgon po ser po lha lnga'i nyams len brgyud pa bzang (ldong)(dbang)(sa)(glang)sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i gdams pa chos bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gror gtad pa'i mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i bla rdo bca' ba'i thabs (ldong)man ngag gis rnam par brgyan pa/ des mdzad pa'i chu bo gaṅgā yang gyen la nges par ldog nus pa'i shwa bzlog gi man ngag rje btsun kun spangs (ldong)(sa)(glang)chen po'i gsung gi nying khu 'gro don dpag yas sa steng khyab par shog gi mtha' can/ bla ma gser gling pa'i man ngag rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po la zhus pa srog me khab (sa)ma gser srang bdun ma'i yon can yar klungs pa'i phyag dpe las bshus pa/

dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i thebs bzlog brtsi ba'i man ngag (sa)rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor na ma tsa turmu kha/ 'gab chad dang gzhogs drud dang zhes yod pa'i dpal 'bar gyi me bkra brtag pa kha'u pas gnang ba'i mtha' can/ 'gor skyabs med skyob pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa'i khang pa dben pa ru// zhes yod pa'i me bkra dang du ba brtag pa zhal las shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ me bkra 'di la bzang po'i rtags bzhi zhes yod pa'i me bkra brtag pa mngon shes su 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ dpal 'bar (dbang)bkra rtags/ ba len bkra (dbang)rtags rnams so// gnyis pa gsang sgrub kyi skor la/ dpal ma hā kā la zhal bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa snying gi yang thig ces (sa)(glang)bya ba rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i ru 'dren gyi pho brang sum cu rtsa gsum du mdzad pa/ des mdo khams pa lcags sgom chos rje'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin (glang)mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha zhes yod pa'i gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi tho/ des mdzad pa'i zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa'i gsang khrid kyi sngon 'gro rnam pa bzhi'i khrid nyams len gyi snying po dril ba yin no'i mtha' can/ lcags sgom chos rje'i gsung bzhin des dam pa'i gsung ngor bris (glang)pa'i zhing skyong dbang po'i gsang khrid kyi skabs su 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i las sbyor gyi gdams pa snyan brgyud ma/ gong gi 'phros 'gor gsum pa tsit+ta dharma tsakra zhes yod pa'i ches zab (glang)(sa)yang gsang snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor gyi yi ge rtags myur du 'byung ba ni nges pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor gsum pa las sbyor la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa zhes yod pa'i snying ga (glang)(sa)chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor snyan brgyud zhal shes kho na yin gyi mtha' can/

bsnyen sgrub las gsum (glang)gyi phyi ma'i yang yig 'gor lha mo nag mo'i gdams pa ni rang nyid sgrub pa'i dus kyi mgon po zhes yod pa'i las sbyor spogs chog gi dus su nye bar mkho ba'i lha mo nag mo'i gnad 'bebs shog dril gyi gnad 'bebs las khyad par du gyur pa'i zab khyad can tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rgyun gzhan du ma 'khyar ba mdzod ces bka' bsgo yod do'i mtha' can/ zab chos 'di nyid 'chad pa la med du mi rung ba'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i khrid yig (glang)rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ 'di nyid mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bka' drin la brten pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mjug tu/ rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i zlos gar gyis// deng 'dir skye dgu'i don slad bshes gnyen sku// pha rgod sku drin dbang po dgon gsar ba// mgon de'i gsung gi gsang ba mi zad pa// zab rgyas snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las// dad gus snyim pa'i bcud kyis bsdus pa 'di// skal bzang snying la grub pa'i dga' ston spel// zhes pa'ang snang ngo*// 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes yod pa'i gsang khrid kyi zin bris (zha)mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i yig chung ltar gsung gin 'dug go'i mtha' can rnams so// gsum pa phyi sgrub kun gyi snying por gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i snying thig ha la nag po'i skor ni/ phyi bram ze ltar sgrub pa/ nang zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gi sgrub pa/ gsang ba stobs 'phrog nag por sgrub pa gsum las phyi ma ste/ gong gi phyi sgrub dang khyad par gyi man ngag rnams su gab sbas thor bu bzhugs pas shes rlom can dag man ngag gi khog sgrig mi shes pas dpe mthong bas phyogs tsam yang mi rtogs pa'i phyir snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsung rgyun zhal shes phyag khrid kho na la bltos dgos pas/

rje btsun kun spangs rdo ring pa chen po yan chad du yi ge gsal bar bkod pa med 'dug na'ang*/ snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo zhing bdud rigs snying la zhugs pa'i skye bo mi srun pa dag gis rnam par 'tshe ba bsrung ba la ji skad du/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na// bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong bgrang yas kyang*// khro zhing 'khrug la gnyan zhing myur ba ni// yongs su grags pa stobs 'phrog dbang po yin// zhes ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams skor rnams med du mi rung ba lta bu yin na'ang*/ kwa ye da ni lang tsho mthon por song*// kha ba'i khrod na 'di 'dra shes pa med// ga le spel kyang nub par gyur dogs nas// nga yis 'di ni yi ger gsal bar bris// zhes bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su 'khrugs bsdebs su mdzad pa shin tu rno ba reg thabs med pa lta bu nas/ de ltar 'di ni srog 'phrog ha la'i dug /bstan dgra'i klad 'gems gshin rje'i dbyug pa ste// rnal 'byor sgos dgra'i snying 'byin bshan pa che// gang la'ang thogs med gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon// sa skya'i rje btsun thugs kyi gces pa'i nor// kun spangs chos rje'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha'i mchog /rnal 'byor g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i chas// zhes dga' rab dbang phyug sde dang bcas pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i go mtshon yin la/ de yang dgos pa'i gtso bo/ gang 'di thub bstan 'jig la thug pa'am// rnal 'byor kha zhan skyabs dang bral gyur nas// kha drag dpung gis bsdigs shing gnod pa'i tshe// mtshon 'di phyung la sdig can chos dbyings skyol// zhes bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i sgos dgra bsgral ba la dgongs nas mdzad pa yin pa las/ de la ma yig dang bu yig gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpal mgon zhing skyong nag po chen po dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang snying thig ha la nag po'i be bum zhes bya ba/

'di nyid kyi lung gnang ba'i dus mgon po'i bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can gyi drung du mchod gtor dang bcas te spyir las 'bras la 'dzem zhing bstan pa rin po che gces spras dang*/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa spyi dang*/ yang sgos gsang chen slob bshad pa'i ring lugs la gces par 'dzin zhing*/ snod ldan la chig brgyud las mang por mi spel ba sogs mgon po dpang du btsugs pa'i dam bsgrag cing*/ 'chol bar spyod pa rnams gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyis snying khrag 'thung ba'i bka' rgya shin tu dam pa/ dus der chos kyi yon la gser srang gang ngam yang na de ri ba'i dngos po 'bul ba sogs kyi phyag len deng sang gi bar du'ang ma nub par yod pas dpe tsam mthong bas nyams su len pa/ rku thabs su byed pa/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi sger la gces par 'dzin pa lta zhog gnod pa lhur len bzhin du tshul 'di don du gnyer ba rnams ni sa bon mes tshig pa la so nam 'bad pa lhur len pa dang*/ btsan dug la rjen zas byed pa dang mtshungs pas bag yod par bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o// gnyis pa bu yig ni/ gong gi ma yig gi be'u bum mi'i lus kyi phyi'i dbyibs lta bu la stod smad bar gsum gyi zab gnad don snod dang dbang po lta bu rnams logs su gab pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa phra mo tsam gyi phyir// drag po'i las sbyor byung rgyal rtsom byed cing*// chos la brten nas sdig chen gsog pa yi// blun po zhe sdang can de'ang 'di'i snod min// sdig can mi dpon stobs ldan khyim nang du// las sbyor drag pos lto gos 'tshol byed cing*// las 'bras rgyab bskyur mthu stobs chen por rlom// dmyal ba'i bud shing chos 'di'i snod ma yin// zhes pa'i gang zag gi lag tu son tshe spre'u la sgron me bskur ba bzhin thams cad phung la sbyor ba'i dgag bya dang dgos pa la dgongs pa yin pas bu yig gi skor la/
mā ri'i

1 lag len de 'khor gsal byed dang*/ 2 /mal srung bzlog 3 zab tsakra'i bri 4 yig bcas// gta' ru srog 5 bzung kha sbyor de'i gsal 6 byed// yid bzhin 7 'khor lo lo tsā'i sgros rnying gi /tsakra 8 (glang)mkha' 9 mig (glang)mda' gzugs 10 (glang)ling tshe rnying*// 'khor 11 (glang)can ling can 12 sngags (glang)can 13 rkyang (glang)gzugs 14 (glang)bzhi// paṇ+ḍu ra yi mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul 15 gcig(glang) /tsaṇ+ḍa'i tsakra 16 de yi lag 17 len bcas// rdo rje gri gug 18 dngos sku'i bsrung 19 ba dang*// mi min 20 rak+ṣi ta dwang ba 21 liṃ gzungs// spu gri so 'debs 22 man+t+ra lugs 23 ldog dang*// ral gri rtags can las bshus rnam dag 24 sngags// nyi zla can 25 dang de wī kā 26 li ma// mnan 27 pa dur rdo man+t+ra'i 28 ri mo can// bri yig lag 29 len (glang)(sa)gsal phyed zhal 30 shes (glang)(sa)dang*// drag 31 gtad (glang)(sa)gzugs 32 bsnun (glang)(sa)rten 33 brab (glang)(sa)spre'u 34 (glang)(sa)dang*// gcun 35 (glang)(sa)'khor ka 36 pā (glang)(sa)la dang gnad 'khor 37 (glang)(sa)lo// gnad dbab shi sa'i tshod 38 'dzin 'tshams sbyor 39 (glang)(sa)dang*// 'jam mgon sa skya'i chos kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa yis// khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs brtan nas// yab chos gsan tshe 'di dang gsang sgrub zung*// dkar 40 (sa)chag zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas kyis// mtha' rten kho bo'i snying dbus bum par bltams// zhes grangs tsam 'god pa las gsal bar mi 'dri ba ni/ 'di ni lho bal gser gyis gnongs pa ltar// yod ces mi smra shin tu gsang zhing sba// sbas kyang shes na khyi dang glo ba ni// phrad ltar mi bya rim gyis brtags byas te// skal bzang snod dang ldan pa'i bu mchog la// chig brgyud kho nar byin la rgyas gdab bya// zhes pa'i don snying gi dpal be'ur bcang dgos pas zhib cha mtha' dag yid la ri mor 'dri ba dang*/

gal te brjed ngas kyis 'jigs na tho gsal po bris nas gud du bcang ba las tho yig yongs grags su'ang rgyas par mi 'dri ba phyag len no// de ltar chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par nos pa las/ thog mar thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang rkyang pa ngor lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ grub chen ba lin+ta pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ rat+na kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyen lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de sras shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dang grub chen bud+dha shrī gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ gzar chen pa/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la lan mang du stsal to// yang na shug rwa ba grub mchog he ru ka dpal kun dga' dpal 'byor/ de pa'i gsan yul gyi bla ma shug ra gong ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan yin nam gang yin ma nges/

de nyid las bdag ban+de tshul rin gyis so// yang na byams pa bsod nams bzang po las thob pa'i gsan yul gyi bla ma slar rnyed na bri dgos/ yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dbang man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba/ sangs rgyas seṅge man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge/ bla ma rdo rje seṅge/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na sa lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ gzar chen man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ zhabs drung nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra/ yang na sa lo nas/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ de sras sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na zhabs drung a mi lags/ de sras bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs drung rgyal rtse pa man 'dra'o// yang bsnyen tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i pho nya myur mgyogs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas/ dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang dang*/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas brgyud pa'i sa bcad dang phyi sgrub skor dang*/ sa bcad gsum pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gyi man ngag rnams las shog dril dang po'i gsal byed rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa ma gtogs pa yongs rdzogs dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ldong g.yung drung lhan cig pa'i rtags can/

rtags gang yang med pa'i lung rnams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba lin+ta pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen grags pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun kun spangs rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// rjes gnang ni dngos grub rgya mtsho la sogs pa ltar/ sgrub dus kyi rjes gnang*/ dkar chag gi sa bcad dang po yongs rdzogs/ gsum pa'i nang gi ldong gi rtags can/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ldong g.yung drung can dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ grub chen brag phug pa yan gong gi bsnyen dus dang 'dra ba las/ de nas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rmor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// 'di dag la spyir rjes gnang so so'i brgyud pa ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar tha dad du bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ lung gi brgyud pa rnams ni dang po rtags so so ba ltar brgyud pa kho na yin yang*/ phyis su glegs bam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs zin pa tshun chad nas lung gi brgyud pa tha dad bgrang du med par bsdoms nas glegs bam dang be'u bum gyi lung thob yul gang yin ltar rgyun chags su sbrel shes dgos so// yang rjes gnang dang sa bcad dang po'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas/ bdag chen zhwa lu pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ e'i rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gzhi thog pa bdag chen kun dga' dbang phyug bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man gong ltar ro// yang rjes gnang dang sgo rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun rdo ring pa yan gong ltar las/ de nas rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra'o// rdo rje rkyang pa'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/

'phags pa rin po che nas/ bla chen rong pa/ bla ma shes rab seṅge/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang*/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rje rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras klu dbang gling pa/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra'o// rdo rje g.yung drung gi rtags can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gnyan lo nas gshongs ma'i sngags ban ga rod/ rtogs ldan 'tsho dkar ba/ 'dis dgung lo phyed nyis brgya tsam bzhugs sku tshe'i stod la sngags ban dang mjal sku tshe'i smad la spyan snga dang mjal zhes rdo rje gdan pa dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na snang*/ thel spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ rin po che tshal min pa/ rje seṅge dpal ba/ pha brag thog pa man 'dra/ 'di skor la brgyud tshul zur pa 'di 'dra zhig kyang mchis na'ang*/ de rgyu mtshan du byas nas rje btsun gong ma nas ma brgyud par 'dod pa ni log rtog go zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos gsungs/ rdo rje dga' 'khyil bcas pa'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kha'u pa nas/ slob dpon go cha/ dam pa de skyes/ gru rdo rje seṅge/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ jo nang kun mkhyen chen po/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rje lung rig pa/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal ba/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ glo'i rtags yod do cog gi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo ring pa chen po/ rje grol mchog mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ ku'i rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ gnyan ston sprul ba'i zlos gar rdo rje 'chang gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug bstan pa'i snang byed mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/

des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// dbang gi rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// ngag gi rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje dbang rab yan gong ltar las/ de nas mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra'o// mus kyi rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o// nyi g.yung drung bcas pa'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog nas/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs pa can pa shākya kun dga'/ dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po/ bla ma badz+ra ma ti/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ de gnyis ka las paṇa chen kun bzang rtse pas gsan/ de las zhwa lu mkhan chen/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang ba chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad gsum pa snying thig ha la nag po ma yig bu yig rtags med rnams kyi lung man ngag phyag khrid dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ drung yig byams pa don grub/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/

des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rmor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ mgon po bsod nams/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ bka' bcu rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub man gong bzhin no// rjes gnang bsnyen dus dang*/ sgrub dus khe rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje sa paṇa nas/ nub pa rigs 'dzin grags/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gu ru dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma rdo rje seṅge/ mkhan chen bka' bcu pa/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ rtses dang dge 'phel ba bsod nams blo gros/ rje rdo ring pa/ de las rje btsun sgo rum pa dang tshar chen gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses gsan pa man sngar ltar ro// yang na zhang dkon mchog dpal nas/ dgon pa ba bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon tshul man 'dra/ yang na chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag po bla ma/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ gung thang pa seṅge dpal ldan 'od mdzes bzang po/ bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra/ yang na gzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen nas/ gzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ grwa thang ba shes rab zla ba'i dbang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na bdag chen zhwa lu pa nas/ chos rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge/ rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang na chos rje bla ma dam pa yan gong ltar las/ de nas ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ de gnyis ka las chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge man 'dra/

yang na ngor chen las/ rje bsod nams dbang phyug rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rje bsod nams sangs rgyas/ mkhas grub gung ru shes rab bzang po bzhi kas gsan/ de bzhi ka las rje btsun rdo ring chen pos gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje nas/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka las mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ yab sras de bzhi char las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan pa man 'dra'o// sgrub dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa'i sgrub skor dang*/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad dang po'i ta'i rtags can gyi lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba lin+ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ gnyan lo man gdung brgyud brgyud pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa nas brgyud pa gnyis sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel bzhugs pa dang 'dra'o// sgrub dus kyi mgon po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/

brgyud lugs 'di lo pa spyan snga'i der yod par grags/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas gzhi thog bdag chen kun dga' rin chen/ gzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med grwa thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa man 'dra'o// yang sgrub dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang thun mong ba'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa chen po man 'dra'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ skyed tshal mkhan chen thar pa bzang po/ zhwa lu pa chen po man 'dra'o// sgrub dus dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ gzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs can shākya kun dga'/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag zhwa lu mkhan chen man 'dra'o// tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bka' rgya ma la brten nas mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes dbri bsnan dang bcas pa'i sgo nas las sbyor gyi mgon po gdong brnyan can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ nā gārdzu na/ ba lin+ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/

chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu pa chen po man 'dra'o// yang na 'phags pa rin po che yan gong ltar las/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ chos rje dharma kīrti/ chos rje blo bzang pa/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ bla ma lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo/ mus chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang*/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man gong bzhin no// yang na kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'khor zhal gyi rjes gnang zhes logs su bgrangs 'dug pa gdong brnyan can las zur pa med kyang lo mchog pa yod pa'i brgyud pa'i skabs gdong brnyan can dang las bzhi lhan du bgrangs pa'i dbang gis so sor phye bar snang ngo*/ /mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ na bza' pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ gzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ gcung grags pa blo gros/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal man 'dra/ yang na bdag po kun rin pa nas/ bdag chen blo gros pa/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje zla ba shes rab/ rdo ring pa man 'dra/ yang rje rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba man 'dra/ 'di nye brgyud yin pa 'dra zhing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig gi tshar lugs nas brgyud pa'i skabs ring brgyud dang gong dkar ba lugs kyi gsan yig skabs gsan yig rgya mtsho sor bzhag bgrangs 'dug pa rgyas bsdus su mngon/

paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa nas brgyud pa'i chos skor dang dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i 'bum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ tshar chen yan zhal ngo nang brgyud dang yar klungs pa nas brgyud pa rta rwa ba bzhugs pa nas/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ rta rwa ba/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ dngos grub rgya mtsho dang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge gsung rgyun phyag len ltar nang zhing skyong ltar sgrub pa'am gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang tshar lugs ltar las/ de nas dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas mchog pa/ mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ mdo khams pa lcags mo bkra shis seṅge/ 'dis stan thog gcig tu zhal gyi sngags thung 'bum phrag brgya song zhing zhal dngos su gzigs pa yin no// rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la gsang khrid kyi sngon du 'gro bar stsal to// yang na rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub yan gong ltar las/ de nas skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// phyi nang gi srung 'khor 'chi med sgrub pa zhar byung bzlog pa dang bcas pa'i phyi'i nyams khrid dang*/ gsang khrid kyi nyams khrid zab mo smin rgyas su thob pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas brgyud pa'i sa bcad gnyis pa'i skor/

dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i sa bcad gnyis pa'i rtags gang yang med pa rnams kyi lung rnams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan bshad ma thag pa'i gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang ltar las/ de nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ de gnyis ka nas rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab bla ma byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la'o// gsang khrid yig rnying dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ g.yag phrug bstan pa'i nyi ma sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes bya kun rig rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan 'dra'o// yang srung 'khor tshe sgrub kyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ lcags mo bkra shis seṅge nas/ khams ston bsod nams don grub/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra'o// glang gi rtags can yod do cog gi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// sa'i rtags yod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// byang chub ma thob kyi bar du chos skyong snying dbus su mi 'bral ba'i nyams khrid zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan gong ltar las/ de nas glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// las bzhi'i rjes gnang la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i yi ge ltar ram ngag chos pa'i yi ge ltar/ dkar po tshe 'phel gyi tshe dbang thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar las/

de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun spangs chen po rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba chen po/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ drin chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa nas/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog snying rje bzang po/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// dkar chag na bzhugs pa'i las bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yig chung dngos grub rgya mtsho'am mkhan chen ngag chos kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas/ dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ba/ ser po rgyas byed lha dgu/ dmar po dbang sdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang tshar lugs ltar las/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ chos rje dharma kīrti/ chos rje lam 'bras pa blo bzang*/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ bla ma lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mus chen rnam rgyal 'di mi bzhugs pa'ang byung*/ dpal bzang*/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/

tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje mai tri bod mkhar ba/ pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na dbang phyug rab brtan yan gong ltar las/ de nas mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang ba chen po bkra shis bzang po/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// yang dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ba dang ser po rgyas byed lha lnga'i rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ glang bu chos rje/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rmor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rigs brgya'i mgon po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// nor sgrub ser po lha dgu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ma hā de wa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī singha/ ā tsār+ya gnyan chen dpal dbyangs/ rgya gar kā ma rū pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ glang ban ga rod/ rtogs ldan 'tsho dkar ba/ spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ rje bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal/ grwa thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/

grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// yang na tshar pa rdo rje 'chang nas/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ bla ma rnam rgyal bkra shis/ dpal 'byor gling pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// gdong brnyan can gyi rjes gnang ni bsnyen dus dang 'dra'o// yig cha dngos gzhi dang tshar pa rje'i zin tho ltar gnad dbab kyi mgon po'am spogs chog gi mgon po nang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i rjes gnang dang ā rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ chos rje bla ma dam pa yan bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang gi zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar las/ de nas gzhi thog pa bdag chen kun dga' rin chen/ gzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ grwa thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ lcags zam pa chen po kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug khyab bdag zhwa lu pa chen po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rigs kun khyab bdag chen po rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul rin la'o// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin tho la brten nas/ dpal mgon khyung zhal can nam dmag dpon mgon por grags pa'i rjes gnang 'bum phrag gsum pa nas brgyud pa'i zhar byung du khyung zhal can gser gyi spu gri'i skor dang*/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i shī rtags can gyi lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ ma hā de wa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī la singha/ ā tsār+ya gnyan chen dpal dbyangs/ rgya gar kā ma rū pa/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ glang ban ga rod/ rtogs ldan 'tsho dkar ba/ spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ seṅge dpal ba/ rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs chen po/ grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man bsnyen dus kyi zhal ngo nang brgyud bzhin no// tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zin tho la brten nas mgon po che chung sogs slob bshad gdams pa phal cher rdzogs mthar bstan pa gtad pa'i tshul gyis bram ze nag po'i mngag gtad kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni 'phags pa rin po che lan bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang ltar las/ de nas brgyud lugs 'di lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig ltar byas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bdag chen kun rin pa/ gzhi thog pa blo gros pa/ rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse/ sngags 'chang dgon gsar ba chen po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu pa mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun chen po bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zin bris kyi steng nas rgya gar kā ma rū pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal mgon bram nag bshan pa drug skor nag po dom mchong gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ dzo ki kā ma rū pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/
bla ma grong mo che ba/ rje btsun red mda' ba/

rje re te zla ba zer ba'ang 'dug grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ 'jigs med dpa' bo/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dbang phyug gsan pa 'di nas yin nam brtag mkhas btsun bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ dran pas yid srubs dpung tshogs mthar byed pa'i// zhing skyong dregs pa'i sde dpon yum bzhir bcas// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i g.yar dam ma g.yel bar// byang chub bar du mi 'bral stong grogs mdzod// ces dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer lnga pa'o// //gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas bstan srung brgya rtsa tsam gdan drangs pa'i nang nas/ gtso bor gyur pa stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa'i bka' sdod bshan pa dmar nag gnyis su grags pa'i nang nas/ mthu rtsal mchog tu che ba las mkhan dmar po gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi skor la/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lcam sring 'khor mang gi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lcam sring gnyis kyi rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol gnyis smin rgyas su legs par nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/

bka' ma'i skor dang gter ma'i skor te gnyis/ dang po la spyi bye brag gnyis/ dang po yongs grags spyi'i chos skor la/ yid ches pa lo rgyus/ nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang*/ khungs btsun pa rgyud/ nyams su blang ba sgrub skor/ gong 'og tu nye bar mkho ba gtor mdos bskang ba/ gzungs dang thugs chen gzugs pa/ bstod bskul/ las tshogs dang brgyad/ dang po la/ gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam sring gi chos skor byung tshul bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros ltar gnyags kyi ban+des yi ger bkod pa/ 'gor bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// srog gi bshan pa mi reng dmar po zhes yod pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus man ngag la yi ge gcig kyang khyad mi 'dug go'i mtha' can/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// bshan pa sgrol byed srog bdag dmar po'i lo rgyus ni zhes yod pa'i bshan pa lcam dral gyi skyes rgyud rgya bod du dar tshul gdams ngag gnyan gyi lugs che bar gda' 'o'i mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang la/ 'gor na mo gu ru pad+ma rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅge'i gsung sgros mjug tu bla ma brgyud pa bkod pa/ 'gor ha ya grī wa la na mo/ beg tse lcam dral gyi gtor dbang ni zhes yod pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi yig rnying gtor dbang yig chung i thi'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅge'i tho yig las cung zad gsal bar rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa phrin las thams cad myur du sgrub par mdzad du gsol gyi mtha' can rnams so// gsum pa khungs btsun pa rgyud la/ dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i man sngags bshan pa dmar mo'i rgyud le'u drug pa dmar mo 'jig rten za byed ma'i rgyud rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dha ra kra shu dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pas bod yul dbus kyi grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/

srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags bshan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud le'u lnga pa shrī dha ra kra shu dang mar pas grwa thang du bsgyur ba'o// bzhi pa nyams su blang ba sgrub skor la/ 'gor rgya skad dang dmar mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i ngan sngags bshan pa dmar mo'i sgrub thabs srid pa gsum gyi yum e ka dza ṭī la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod dam chu 'gram mam zhes yod pa ā tsār+ya nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrī dha ra kra shus bsgyur ba/ pho'i sgrub pa 'gor rgya gar skad du dang srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags bshan pa sgrol byed kyi sgrub thabs dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod chu 'gram brag dmar ram zhes pa ā tsār+ya nyi ma grags pas mdzad pa shrī dha ra kra shu dang mar pas bsgyur ba/ drag las thams cad pho mo'i sgrub pa 'di gnyis la thug go /'gor gnod sbyin 'di ni skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zhes kyang bya zhes yod pa'i bshan pa dmar po'i sgrub thabs dgra bo dngos su sgrol bar 'gyur gyi mtha' can ā tsār+ya nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrī dha ra kra shus bsgyur ba/ 'di'i mjug tu rgya gar bam so dmar po nas nyi 'od grags pas bton tshul dang dgra la mig bltas pa tsam gyis shi ba byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod do// dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma dang bshan pa dmar mo'i ngan sngags yab yum sbags te sgrub pa gnas gsar gyi phyag dper nga yi nor gyi rting la rgyug man 'dri 'phro lus 'dug ā tsār+ya nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can shrī dha ra kra shu dang mar pas grwa thang du bsgyur ba/ srog bdag dmar po bshan pa gri thogs kyi sgrub thabs mu stegs slob dpon rdo rje grags pas mang yul byams sprin mgon po'i thugs kar sbas nas bstan pa'i don du smon lam btab pa gnam lcags thog dmar/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa gnod sbyin ra zhon yam shud dmar po'i sger sgrub gnyan los mdzad pa bdag gi bran bzhin khol bar shog yam shud srog gi sgrub pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/
