'gor bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// srog bdag dmar po bshan pa gri thogs sgrub par 'dod pas gnas ni ri gsum 'dus pa'am zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs mjug tu bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs kyi mtha' can mang du thos pa'i btsun pa seṅge 'bum gyis dpal brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ 'gor rgya gar skad du dang dur khrod dam brag dmar po'i rtsar bsgrub te zhes yod pa'i gnod sbyin lcam sring gi sgrub thabs drag po gnad bskul dang bcas pa kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅge mdzad pa dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod par shog gi mtha' can/ gnod sbyin beg gdong lcam sring 'khor mang gi sgrub thabs tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos lcags pho 'brug gi lo nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'o'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i chos skyong lcam sring gi mngon rtogs mjug tu rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol zhes yod pa rnams so// lnga pa gong 'og tu nye bar mkho ba gtor mdos bskang ba la/ 'gor chos skyong beg tse can gyi gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas lha mo dang de'i smin mtshams nas beg tse spro ba'i gtor chog yig rnying bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'dar phya ru ba rin chen dpal bzang gis brag ram chos grwar mdzad pa'i bskang ba ra dmar khrag chang ma/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bskang ba lha mchog sgrol ging ma/ a mo ghas mdzad pa'i bskang ba dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ gtor chog bsdus pa tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs kyi mtha' can/ de'i gsung rgyun gyi bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ lcang sbe ba seṅge 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i bskang ba byang shar dbang ldan ma/ bshags pa bde chen chos sku ma/ bud+dha bha dras bstod pa'i gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse ma/

bud+dha war+ṇas mdzad pa'i bstab pa dbang ldan ma ru ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i bskang bshags rgyun khyer rol mo drag tu bya'o'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa byang shar mya ngam ma shar mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis kyi ngor rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ rje de nyid kyis ā tsār+ya nyi 'od grags dang gnyan lo sogs gong ma rnams kyi yi ge 'thor ba phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi las byang phrin las lhun grub ma/ gtor mdos la brten nas srog bdag dmar po bshan pa sgrol byed bcos pa'i thabs phyogs phyogs ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa srog bdag dmar po'i bskang mdos rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam dral gyi gtor bzlog bos so chos skyong ma dpal ldan 'dar phya ru pa rin chen bzang pos dpal brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa rnams so// drug pa gzungs dang thugs chen gzugs pa la/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam zung 'dzugs dang thugs gso 'di gnyis glegs bam rnams su ma bzhugs pas lung ma thob/ dral 'khor bcas kyi phyi rten gzugs pa'i lag len gyi rim pa gnyags kyi ban+de bi dza ya bha dras dpal nyan po'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ srung ma'i dbang po beg gdong lcam dral gyi thugs gso ba'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa byang shar dbang ldan mar grags pa/ 'dar gyi ban+de rig 'dzin rdo rjes sbyar ba/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi phyi rten zung 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi cho ga 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa dang bcas pa'o// bdun pa bstod bskul la/ lcang spe ba seṅge 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rig pa'i lha mo ma/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅges mus srad dgon par sbyar ba'i bstod pa gang gi thugs rje ma/

rigs 'dzin rtogs ldan blo gros bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mus srad gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'i bstod bskul gnas mchog rgya gar ma/ gnyags kyi ban+de rnam rgyal bzang pos bstod pa'i ha ha dgod pa ma/ rgyud las phyung ba'i bskul gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse ma dang rig pa'i lha mo ma/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i skor la/ rgya gar yul gyi dam sri ma/ 'jam dpal thugs kyi pho nya ma/ e ka dza ṭī ma/ las mkhan srog bdag ma/ gri thogs brgyad/ bshan pa nyer gcig bka' 'khor spyi/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad dang bcas pa rnams kyi bskul gnyan los bsgrigs pa/ gnad nas bskul ba ma hā de wa ma rnams so// brgyad pa las tshogs la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dam tshig pa 'di be bum du ngos zin pa zhig med pas lung ma byung ba 'dra snyam ste brtag go/ bskyed bstim/ bsnyen pa/ rtags/ las sbyor/ shi sa/ smyo 'bog ltas ngan/ gcun thabs rnams kyi snying po'i man ngag ā tsār+ya nyi ma grags kyis mdzad pa shrī dha ra kra shus bsgyur ba dam nyams lag tu ma btang zhig gi mtha' can/ 'gor rgya skad dang dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gnad kyis bsad pa bstan/ e ka dza ṭī la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud dang mthun pa'i gnas zhes dang 'byung ba rlung la brten nas bskor ba 'khor los smyo 'bog lceb par 'gyur gyi mtha' can/ 'di lag tu blangs nas dregs ldan cham la phab pa'i nyams myong yang cung zad bdog 'gor bstan pa bsrung ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// sngags dang rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin dang zhes yod pa'i bsad pa'i las sbyor dha ra kra shu'i ngan sngags zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' rgya ma/ ling ga ming byang 'dri ba'i rdzas dang smyu gu'i ngos 'dzin/ 'gor dgra bo lha dang dbye ba la spyir dgra la lha lnga zhes yod pa'i lha dbye'i man ngag lhun bzang bdag la gnang ba lags so'i mtha' can/

'gor oṃ āḥhūm̐ yod pa'i sngags bsnal dkrug bzlog pa sogs kyi zab gnad bsad pa'i sngags i thi'i mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bla rdo'i man ngag gnyan lo'i chig brgyud ma/ bshan pa dmar po'i gsang rten bca' thabs ra ban chos dpal bzang po'i brjed byang*/ 'gor rang yi dam du gsal ba zhes yod pa'i bzlas pa'i gnad mtho bar byas nas yab rbad do'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ha la nag po dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba dbang lung thob pa'i snod ldan re gnyis la chig brgyud ma gtogs mang por spel na bshan pa dmar po la zas su gtad pa'i bzhes sgra dang bka' rgya shin tu dam pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrol gying dmar po'i gnad kyi gdams pa nang gi rnal 'byor la brten nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum myur du 'grub pa'i zab gnad can rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu dang srog bral lto ba'i gser bzhin sba ba'i chig brgyud ma ming tsam yang brjod par bka' ba'i gdams pa/ yab yum srog 'khor/ sgrub pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor/ rlung 'khor gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams phyag len dmar khrid nyams su myong bar nos so// gnyis pa bye brag gi skor la/ gnod sbyin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par brten pa'i gsang sgrub bka' rgya ma snying khrag thang la pho zhig gi mtha' can/ gnod sbyin gdug pa'i las sbyor la brten nas dgra la khyi dmag drang ba bai ro tsa nas paṇ+ḍi ta dha tsaṇ+ḍa la gser srang gang phul nas zhus pa/ dgra la bya dmag gtong ba sa la sba'o'i mtha' can/ wa thod las kyi rlung dmar la brten nas sngags pa nag po bsgral ba'i gdams pa man+t+ra i thi'i mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa gter ma'i skor la/ gnubs lugs dang nyang lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po pad+mas bsam yas dbu rtse'i ke'u tshang du gter du sbas pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis spyan drangs pa la/

rgyal po gser gyi shugs can dang btsun mo ut+pa la'i rgyan gnyis kyi sras su gcen grags ldan dang gcung grags skyes gnyis 'khrungs pa'i lo rgyus/ 'gor khrag gis dmar rjib gtang zhes yod pa'i srog bdag yam shud dmar po spu gri reg chod ces bya ba yam shud btsan gyi cog brdung bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ slob dpon pad+mas dur khrod phung lung nag por srog bdag yam shud dmar po'i srog phrogs nas mdzad pa'i bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub thabs ngan sngags kyi rgya bsdebs zhes bya ba/ bsad pa srog las kyi rkyal bu nas phyung ba ngan sngags kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ wa thod kyi thun snod la brten pa'i srog bdag yam shud dmar po'i thun gyi sgrub pa/ sngags pa nag po bsgral ba'i man ngag wa thod las kyi rlung dmar bsad pa'i man+t+ra i thi'i mtha' can/ bya 'ug khra srin bzhi'i sgro sgron pa'i srog bdag yam shud kyi mda' zor/ rdzas la brten nas smyo ba/ mdze/ skrangs 'bur/ bsrung ba/ mtshon srung*/ las mi byed par 'khu na srog bdag dmar po gzir zhing gcun pa/ mde kha rnam drug ces pa gri srog la brten nas smyo ba/ nal thod la brten nas bsad pa/ rims thod la brten nas nad rims/ smyo 'bog gi thod par brten nas 'od/ mon thod la brten nas ltas ngan/ phur par brten nas cho 'phrul rnams gtang ba'o// 'gor srog bdag bshan pa zhes yod pa'i dmod kha brgyad pa i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor srog bdag chen po'i dus la babs zhes yod pa'i bla 'gugs pho nya'i skabs gtso 'khor rnams kyi bskul byang bskul zhing rbad do rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gi bsnyen sgrub bsad pa gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa 'jigs rung me'i spu gri zhes bya ba paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rnams so// gnyis pa nyang lugs skor ni/

drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag la gdams pa spa gro skyer chu dang ru lag grom pa rgyang gnyis su rgod dang*/ g.yung mang yul du sbas shing rgod gcig mchims phur sbas pa mnga' bdag nyang gis spyan drangs pa la/ bshan pa srog gcod dmar po'i srog mthu drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud bsnyen sgrub rbad bskul la ma bltos pa'i ngan sngags chig chod ma yid la yang dran du mi rung ngo'i mtha' can/ gsang bskul dur khrod chen po ma phrin las gong ma rnams las thos pa yi ger bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ bshan pa srog gcod dmar po'i srog mthu'i zhal shes bsad thabs rnam pa lngas bstan pa las 'phro can dang 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud kyi zhal shes yig chung sgrub pa'i zhag grangs spogs pa kha bsgyur rnams bstan pa gsang ba'i zhal shes snying ltar chongs/ las can la 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud kyi yang yig rgya gar gyi ngan sngags bsad pa'i spu gri ldang ba dgra'i gshed ma bla srog rku ba'i man ngag ma gter nas phyung ba i thi'i mtha' can dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob cing ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yi ge ltar lcam sring gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang bka' ma phal cher gyi lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ma hā de ba/ ā tsār+ya nyi 'od grags pa/ sras zla ba nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/

shrī dha ra kra shu'ang zer/ 'di lam 'bras pa'i gha ya dha ra ni min no// gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ra sa'i shod bu bkra shis 'od zer/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug grub thob 'dar phya ru ba rin chen bzang po/ chos rgyal bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ slob dpon shes rab 'tsho/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug lcang spe ba seṅge 'bum/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅge bzang po/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal ba/ gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos kyi rje ye shes phrin las/ rje btsun bsod nams chos 'byor/ de las kun dga' chos 'phel yin nam/ de nas mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la shin tu dgyes bzhin legs par stsal to// yang na mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas/ byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ grub dbang bsod nams chos 'byor/ de las dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin nam bkra shis dbang phyug gang rung zhig las/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas gsan nam blta/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog dang mkhyen brtse'i tho yig la brten nas 'khor mang gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po yang gong ltar las/ de nas 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug drin chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la rjes su gnang bas be bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang bcas pa stsal to// yang na mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/ grub dbang bsod nams chos 'byor/ de las mkhas mchog bkra shis dbang phyug gis gsan/ de las rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang gis gsan/ de las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen bdag gis 'khor mang gi rjes gnang be bum gyi lung du bcas pa mnos so// rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig tu thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lcam sring gnyis kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar las/ de nas mnyam med dkon mchog dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ byams pa rin chen chos 'phel/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang pad+ma phrin las/ des bdag ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la'o zhes 'byung ngo*// yang beg tse lcam dral 'khor mang gi rjes su gnang ba'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje nas/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ mus srad pa dpal ldan seṅge man 'dra'o// yang na mus srad pa dpal ldan seṅge nas/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅge nas/ dpal ldan rat+na kīrti/ gu ru dug gsum nad sel/ mtshungs med rin chen bkra shis man 'dra/ yang na rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po nas/ ston pa chos dpal ba/ dam pa seṅge/ be phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/

glo bo 'dzar pa chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra'o// lung dang gdams skor gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po nas/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra'o// gnubs lugs gter ma'i lung brgyud ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs pa mtshur ston/ gnubs ston phug pa 'bar/ de nas rim par sngags 'chang sangs rgyas 'phel dang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po brgyud par bzhugs pa ltar ro// nyang gter gyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon chen po nas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer nas rim par brgyud de/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// nye brgyud ni slob dpon chen po pad+mas/ grub thob 'dar phyar la dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba yin no// 'on kyang da dung 'dir dpyad par bya ba rjes gnang gnyis ka'i brgyud pa'i smad so sor gyes tshul dang*/ be'u bum gyi lung brgyud kyi smad kyang rjes gnang dang phyogs 'grigs su yod med cung zad brtag par bya'o// smras pa/ rnam 'dren bka' srung bye ba'i 'khor lo sgyur// rnam gnyis mgon po 'khor bcas sgrub pa'i skor// bla chen mkhyen pa'i drang srong ltor 'khyil ba'i// gser chos dag byed skyugs rgyun de tsam btung*// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ gser chos gdong bzhi pa'i bka' sdod las mkhan dmar po gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer drug pa'o//

༈ //yar lung pa'i yi ge dang rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi zin bris kyi steng nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang legs par nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo le'u brgyad pa paṇ+ḍi ta bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta las brgyud cing 'dzim lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ 'gor he ru ka la phyag 'tshal dang*/ gang dang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ mjug tu shin tu gsang nas bsgrubs na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ngo*// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang dang*/ bla ma bai ro'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'o shin tu zab bo rgyud las phyung nas mdzad pa 'dzim lo'i 'gyur/ yang jag pa srung ba'i thabs zab mo 'gor rgya skad bod skad dang*/ srung ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi sngon dang zhes yod pa tshigs bcad ma/ 'di la the tshom spang ba'o'i mtha' can 'dzim los bsgyur ba/ de'i 'grel pa sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gor phyag 'tshal dang*/ dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi// gdams pa gzhung dang mi 'gal ba zhes yod pa/ bdag gzhan bsrung ba'i bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyar ba rnams kyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa/ 'di la mos shing sgrub pa rnams// bar chad med par dngos grub kun// ci 'dod pa ni grub nas su// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i man ngag lag len sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ las tshogs dum bu la 'gor yul du rims nad byung ba la zhes dang des ni mi phyugs nad rnams khegs kyi mtha' can/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i yig chung*/ tsakra'i rab gnas/ bsrung ba'i man ngag rnams kyi yig chung re/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag 'gor/

dam tshig ldan pa'i gang zag gis zhes dang*/ mjug tu las sbyor ni las tshogs so so'i skabs bzhin shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ sku rten sba ba'i man ngag kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur ro// 'di ni rten gyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/ yang sku'i mdun du mchod gtor 'bul ba'i man ngag des dga' mgur 'du ba yin no'i mtha' can/ yang yab yum gyi sku sba ba'i man ngag rten gyi man ngag logs su bkol ba'o'i mtha' can/ bstod bskul dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni zhes dang bstod cing bskul ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rdzas dang sngags la brten nas smyo ba 'dul ba gzhan zhig 'drir bcug pas kyang 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ de'i las sbyor dam nyams bsgral ba'i las tshogs drag po'i las so'i mtha' can/ yang dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul dpal sa skya pa chen pos g.yu mkhar mo sgrol ma lha khang du bris so'i mtha' can/ yar klungs pas mdzad pa'i mchod gtor 'gor/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa/ mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas zhes pa nas/ chom rkun bsrung ba'i mjug tu gzhan las tshogs mang po mchis pa rnams bla ma bai ro tsa na dang bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ rjes gnang gtor chog gi yi ge yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gzhan yang sa los mdzad pa'i yab yum gyi gtor chog sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bskang ba rnams kyi lung bcas thob pa las/ rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ rā hu la badz+ra/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na/ khams rgwa lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/

slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seṅge bzang po/ bar 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan zhes gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu byung*/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos rje bsod nams rab rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ sa lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ bsod nams rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas thob cing lung yang mnos so// yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha mchog seṅge/ bud+dha singha/ brang ti paṇa chen/ snying rje bzang po/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho man 'dra/ bai ro tsa na dang sa skya pa chen po dang yar lung pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ de nas rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen dbang phyug rab brtan/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de nas brgyud dam bla ma gnyis tsam btsal dgos/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dbang phyug dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bla ma gnyis tsam btsal dgos pa nas/ chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mkhas btsun kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor mang du mchis pa rnams kyi lung ni ma thos so// ༈ //paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge bklag pas don grub kyi steng nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs las sprul pa'i bstan srung chen po rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa lha mangs phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ mi nyag rtswa shing gi rgyal rigs / dpal chen rgwa lo tsā ba/ bde gshegs phag mo grub pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyid shod pa grags pa seṅge/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan lo grags pa blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs bral bla ma bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na ma ṇi ka shrī nas/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' rtse mo/ gu ge paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na ār+ya de wa nas/ a bha yā ka ra/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags man 'dra'o// 'di mgon po rang gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i lha mangs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las sngags gsar rnying gi mgon po yin no cog bsdus pa ni min no// ༈ //mgon po gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa lha mo bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa zur tsam bstan pa dang*/ rtsod dus kyi kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston rjes som nyir mdzad kyang phyag bzhi drug gi bla ma brgyud pa phal cher gyis tshad ldan du mdzad pa/ mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi par/ mgon po kun gyi gnas 'di ni// zhal gcig pa la phyag drug pa// dang po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// spyan gsum mthing nag rngam pa yi// g.yas g.yon bar pa phreng ba dang*// ḍā ma ru ni 'dzin cing brdung*// tha ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /sdigs mdzub zhags pas 'ching bar mdzad// ces sogs gsal bar bstan cing*/ rgya bod kyi paṇa grub dang lo tsā ba mkhas grub rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor la/ mkhas grub khyung po gdub bu pas ko sa li bik+ṣa'i dur khrod du rje btsun mai tri pa chen po la gser srang bdun phul nas zhus pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba'i skor dang*/ mkhas grub khyung po 'phan yul 'jog po'i ri la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe grub chen rā hu las chos sgo skyel gyi tshul gnang ba'i rjes gnang gi skor rnams bsdoms pas mgon po bcu gsum du grags pa/

skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa la/ gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel/ rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul tu bskur ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi skor la zhi ba grib sel/ rgyas pa bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud dang gnas dbab gcig tu byas pa/ gsang sgrub mgon po mchin kha/ nang sgrub rgyan can/ mgon po dbang rgyal/ mgon po tshe bdag sa ra ha'i mgon po khrag 'thung*/ lha bzhi dril sgrub/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu ste bka' bcu gsum du grags pa/ de'i khongs su mi the ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul la brten nas mgon po phyag drug pa snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan chas gos sin+dhū ra rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba shangs pa'i phyag len gtsang ma thob pa las/ thog mar gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel/ rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi skor la zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud dang gnad dbab gnyis gcig tu byas pa/ gsang sgrub mgon po mchin kha/ mgon po dbang rgyal/ mgon po snying zhugs thun mong ba rnams kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po/ grub chen rā hu la/ shangs pa lo tsā ba khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seṅge/ gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/

mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang*/ mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros/ mar ston tshul khrims rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag mgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ spro lung pa grub dbang bsod nams chos 'phel/ thub bstan mkhan chen tshul khrims bzang po/ khams ston rdo rje 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug drin chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lhun grub steng gi phan bde gling bla brang du stsal to// yang na ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho nas/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la stsal to// yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ 'brong rtse lha btsun rin chen rgya mtsho blo gros/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ mar ston tshul khrims rin chen man 'dra/ yang na 'brong rtse chos rje nas/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros/ mar ston sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang na mkhas grub shangs ston pa nas/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ 'jag pa blo gros dpal/ grub chen ngag dbang blo gros man 'dra/ yang na byams pa dpal nas/ kun dga' dpal/ ngag dbang blo gros man 'dra/ yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ rong ston blo bzang grags pa/ thon pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ gu ge ba nyi ma bzang po/ khri rin po che rgyal khang rtse ba dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/

rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal nas/ snar thang lo tsā ba don grub bzang po/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po/ shar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa grags pa rin chen/ snar thang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rje chos grags pa/ mar ston sems dpa' chen po/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa man gong ltar ro// yang na rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po nas/ rgyal sras bzang skyong ba/ rin po che chos dpal ba/ chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa man 'dra/ yang na 'jag chen byams pa dpal nas/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang*/ sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub rin chen bshes gnyen/ chos rje legs pa'i blo gros/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa man 'dra/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba bar gcod kun sel gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ mkhas grub shangs ston nas/ rje rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ rje bsod nams blo gros/ bla ma kun dga' bzang po/ 'dren mchog don yod rgyal mtshan/ yab chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ chos rje rin po che thub bstan pa/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal man gong bzhin no// yang na mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na mkhas grub rje nas/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gnas rnying pa kun dga' bde legs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho man gong ltar ro// yang na mtshungs med bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/ 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/ rgyud pa bkra shis 'phags/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags/ sras khang sngags rams pa bzang po rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba man 'dra/ mgon po rgyan can/ tshe bdag lha bzhi'i dril sgrub/

mgon dkar bzhi'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon dha na saṃ skṛ ta/ grub chen rā hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor man brgyud tshul gong ma mtha' dag dang 'dra/ sa ra ha'i mgon po khrag 'thung gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng*/ grub chen sha ba ri pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ khyung po rnal 'byor man gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ shangs lugs gtsang ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po yan gong ltar las/ de nas mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ gnyan ston rnam sprul gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa chen po bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas/ bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog dang rjes gnang gi yi ge bar chad kun sel gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ gzims shag chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug khyab bdag zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// yang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ phyag drug nag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel lung dang bcas pa/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang ba las thob pa/ rje des gsan yul bla ma gang yin blta/

de las bdag tshul rin gyis legs par nos so// ༈ //mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas dpal shangs pa bka' brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med dam mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi 'di skor gyi gdams pa gsar rnying gi yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa be bum du byas pa'i steng nas lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ khyung pos mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gdams ngag gi rgyal po dngos grub ma lus pa 'byung ba'i bdag nyid ces bya ba lo rgyus/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa/ mjug tu bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhal gdams snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus 'gor bla ma mai tri pa ko sa la bik+ṣa'i dur khrod ces dang*/ zhal dngos su ston no'i mtha' can/ gtor ma'i cho ga 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ mchod 'bul rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par ma/ bskang ba 'gor/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig ces dang*/ bsam don ma lus myur 'grub nas// longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dpal spyod shog gi mtha' can/ rjes gnang 'gor mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang la dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma zhes yod pa/ lte bar hūm̐ dkar po bris lugs gcig go'i mtha' can/ na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs/ las tshogs 'gor las kha tshar 'di la zhi ba nor du sgrub ces dang*/ tshes brgyad nas gnam stong gi bar la bya'o sa ma ya i thi'i mtha' can/ gter bum bca' ba'i man ngag 'gor bum pa kha yangs shing mchu yongs su grags pa dang ldan pa zhes dang*/ ches shin tu gsang bar bya zhing dpe su la'ang mi bstan no'i mtha' can/

'khor lo'i man ngag 'gor dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bri ba ni bri ba'i gzhi zhes dang*/ nor bu byed kyi hūm̐ bri ba ma yin no'i mtha' can/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge 'gor rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na thab khung zhes dang*/ sbyin sreg byar rung gsung ngo i thi'i mtha' can/ bum gter bca' ba'i man ngag 'gor chos skyong gi bum pa bca' ba'i thabs ni/ dang po bum pa so ma btang ba zhes dang*/ zhal shes rnams kyang yi ger bkod pa yin pas dpe gzhan la mi bstan par ches cher dam par bya'o'i mtha' can/ bstod pa chos dbyings spros bral ma/ kun dga' 'od kyis chos skyong zhal mjal dus bstod cing gsol ba btab pa yin no'i mtha' can/ rab gnas kyi yi ge 'gor rab gnas spyi dang mthun pa'am 'dis sgos kyi rab gnas zhes dang*/ shangs pa'i zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ yang bla ma'i sku 'bag rab gnas rdo rje 'dzin pa nam mkha' stobs rgyas kyis mdzad pa ste de rnams yig rnying gi skor ro// yi ge phyi ma la tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mgon dkar gyi sgrub thabs dang bstod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi phyag len bklag chog tu bkod pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po/ des mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bklag pas don grub dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu la gnang nas bskul ba'i tshigs bcad dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rnams dang bcas pa'i lung rnams thob nas/ rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug rgyal sras mai tri pa chen po/ grub chen rā hu la gup+ta

jo bo a ti sha'i bla ma ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa de yin/ badz+ra/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seṅge/ gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ ni gu pa sangs rgyas bzang po/ mtsho kha nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ mtshungs med e waṃ pa chen po/ rje dpal ldan don grub/ rje dbon 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lan mang du stsal to// yang na rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul rin la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bla ma gcig gnyis btsal/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa khyung pos mdzad pa dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yan rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ de nas byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ pu rang ba dpal ldan dar po/ zhi dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhas pa ngag dbang chos grags/ bdag po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan/

chos kyi spyan ldan sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de las rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis gsan/ de las mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis gsan/ des snyom las mkhan gyi mthar thug pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen bdag la'o// ༈ //lo pa tshul khrims dar gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang gtor chog gi steng nas jo bo chen po lugs kyi mgon po gri gug lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ bshes gnyen bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seṅge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo smon lam tshul khrims/ snar thang byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla chen bsod blo/ spyan snga sbyin pa dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa don grub/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na ye shes kyi mgon po/ bram ze mchog sred/ jo bo a ti sha 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'dzeng sgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar/ glang ri thang pa rdo rje seṅge/ glang thang pa zhang dge bshes gnyen/ slob dpon sgom pa/ dge bshes 'gar ba/

slob dpon gtsang pa/ rgya ma dbon ston/ lha brag kha ba/ mkhan po stag ru ba/ slob dpon sbas pa ston gzhon/ lo pa tshul khrims dar/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na sbas pa ston gzhon nas/ glang thang spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga yon tan rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po paṇ+ḍi ta gsang ba ye shes sam ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta lwa ba dmar por grags pas gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir lan gsum byon pa'i bar par gdan drangs shing*/ de'ang nges pa'i don gsang ba ltar na rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'am shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ nang ltar ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma/ phyi ltar ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo sogs mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod dang*/ 'grel pa rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa dang*/ mu tig phreng ba rnams las lha mo u ma de wī dang gcig par bshad de/ ming gi rnam grangs dgu bcu tsam gyis bstan cing*/ lha mo'i bstod pa'i skabs su mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstan pa dang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud rnams las kyang sngags srung drag mo'i sgrub tshul mang du bstan cing*/ bya ba'i rgyud rig pa mchog las phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs dang cho 'brang la bstod nas sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur te gsang sngags spyi'i srung mar bskos shing*/ yul nyer bzhi dang gnas so gnyis kyi nang tshan de wī ko ṭa ste bod skad du lha mo'i mkhar zhes par gnas nas/ zhing skyong ma mo thams cad kyi gtso mor mdzad par bshad pa'i dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rgyal mo zhes rje khol gnyis las khol mo re ma tir grags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang*/

bzlas lung phyag mtshan gtor ma'i bka' bsgo sogs thun mong ma yin pa shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas smin rgyas su thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta lwa ba dmar po/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po/ gnubs rgyal ba ye shes/ zhang lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma/ de sras zhang saṃ gha bha dra/ de sras zhang dpal chen 'od po/ de sras zhang gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu 'di ma byung ba chad pa yin nam/ rdo rje rtse mo/ zhang ding ri ba nyi ma 'od/ zhang bstan bzang pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ bsam gling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon po/ chos rje nyi ma bshes gnyen/ chos rje dkon mchog bzang po/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ bo dong ba 'jam dbyangs ral gri/ rje nam mkha'i snying po/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge/ yang mgon pa dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ de las shar pa ye shes bzang po dang*/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lan gnyis su stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ gnyags ston kun dga' rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lan mang du stsal to// ༈ //yig rnying gi steng nas phyag len ltar jo bo'i srung ma rdo rje lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma'i bka' gtad rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ bya yul ba/ gtsang po rin po che/ glang lung pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ zem rin po che/ tshes bzhi pa/ rgyal steng gser khang pa rin chen 'phel/ lo ba tshul dar/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag skal ba can ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //dpal zhwa lu gser khang pa'i srung ma dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdu/ dbang bzhi/ sku tsa ka li/ sngags kyi bzlas lung*/ phyag mtshan gtod pa/ gtor dbang dang bcas pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor mchog rjes gnang gi yi ge rgyas pa'i steng nas lung bcas dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin bris steng nas gnas lnga 'od zer spro bsdu gtor dbang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bsdus pa/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi yi ge'i steng nas bka' gtad bcas so sor thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ au ḍ+yān chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng*/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas/ lce btsun ye shes dbang phyug lce 'bum me/ lce 'bum dar/ lce 'bum ldan/ g.yu thog sgra gser bzang*/ lce ye shes 'bar/ mkhan po mngon pa ba/ bu ston seṅge 'od/ mkhan po grags pa gzhon 'di las bu ston rin po ches gsan/ nu/ bla ma bkra shis seṅge/ 'di las thugs sras pas gsan zhes mkhyen rab rje'i gsan yig las byung*/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' brtson 'grus/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/

chos kyi rje brag dkar rab 'byams pa bstan pa rab gsal/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na thugs sras rin po che nas/ sku zhang nam mkha' brtson 'grus/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dpal grub/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal las/ mkhas pa nor bzang rin chen dang*/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dpal grub dang*/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum char las rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ bka' bzhi pa mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rje btsun sprul pa'i ḍā ki ma 'khrul zhig rig 'dzin tshul khrims rgyal mo/ de las brag dkar ba bstan pa rab gsal dang*/ lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka nas tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsan pa man 'dra'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje nas/ rin chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan nas/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ sku zhang bsod nams lhun grub/ sku zhang ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ sku zhang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/

sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ bka' drin can rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas/ legs ldan nag po stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ phung byed shīn+taṃ gar+bha/ rom bu gu h+ya tsan+d+ra/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ bal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ dge bshes kun dga' grags/ so'i ban+de 'bum grags/ skyo'i ban+de mthu chen/ lce btsun mdo sde seṅge/ yang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ bal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas rin chen/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ rong pa grags pa seṅge/ lce mdo sde seṅge/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub thob be ha ra/ rat+na kīrti/ bhai ra singha/ jo bo rje/ 'ban dkon mchog blo gros/ shākya 'bar/ mkhar ston nam mkha'/ lce btsun mdo sde seṅge/ rong pa rgwa lo/ lce blo ldan seṅge/ bla ma sre'u chung pa/ 'jam dbyangs spos khang rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dga' ba gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ dbon chen chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ mdong rmor ba'i gsan yig tu pha rgod bla ma chos skyong rin chen zhes byung*/ gi sngags 'chang pha rgod rin chen rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje dam chos bsam grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong nas/

chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na dga' gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ dpal ri ba chos rgyal bzang po/ yab rin chen rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na lce blo ldan seṅge/ rje btsun nam mkha' bsod nams/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rong pa rgwa lo/ sras shes rab seṅge/ gcung ā kar sid+dhi/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang*/ dbang phyug rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na lce mdo sde seṅge/ gru shākya 'bum/ lce blo ldan seṅge man 'dra/ yang na gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes nas/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnubs ye shes/ gnubs mchog gi snying po/ gnubs rgya gar rdo rje/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa khro bo 'bar/ dar ma rgyan/ hūm̐ chen pa/ rtsa ba lung gi jo bo 'byung gnas/ shākya bzang po/ stag ste 'jam dpal/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang man 'dra'o// ༈ //paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog rjes gnang bya tshul bklag pas don grub mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi steng nas gnyos mgon trak+ṣad 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred/ rnal 'byor pa ro zan de wa/ rnal 'byor ma bde ster ma/ bla ma ba liṃ ta ā tsār+ya/ kha reg gi gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ de sras gnyos rdo rje bla ma/ gnyos dpal 'byung*/ gnyos dpal gyi seṅge/ yab gnyos nag grags pa dpal/ 'gro mgon

rgyal ba lha nang pa'ang zer/ ras chen/ bla ma rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma byang chub dar rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas/ mkhas pa ye shes rin chen/ kun spangs chos kyi rin chen/ dbu ma ba dpal ldan rin chen/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po mtshan chos kyi gzi brjid/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thar pa rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ chos rje shes rab don bzang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ drin chen he ru ka dpal bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la dgyes bzhin par stsal to// yang na rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub nas/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ras chen nas/ rgyal sras ba ri stag tshang pa/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas phyar chen/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas/ drin can mkhas btsun sangs rgyas/ kun mkhyen saṃ gha bha dra/ brgyud 'dzin sangs rgyas bzang po/ dbu ma pa dpal ldan rin chen man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen brang ti pa/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ gzar chen sangs rgyas dpal ldan/ chos rje shes rab don bzang pa man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen nas/ rje dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ dpon slob gzar pa man gong bzhin no// ༈ //phyag rdor khang bu brtsegs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas zhang blon chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/

grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ mkhyen rab mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po bai ro tsa na/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa grwa pa mngon shes/ pu rang mgon po rin chen dang ga gran nag po/ de gnyis ka las dge slong smon lam 'bar gyis gsan/ de nas gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen/ dol po badz+ra pā ṇi/ rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ nyang byang chub sems dpa'/ brag dkar sman bla/ jo sras dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mgar btsun tshul ston/ mkhas grub chos dpal bzang po/ chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'gos gzhon nu dpal/ rje nam mkha' shes rab/ rig 'dzin chen po nyi ma 'od zer/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'dren mchog dam pa byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// ༈ //byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas/ dbang phyug ma tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes su gnang ba thog mar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ tshe bum la brten nas tshe dbang bskur ba/ bum pa'i dbang la brten nas rigs lnga'i chu dbang bskur ba/ gtor ma dang phyag mtshan la bsten nas chos skyong ma dngos kyi rjes su gnang ba smin rgyas su thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can ma/ au ḍ+yān chos kyi rgyal po pad+mā ka ra/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ dbang phyug bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal/ 'bri khung 'jig rten gsum mgon/ de dbon gcung rin po che/ a brtses pa/ spyan snga rdor rgyal/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī na ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen dga' ba gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ dbu legs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dpal ldan mid la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza/ gung thang ras pa/ rgya pho ba lung pa/ lha sa rat+na/ spyil dkar grub chen/ rat+na bha dra/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan po byang chub seṅge/ gzhon nu kun dga'/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ byang sems kun dga' bkra shis/ stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra'o// ༈ //ma gcig dpal lha'i rjes gnang thob pa'i nye brgyud ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku srong btsan sgam po/ yang sprul thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ sdom pa'i bka' sdod dur khrod yab yum dang*// phyag bzhi phyag drug mgon po gri gug can// dpal ldan lha mo stag zhon trak+ṣad zhang*// bstan srung chos skor rgya mtsho thos tshul lo// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/

dur khrod yab yum sogs bka' srung rnams kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer bdun pa'o// //gnyis pa de thams cad kyi rgyab brten lung gi tshogs thos pa'i brgyud rim la gnyis/ mkhas grub rnams kyi bstan bcos dang*/ ston pa'i bka' lung rin po che'o// dang po ni/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i snang phyed mkhas shing grub brnyes bla ma dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ni/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ga' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa// de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags phyogs kyi tha snyad so sor dbye bar dka' ba bstan bcos sna tshogs pa'i skor gyi lung khrid mnos pa'i rnam grangs la/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje de nyid gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir sems can gyi don du bsams bzhin du sprul pa'i sku'i skye ba bzhes pa/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya bas thub bstan rin po che thugs kyi dpal be'ur bcangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bsgrubs te/ dam pa'i chos dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas bcal ba'i khrid brgya'i skor nos pa la/ zab khrid brgya dang brgyad kyi khungs gleng ba'i lo rgyus mdo tsam bris pa'i mthar tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig gis zhabs brten pa/ gsol 'debs brjod bde brgyud pa'i mtshan sdom/ sa ma 'grel ya mtshan 'phrul gyi lde mig spyi sdom khrid tshul brgya dang brgyad kyi mtshan tho dmigs bsal/ spyi chings rnam par spel ba ngo mtshar chos kyi sgo mang*/ thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro'i gnad bsdus pa/ sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa sogs gsung rab ngo mtshar can mang du bzhugs pa las/

sa skya pa'i yab chos 'ga' re'i nyams khrid dang gzhan rnams lung khrid kyi tshul du nos pa'i khrid yig gi rnam grangs la/ mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rje btsun sa skya pa la dngos su gnang ba'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog rje bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rje lcags zam pa ngag dbang nyi ma/ dge steng bla ma kun dga' dpal bzang*/ lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug de sras sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal po/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang ba chen po thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bla ma gnyis tsam btsal dgos/ de nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o/ 1 /sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ grol sde gnyis/ gu ṇa mi tra/ seng bzang*/ gang spel/ ku su lu gnyis/ gser gling pa/ jo bo/ 'brom/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ 'od zer bla ma/ byang chub 'bum/ lha sdings dbon po/ yon tan dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/

dpal ldan ye shes/ hor bka' bzhi pa/ dpal ldan bzang po/ gnas brtan bsam phan/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ kun dga' mchog grub/ kun dga' grol mchog man 'dra/ 2 bo dong rin rtse'i snyun mdze gdang ldog tu btang ba'i rten 'brel snying po'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ po to ba/ lcags ri ba chos kyi g.yung drung*/ snye phu rgya sgom/ brag ram pa/ nyan chen pa/ shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa man gong ltar ro/ 3 /khro lo lhag par khur che bas sbyong ba'i skabs kha che paṇa chen gyi bde sdug sku gsum ngo sprod pa skyid sdug lam khyer gyi brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen/ khro lo/ lho brag pa/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras pa/ red mda' ba/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' mchog grub man blo sbyong don bdun ma dang 'dra/ 4 sum pa lo tsā ba khams 'dus pa'i tshe sgrol mas gnang ba'i gdams pa rgyal sras thogs med pas bla ma dam pa la drung gi thugs dam gyi bcud sems can la phan pa zhig zhus pas gnang ba'i sum pa lo tsā'i snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag ma/ sgrol ma/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras bzang po dpal/ byang chub rtse mo/ hor bka' bzhi pa man blo sbyong don bdun ma ltar ro/ 5 /rgyal thang pa bsam gtan 'od zer gyi yi ge la gcod yul snga ma rnams la ma grags pa'i lab sgron gyi zhal shes gsang bas brgyan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yum chen mo/ bstan pa'i gtso bo/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng*/ sgrol ma/ su kha sid+dhi/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ ma gcig lab sgron/ khu sgom chos seng*/ dol pa zang thal/ rgya nag gcer bu/ sangs rgyas rab ston/ sangs rgyas dge slong*/ rin chen 'od zer/ rtsa tsha ras pa/ 'di gnyis grol mchog gi brgyud 'debs na snang yang gsan yig na mi 'dug

skye med jo stan/ mkhan chen chos rin/ rin chen gangs pa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ rin chen dpal bzang*/ rin chen gzhon nu/ bsam 'od pa/ rtsibs ri nam mkha' 'od/ shākya 'od zer/ skyes rtsa ba bde legs/ dbon sras chos legs/ yig drug shes rab dpal/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas rab ston nas/ bla ma dam pa/ do pa chos she/ lha ston zhig po/ zhig po thog rdugs/ nyan chen pa/ mus chen rgyan dpal/ sngags 'chang rdor gzhon/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ sems dpa' chen po dkon rgyan/ rje rdo ring pa/ grol mchog man 'dra/ brgyud pa bar ma 'di khungs btsun par sems/ rgod phrug pa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas/ pha rgod bsod bzang*/ rje rdo ring pa man 'dra/ 6 kha sar+pā ṇis mi tra dzo ki la dngos su gnang ba'i snying po don gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ blo gros rin chen/ tai lo pa/ rnyog med dpal/ mi tra dzo ki khro lo/ bsod nams dbang phyug sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston/ thugs sras pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan/ mkhyen rab rje/ kun dga' mchog grub man blo sbyong don bdun ma ltar ro// yang na yang rtse ba nas/ dgra bcom yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung gzhon nu blo gros/ shāka mchog pa/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 7 maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du kha sar+pā ṇi sku khru gang pa'i tshad tsam zhig dngos su rje mi tra dzo ki la bstan nas gsungs pa'i zab chos thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis thugs sras rnams la snying gtam gros 'debs su mdzad pa'i sems nyid ngal gso'i brgyud pa ni/ kha sar+pā ṇi/ mi tra dzo ki khro lo/ dzang sgom bsod dbang*/ khro phu sems dpa'/ yang rtse rin chen seṅge/ bu ston yab sras/ rje grags rgyan/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan/ mkhyen rab rje/ kun spangs rdo ring pa/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/

8 bshes gnyen sha rwa bas tshogs pa lan gsum bkye ba'i mtha' ma'i skabs gtum ston la gtsang phyogs su 'gro don 'byung bar lung bstan pa ltar dpal snar thang gi chos sde dar rgyas su gyur pa'i bka' srol skyes bu gsum gyi brgyud pa 'di dang srid zhi mnyam nyid/ dbu ma chen mo/ lkog khrid bzhi la bka' gdams pa'i khrid chen bzhir grags so// ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde rnam gnyis/ rnam snang mdzad/ seng bzang*/ ku sa li che chung*/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ rngog legs she gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ gtsang nag mi'i seṅge/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ ze'u brtson 'grus grags/ ze'u grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang grags/ lo chen byang rtse/ hor bka' bzhi pa man blo sbyong don bdun ma bzhin no/ 9 /gtum ston pas sha rwa ba nas brgyud pa rgya cher spel ba'i bstan rim gyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje yan skyes bu gsum ltar la/ de nas 'brom/ po to ba/ sha rwa ba/ gtum ston/ gro ston/ zhang ston/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston/ ze'u sku mched/ mchims blo bzang grags/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpang ston grub pa shes rab/ grags ston dpal ldan don grub/ rwa ston man blo sbyong don bdun ma ltar ro/ 10 /gro ston bdud rtsi grags kyis bya yul ba'i slob ma mus sman par gsan pa'i srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ gser gling ba/ jo bo/ 'brom/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman ba/ gro ston/ zhang ston/ stongs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims/ skyo ston/ bcom ral/ gro ston kun rgyan man bstan rim dang 'dra/ 11 bal po pe nya ba la byang sems zla rgyal gyis gsan pa'i thal rang gang du'ang ma phye ba'i gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma chen po'i brgyud pa ni/

thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub yab sras gnyis/ zla grags/ rig pa'i khu byug pe nya ba/ byang sems zla rgyal/ rdzi lung pa/ gro ston man bstan rim sor bzhag go 12 /sha bo sgang par mus sman pas gsan pa gro ston las brgyud pa'i bka' gdams lkog khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo yab sras/ po to ba/ sha bo sgang pa/ mus sman pa/ gro ston kun rgyan man bstan rim ltar ro/ 13 /sangs rgyas sgom pas glang ri thang pa'i gdan sa pa bshes gnyen zhang las gsan nas 'phel ba'i thub pa'i zhi gnas sems 'dzin/ 14 spyan ras gzigs kyi snying rje mkha' khyab/ 15 mi g.yo ba'i gtum po bgegs bsrung*/ 16 sgrol ma'i mngon shes lung ston te bka' gdams lha bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ jo bo/ sgom pa ba/ sne'u zur pa/ glang thang pa rdor seng*/ zhang zhung pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa man bstan rim bzhin no// lha gzhan gsum gyi brgyud par thub pa'i tshab tu lha so so 'jug pa tsam las de phyin 'dra/ yang na lha bzhi so so'i khrid brgyud bya rgyud kyi skabs smos pa ltar gyi gnyug la paṇa chen nas/ rje kun spangs chen po/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 'dir lo phyogs nas brgyud pa'i khrid chen mo la zur za'ang snang yang chen mo rang legs par mngon ma dag pas dag pa sun dbyung ba 'dra'o/ 17 /sgrung brgyud la brten nas las dang po pa yid sgyur bar byed pa'i thabs bla na med pa dpe chos kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ po to ba/ brag dkar ba/ slob dpon 'phan yul ba/ lce sgom pa/ smon lam mgon po/ rta nag pa rin ye/ rje dpal ldan ye shes man blo sbyong don bdun ma sor bzhag go 18 /nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i lag rjes mdo sngags ma lus pa stan thog gcig tu hril gyis bsgril nas snying gi thig ler 'chang rgyu thig le bcu drug gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ sgrol ma/ jo bo yab sras/

rngog legs she mnga' ris pa sher chen/ phu chung ba/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ stab ka ba byang bzang*/ slob dpon nam rin pa/ 'brom gzhon nu blo gros/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ gra phu ba/ sga lung pa byang dpal/ bsod nams 'od zer/ bsod nams rin chen/ chos grags pa/ mkhan chen rat+na/ gnyug la paṇa chen/ a wa d+dhu tī pa/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na chos grags pa nas/ dpal 'byor bzang po/ 'brom seng rgyan/ lo chen thugs rje dpal/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 19 kun mkhyen rong ston gyi pha dam pa'i rab gnas ma'i 'bum dga' ldan ma gzigs pa'i dus lung bstan byung ba ltar la stod ding ri glang 'khor du dam pa blo rgyam las gsan pa'i sher phyin bka' babs drug gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ dam pa kun dga'/ pa tshab lo tsā ba/ rgyal ba tan ne/ zhig po nyi seng*/ snye mdo bsod dpal/ snye mdo kun 'od/ ri khrod dbang phyug tshul khrims 'phags/ sangs rgyas dbon/ ding ri blo rgyam/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang man blo sbyong don bdun ma bzhin no/ 20 /rong ston gyis gra sman gcig pa sher bzang las gsan pa'i zhi byed lam lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng*/ dam pa yab sras/ pa tshab lo tsā ba/ rgyal ba tan ne/ zhig po nyi seng*/ 'khrul zhig dar seng*/ snye mdo yab sras/ dpal chen kun lhun/ chos rgyal sher bzang*/ rong ston chos rje/ kun mkhyen gung ru/ mkhyen rab rje/ spyang lung chos rje/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 21 dbu ma rang brgyud pa'i mtshan gzhir gyur pa'i lam srol ka ma shī la'i sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum khrid du bsgril ba rong ston gsung gi snying po'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ zhi ba 'tsho/ kā ma shī la/

rgyal ye rnam gnyis/ mchog ye grub/ se btsun dbang gzhon/ 'gar tsha yon tan/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung*/ ra khri bzang 'bar/ lo ston chos grags/ brang ti dar snying*/ mchims brtson seng*/ rgyang ro dar mgon/ mchims shod lo tsā ba/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba/ dpang lo/ byang chub rtse mo/ nya dbon/ g.yag sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes rab rgya mtsho/ rwa ston yon dpal/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 22 byams chos sde lnga'i khrid brgyud ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ rig pa'i khu byug daṃṣ+ṭi bzang po/ dī paṃ ka ra/ gad+gā dha ra puṇ+ye shrī/ kha che mgon pa ba/ bram ze saṃ gha dzñā na/ rngog lo/ ba reg lo tsā ba/ ba reg ston skyabs/ yon tan dga' ba/ bkra shis rdo rje/ gdong khrod 'dul 'dzin/ nyang dkon rdor/ 'jam dbyangs dar/ bag ston tshul rgyan/ dpang ston pa/ g.yag pa/ rong ston don yod dpal/ rwa ston/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 23 'di'i lo rgyus la chos nyid rnam 'byed dang rgyud bla rgyun chad pa mai tri pas gsan pa'i lo rgyus drangs pa las brgyud pa'i skabs de dang mi mthun pa mdzad 'dug pas dpyad dgos snang ngo*// pa tshab lo tsā bas zla ba grags par dngos su gsan pa'i rang stong gi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ zla grags/ pa tshab lo tsā ba/ zhang thang sag pa/ dbang phyug grags/ shes rab rdo rje/ slob dpon ston tshul/ su kha de/ slob dpon jo btsun/ dbu ra ba/ shes rab dpal/ dar ma shes rab/ bag ston sher rin/ bsod nams seṅge/ bsam gtan bzang po/ 'gar ston gzhon bsam/ dmar ston gzhon rgyan/ rong ston/ paṇa chen shāka mchog a mo gha/ rje grol mchog man 'gre'o/ 24 /'khor lo mtha' ma'i dgongs don dang mtha' phye chos dang chos nyid phye ba'i rjes su 'brang ba 'byed gnyis/ rgyud bla rnams dpe tsam yang dka' bar byung tshul btsan kha bo che'i zin thor gsal ba bzhin rgya gar du'ang yod par grags pa'i gzhan stong gi brgyud pa ni/

thub pa/ byams pa/ mai tri pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dga' ba grags/ sadz+dza na/ rngog lo/ btsan kha bo che/ rgya dmar ba/ gro lung pa/ cha ba/ 'dul dkar ba/ 'bre sgyur ba/ gdong khrod pa/ dar 'od pa/ grub seng*/ bag ston pa/ tshul rgyan pa/ dbang ston pa/ g.yag pa/ rong ston/ a mo gha/ rje grol mchog man 'gre/ gong du mai tri par byams pas dngos su gnang ba'i lo rgyus 'dir 'os pa 'dra'o/ 25 /rdo rje sems dpas bo dong 'jigs grags la gnang ba byin par grags pa de nyid 'dus pa'i snying po khol du phyung ba sbas don kun gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ bo dong 'jigs grags/ rje btsun gsang ba byin/ shangs pa bsod nams mchog gyur/ zal mo brag pa grags ye/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 26 grub rgyal tshe khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu ba/ ras chung pa/ mid la/ dwags po pa/ phag mo grub pa/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga grags 'byung*/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'ba' rwa ba/ gnyan ras pa/ skyabs che ba/ tre bo chos rgyam/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ sangs rgyas seṅge/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ pha rgod bsod bzang*/ rdo ring rin po che/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ 'jam dbyangs rje/ rat+na'i mtshan can/ bsod nams bzang po man 'dra/ yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ rtogs ldan bde legs pa/ 'khrul zhig rje/ mkhyen rab rje/

grol mchog gi gsan yig bar mar chad 'dug kun spangs rje man 'dra/ yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ g.yag pa/ las chen gzhon nu seṅge/ dga' gdong chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog man gong dang 'dra'o// 'ba' ra ba lha gcig bum gcig 'di snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs gsungs pa nyams khrid la dgongs na mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa mi mthun pa med par snang la/ de nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang tsam la ni mtha' gcig tu nges pa med de/ brgyud tshul mang du yod pa'i phyir ro// jo lugs sgrol dkar gyi brgyud pa ni/ tshe sbyin sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang grags pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ gser gling pa/ jo 'brom gnyis/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ 'chad ka ba/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ rgyang ro byang 'bum/ mchims ston/ gro ston/ dpang ston/ spyang lung pa/ paṇa chen shāka mchog gzhon nu chos grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na sgrol dkar/ karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ rin chen bzang po/ mthong ba don ldan/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ te'u ra rin chen chos rgyal/ phra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchog grol mchog man 'dra/ 28 mkha' 'gro ma de wa ḍā kis mi tra dzo ki la gnang ba'i tshe 'dzin dkar po'i brgyud pa ni/ de wa ḍā ki mi tra pa/ bud+dha shrī/ chag lo khu dbon/ gzhon nu byang chub/ rgyal ba nyi ma rgyal/ bzang po dpal/ ye shes dpal/ blo bzang dpal 'byor/ te'u ra pa rin chen chos rgyal/ phra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchog rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 29 thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi dmar khrid jo bos yol ston la gnang ba'i brgyud pa ni/ 'di dang 'og ma gsum bsdoms par thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid rigs bzhi zer/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ dpal gyi bzang mo/ ting 'dzin bzang mo/

jo bo/ yol chos dbang*/ rog ston/ rtsis ston/ jo sras zhang ston/ gsal ston zhig po/ rnal 'byor skyabs seng*/ sangs rgyas dbon/ 'dul 'dzin rin byang*/ byang sems bsod grags/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ rgya ma ba yon 'od/ lo tsā ba grags rgyan/ byang sems dkon rgyal/ kun dga' mchog grub/ grol mchog man spyi ltar ro/ 30 /byang sems zla rgyal la zhang skyi tsha 'od chen gyis zhus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyad ras gzigs/ byang sems zla rgyal/ zhang skyi tsha 'od/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo mya ngan med dpal/ zhang rin 'od/ zhang 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan/ snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras thogs med man dpal mo lugs dang 'dra/ 31 bdag med ma las gnyan tshem bu pas dngos su gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ tshem bu pa/ spyi lhas pa/ brag dmar ba/ lha btsun dgon gsar pa/ zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med pa man dpal mo lugs dang gcig 32 skyer sgang pas lha sa'i klu phug dkar chung du lce sgom las zhus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ rā hu la/ a ti sha nag tsho/ rong pa phyag sor pa/ mnga' ris sher rgyal/ lce sgom pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyen ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ras chen shangs dkar pa rin rgyan/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs rgyan/ grol mchog man spyi ltar ro/ 33 /rgyal sras thogs med pas rwa sgreng sogs su bzhugs dus slob dpon dril bu pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes kyi gzhung chung dang dga' rab rdo rje'i bde dgyes lhan skyes kyi rgya gzhung la dmar khrid so sor bkral nas gsungs pa'i bde mchog gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo/ dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ zhang ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ byang sems rwa sgreng pa/

spyang lung pa/ rje shāka mchog gzhon nu chos grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 34 dgyes rdor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ dga' rab rdo rje man bshad ma thag pa dang gcig rgyal sras pas 'di mdzad par kun yid mgu zhing dpal ldan bla ma dam pas legs so gnang bar grags kyang don du rgyal sras pa gsang sngags gtan mi gsung tshul 'dug pa ni khrid 'di grul mi btub par 'bad pas bsgrubs pa 'dra zhig snang ngo*/ 35 /bla ma dmar nas brgyud pa'i 'khor chen rdzogs rim gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ seng gdong ma/ sa ba ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pūr+ṇa/ lo tsā ba 'gar chos bzang*/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ dmar thub pa shes rab/ dmar brtson 'grus seṅge/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ cha gan pa/ 'dzim chen pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ brag dkar bsod rin/ brag dkar bsod rgyan/ spos khang mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 36 ras chung lugs kyi gtum mo'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ las kyi rdo rje/ shing lo pa/ thang lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ pa la tsan+d+ra/ ras chung pa/ sum pa rin rgyan/ gling ras pa/ rdzong ri pa/ ri bo sgang pa/ dbus ri ba/ gsang bdag grub chen pa/ sprul sku jo gdan pa/ gangs khrod pa/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ bzang ldan sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ gzhon nu grub/ gnas gsar stong legs pa lhun grub rdo rje/ mang mkhar rab gsal zla mgon/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 37 chag lo lugs kyi phag seng kurma pā da'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ sha wa ri pa/ mai tri pa/ na ya ka pa/ da sha pa la shrī/ bi k+ṣa ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ dpal bla brang pa gzhon rgyan/ shes rab dpal/ grub thob legs 'od/ dpal chen bzang po/ ye shes dpal bzang*/ blo bzang dpal 'byor/ te'u ra pa rin chen chos rgyal/

rje rdo ring pa chen po/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 38 ku ru kul+le'i gsang khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ bdag med ma/ bi rū pa/ nag po pa/ si la ba/ shī la tsan+d+ra/ dā na shī la/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ rgyu 'gul paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen legs 'byung*/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 39 sbyor drug gi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ chos longs sprul gsum/ chos rgyal so lnga/ dus zhabs pa gnyis/ zla ba mgon po/ sgom pa dkon mchog drung*/ sgro ston pa/ yu mo rje/ dharme shwa ra/ jo 'bum/ nam mkha' 'od/ se mo che ba/ 'jam gsar ba/ chos sku 'od/ thugs rje brtson 'grus/ rgyal ba ye shes/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ dol bu pa/ phyogs rgyal ba/ nya dbon pa/ grub chen kun blo/ 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang*/ nam mkha' chos skyong*/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na thugs rje brtson 'grus nas/ sron pa kun dga' rgyal po/ sron pa chos dpal bzang po/ bla ma dam pa/ grub chen bsod seng*/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ shāka mchog pa/ spyang lung chos grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 40 man lung gu ru'i dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ chos rgyal rigs ldan/ rigs gsum mgon po/ man lung gu ru/ yar klungs pa grags rgyan/ snye mdo kun don/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng*/ hūm̐ chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ hūm̐ rgyal lhun grub rin chen/ ri sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'chi med grub pa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ mkhas pa rin chen chos dbang*/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 'di la rdzogs chen dang bsres pa'i dbye 'byed dka' ba rjes su lo chen gyi slob ma zhig las sgro 'dogs chod tshul snang ngo*/ 41 /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ o rgyan pa rin dpal/

bsod nams 'od zer/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba/ nam mkha' seṅge/ 'khrul zhig chos rgyal/ mon rdzong ba zla ba rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rje/ spyang lung ba/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 42 lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa d+dū tī pa/ gha ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se/ zhang*/ gong ma lnga/ zhang ston khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal tshul pa/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ kun dga' dbang phyug glo bo legs 'byung*/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen/ go rams pa/ dkon mchog 'phel/ sangs rin/ gsum ga las lha mchog seṅge/ de nas grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ paṇa chen shāka mchog spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 43 bsam mi khyab kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ḍā ki ma/ rta mchog dpal/ bi na pa di/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ legs smin ka ra/ gun+dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi bzang po/ tog tse pa/ bhu ṣa ṇa pa/ dharma pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras brgyud pa dang po ltar ro// deng sang sa skya pa yongs grags la phyis su lam skor phal cher gyi nyams khrid rgyun chad par bzhed pas the tshom gyi gzhir snang*/ khungs btsun pa zhig yin na/ glo bo mkhan chen/ lha mchog seṅge/ spyang lung pa gsum la'ang lam skor tshang ma'i khrid gsan pa 'dra zhig grol mchog gi gsan yig tu 'dug pas de nas bsabs chog par snang yang dgos pa che bar ma mthong bas ma bris so/ 44 /mtsho skyes kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tsin+to bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ legs smin ka ra/ kah+ṇa pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras sor bzhag go 45 /lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/

bdag med ma/ ḍom+bi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras dang 'dra/ 46 gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras ltar ro/ 47 /yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lha dbang phyug chen po/ nag po u tsi ṭa/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra man lam 'bras dang 'dra/ 48 sems thag bcad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ zla grags/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras ltar ro/ 49 /phyag rgya lam khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze grub pa'i rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ dbu ma pa'i zhabs/ gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dzñā na bhū ti/ shrī yo gi bhū ti/ pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bi he ru ka yan lag med pa bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra/ in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ paṇa chen shes rab gsang ba/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras dang gcig 50 yi ge med pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang grags pa/ de wa a ka ra/ ā mo gha badz+ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra/ 51 mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ shān+ti pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ yab sras gsum/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ gzhon nu grub/ byang chub ye shes/ bla ma dam pa man lam 'bras ltar ro/ 52 /bar chad gsum sel las phyi gdon bgegs kyi bar chad sel ba'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ sher 'byung blo gros/ 'brog mi/ se rog gnyis/ gnyos yer/ sgom seng*/ grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag sgom pa/ lung phu ba man mdo rgyud bsre ba dang 'dra/
