53 nang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad sel ba'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang bdag rin chen rdo rje/ 'brog mi man gong ltar ro/ 54 /gsang ba ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad sel ba'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang bdag dzñā na shrī/ bla chen 'brog mi man 'dra/ 55 sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po man mdo rgyud bsre ba dang gcig 56 gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma shangs pa/ sa chen man mdo rgyud bsre ba ltar ro/ 57 /dag pa gsum zhabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas gong ma lnga yan lhan cig skyes grub ltar la/ de nas dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ rgyu 'gul paṇa chen/ glo bo legs 'byung*/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 58 rang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan dag pa gsum zhabs ltar la/ de nas tshogs sgom pa/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ rgyal 'bum pa/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal tshul ba/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 59 lam sbas bshad kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen man lam 'bras sor bzhag go 60 /brda don gsal ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bi rū pa/ sa chen/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba man mdo rgyud bsre ba dang 'dra/ 61 'gos kyi shog dril gsum po dpang du bzhag pa'i gsang 'dus rim lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ bi su kalpa/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu byang*/ zla grags/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ sa 'dres pa/ brtson 'grus bzang po/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ mang ra ba seng rgyan/ rngog ye seng*/ rngog nyi seng*/ rngog nyi lcam/

rngog 'phags lha/ 'phags pa skyabs/ gzhon nu 'od/ chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ shāka mchog mang mkhar rab gsal zla ba/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 62 'jam rdor gyi grol ba'i thig le'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ban+de pa/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ gong ma lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags chen pa/ gangs khrod pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ rgyal tshab pa/ rgyu 'gul pa/ brag dmar ba/ rab gsal zla ba/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 63 gshed dmar spros med kyi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ blo bzang snying po/ dar+paṇa ā tsār+ya/ glo bo lo tsā ba yab sras gnyis/ lo mchog pa/ glo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal pa/ grub pa shes rab/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ rwa ston pa/ kun dga' mchog ldan/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na glo bo yab sras nas/ blo gros dpal/ mchog ldan pa/ dpal ldan seṅge/ bu ston/ bla ma dam pa/ jo nang phyogs rgyal ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ sher rgyam pa/ rwa ston pa/ glo bo mkhan chen/ grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen/ mus chen/ go rams pa/ dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mchog seṅge/ grol mchog man 'dra/ brgyud pa phyi ma 'di gnyis khungs btsun par mngon/ 64 gshed dmar rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ ḍom+bi pa man spros med kyi brgyud pa dang po ltar ro/ 65 /skyo ba'i rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ la li ta/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ don yod rdo rje che chung*/ skyo 'od 'byung*/ skyo gcen 'dzom me/ gcung pad de/ skyo khams pa/ skyo rin chen brtan/ skyo 'od srungs/ gnyan ston chos rgyal/

'dzim pa rin chen shes rab/ thugs rje rin chen/ gdung brgyud rin chen rgyal mtshan/ cha gan pa/ grags chen pa/ gangs khrod pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang pa 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog man 'dra/ 66 bde mchog yab kyi rtsa dbu ma'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ grub chen sha ba ri/ slob dpon lū hi pa/ grub dbang dha ri ka pa/ rje btsun an+tar pa/ grub chen tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang ston khu dbon/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang 'dra'o/ 67 /yum gyi dbu ma'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen man yab kyi dbu ma bzhin no/ 68 /tshogs sgom pas sa paṇa las gsan nas bskyangs pas rgyu ba nges pa dang rnam pa gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa'i myong khrid gtsigs can lhad med kyi dril bu rim lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo/ nā ro/ pham mthing pa/ mal lo yab sras gsum/ sa paṇa/ bo dong brtson rdor/ khro phu ba/ yang rtse rin seng*/ gnyan mkhar ba bkra shis bzang po/ khyung lhas pa/ shar chen man bde mchog yab kyi dbu ma dang 'dra/ yang na phag mo/ kong ka byin/ a bha ya/ legs spyod/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ chag lo/ go lung pa/ shong rdor rgyan/ lo mchog pa/ dpang lo/ ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/

ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ rwa ston pa/ dpal tshul ba/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 69 mal lo/ pu rang lo chung*/ mal lo gsum ga la bka' babs pa'i bde mchog nag po rim bzhi mal lo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan dril bu rim lnga ltar la/ de nas 'phags pa/ zhang ston khu dbon/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen man yang dril bu pa'i brgyud pa dang po bzhin no// 'di gnyan cha che ba ni cog ros mar do la zhus dus byung ba yin 'dug mal phyogs la 'phros mi snang ngo*/ 70 /a bha ya/ jo bo rje/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra rnams kyis bshad tshul dang mi mthun yang rdo rje phag mos kha che paṇa chen la dngos su gnang ba'i bde mchog dkar po'i brgyud pa ni/ bde mchog phag mo/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs ye/ mkhan bsod grags/ grags pa tshul khrims/ bya sder ba byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ bsod nams dbang phyug drung btsun dpal rgyan/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 'di la kun mkhyen rong po thugs dgyes nas ngor du chos rje rdo rje 'chang la zhu bar byon pa'i zhu yig phul ba ngor gyi rten sgam na yod par snang ngo*/ 71 /shin tu dkon pas thams cad mkhyen pa bus khrid gsung dus dpon slob zhal ston phyogs nyi tshod tshun mi 'phyugs par gnang ba'i thugs gtsigs can rdo rje gdan bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma chu shing gi snye ma can/ mar pa/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ rngog tsha chos sku/ rngog dkon mchog dpal/ dran ston mtha' bral/ dran ston sher seng*/ man lung gu ru/ man lung kun mkhyen/ tshul khrims mgon po/ rngog byang chub dpal/ rngog bkra shis dpal grub/ rngog byang chub grags pa/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang*/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 72 'gro mgon 'phags pas bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum mkha' spyod du btang ba'i zab chos ma hā mā yā'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ ḍā ki ma/ ku ku ri pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga' gzi brjid/ rngog rin bzang*/ rngog chos rgyal/ rngog don grub dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal man gdan bzhi dang gcig 73 sngon chad bod du ma 'gyur ba glo bo sne tshe grum pa bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer gyis bal po ma hā bo dhi las gsan pa ngor chen gyis bstan rgyun la dgongs nas gu ge paṇa chen sogs gsum zhu bar btang ba'i bong bu'i phra thig gi nye brgyud ni/ bde mchog phag mo/ bal po skal ldan byang chub/ bal po 'tsho ba'i byang chub/ bal po ma hā bo dhi/ grub chen bsam gtan 'od zer/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo legs 'byung*/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 74 phag mo sgom drug dpyal kun dga' rdo rje'i lugs gtsor bton gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ lcam legs smin/ bi rū pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ ldong dar ba/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal ba byin/ bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas byin/ bal po ha ngu dkar po/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ dpyal kun dga' grags/ dpyal chos bzang*/ rong pa rgwa lo yab sras/ bag ston pa tshul rgyan/ dpal tshul ba/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ rgyu 'gul ba/ glo bo legs 'byung*/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 75 nā ro chos drug rje rang byung ba'i gser zhun ltar gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mid la/ dwags po/ dus mkhyen pa/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+shi/ gnyan ras/ rang byung rdo rje/ mgon po rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sog dbon pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ ban dkar ba/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ skyabs che ba/ tre bo chos rgyam/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 76 ni gu'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ni gu ma/ khyung po/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ras chen shangs dkar ba/

skung lung sangs rgyas dpal/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom pa/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 77 phyag chen ga'u ma/ 78 lam khyer rnam gsum/ 79 rang sems 'chi med rang grol/ 80 gsum gyi brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin no// su kha chos drug mkhyen rab chos rje'i phyag len ltar gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bi rū pa/ su kha sid+dhi/ khyung po/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ shangs ston pa/ rig pa'i rdo rje/ zhu ston tshul mgon/ chos dpal bzang po/ zhu ston tshul rgyan/ mkhyen rab rje/ gzhon nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ rje rdo ring pa/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 81 lte ba sprul 'khor zhes pa bdag med ma'i nang khrid khyung po'i yig rnying ltar gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ su kha sid+dhi/ ār+ya de wa/ khyung po rnal 'byor man ni gu dang 'dra/ 82 lhan cig skyes sbyor rgyal sras thogs med pa'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mid la/ dwags po pa/ phag mo grub pa/ gling ras/ rgya ras/ rgod tshang pa/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa/ sher 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ gnyan ras/ rgyal dbang rje/ ra lung pa ngag dbang chos rgyal/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 83 lnga ldan chos rje bla ma dam pa'i yi ge ltar gyi brgyud pa ni/ phag gru yan gong ltar las/ 'bri khung skyu ra/ dbon bsod grags/ gcung rdor grags/ thog kha ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa/ sman pa sgom chen/ lab phyi ba/ 'dul 'dzin ba/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen shāka mchog gzhon nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 84 phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa g.yag sde paṇa chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ tai lo nas phag gru'i bar 'dra ba las/ skyer sgom zhig po/ gzhon nu 'od/ chos sku 'od/ thugs rje brtson 'grus/

rgyal ba ye shes/ blo gros bzang po/ sman sgom pa man sngar ltar ro/ 85 /sku gsum ngo sprod rang byung rdo rje'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ ti phu pa/

'di gnyis dag snang du mjal na ma gtogs dngos su ma mjal ba 'dra/ karma pak+shi/ o rgyan pa rin chen dpal/ rje rang byung ba/ sngags 'chang g.yung ston/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ 'di gnyis sku skye gong 'og yin pas bar 'dir bla ma zhig 'chad dam/ mthong ba don ldan/ ban dkar 'jam bzang*/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa phrin las zhabs/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 86 rlung sems gnyis med spyan snga lha gzigs lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo/ nā ro pa nas/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i bar nā ro chos drug ltar las/ gu shrī kun blo/ yor pa ye dpal/ mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs pa/ skyabs che ba/ tre bo chos rgyam/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 87 chos dbang rin po che'i gter ma chos drug sras mkhar ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mar pa/ dar ma mdo sde/ slob dpon chen po dang rje 'bangs kyi dus kyi gter ma rnams gter ston gang yin de'i yang srid sngon ma'i dus smon lam dbang bskur/ bka' babs lung bstan/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya sogs kyi brgyud pa la brten smin grol rnams las 'phro gter brgyud 'phyugs med 'ong zhing*/ der ma zad gter ston rnams la o rgyan chen pos dngos nyams rmi lam du zhal ston zhing chos gsungs pa'ang yin 'dug chos drug 'di mar pa'i kha byang la brten chos dbang rin po ches bton pa tsam las smon lam dbang bskur sogs yod mdog ma kha bas chos rgyun yang the tshom gyi gzhir snang ngam snyam/ gu ru chos dbang*/ lha rin chen dbang rgyal/ ru mtshams sgom chen/ skyid phug pa/ 'ol sgom byang gling pa/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ gcung rin po che/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal/ bkra shis dpal grub/ byang chub dpal grub/ byang chub grags pa/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang*/

grol mchog man 'dra/ 88 rngog pa'i dgyes rdor rdzogs rim bsre 'pho'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ rngog chos rdor/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ kun dga' gzi brjid/ rin bzang*/ chos rgyal ba/ don grub dpal/ byang chub dpal man sras mkhar ma ltar ro/ 89 /mar pa'i snyan gyi shog dril rnam bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ḍā ki rus pa'i rgyan can/ pen+da ba/ mar pa/ tshur ston dbang nge*/ gnyags sgom dmar po/ dwags po'i mdud rtse nyi ma lung*/ mgar ras pa/ rog rtse lha sgang pa/ snye mdo kun don/ g.yung ston pa/ bsod bzang*/ tshul khrims mgon po/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gnyags phu ba/ seṅge dpal man sras mkhar chos drug bzhin no/ 90 /mid la'i zhal gdams ras chung snyan brgyud rnying ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mid la/ ras chung pa/ khyung tshang pa/ de las ltar sgom pa/ mar ston/ ma gcig ong jo gsum gyis gsan/ gsum gar zhang lo grub pa dpal/ de nas 'gro mgon dha ra shrī/ byang sems bsod rgyal ba/ kun ldan ras pa/ sras bde legs rin chen/ gzi brjid pa/ rin rgyam pa/ nyug pa chos grags/ byang bzang ba/ rab 'byor seṅge/ mkhan chen chos drug seṅge/ lo chen rat+na bha 'dra/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 91 ras chung pas rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i snyan brgyud bar ma lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung pa man snyan brgyud rnying ma dang gcig 92 zhang zab brgya'i brgyud pa ni/ sgom tshul/ khams pa rgwa lo/ ma la yer pa ba/ bai ro tsa na/ bzhi ga las bla ma zhang gis gsan/ de nas shākya ye shes/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ brgyud 'debs su dkyus ltar byung yang grol mchog gsan yig na go ldog snang ba brtag sangs rgyas snying po/ gser khang steng pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen/

shākya 'bum/ shāka bsod/ dbon po chos bzang*/ grags pa don grub/ bsod nams grub/ grags pa'i mtshan/ bla ma rtogs ldan/ lhun bde rab 'byams pa/ ra lung ngag dbang chos rgyal/ stag lung sprul sku ngag dbang rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 93 rgwa lo'i gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i brgyud pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ rtsa mi lo tsā ba/ a bha ya/ rgwa lo/ bla ma zhang*/ rob skam pa/ ras chen lhun grub/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba/ pha rgod 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ kun dar ras ma/ rngog grags pa dpal 'byor/ rin chen chos dar/ a mo gha sid+dhi/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 94 phag gru'i phyag bzhes phyag chen dang thabs lam chos drug tshigs bcad ma'i brgyud pa ni/ 'bri khung skyu ra yan lnga ldan ltar la/ spyan snga grags 'byung*/ spyan snga rin rdor/ spyan snga grags rgyam/ spyan snga rin rgyan/ spyan snga grags gzhon/ spyan snga bsod rgyan/ spyang lung gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shāka mchog gzhon nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 95 'bri khung dgongs gcig gi brgyud pa ni/ nyer brgyad pa yan lnga ldan ltar la/ de nas dharma rā dza/ sman sgom pa/ lab phyi ba/ 'dul 'dzin pa/ stag lung ngag grags/ 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal/ stag lung sprul sku/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 96 stag lung chos drug gi brgyud pa ni/ phag gru yan lnga ldan ltar la/ de nas stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ bkra shis bla ma/ sangs rgyas dpal/ rat+na ā ka ra gu ru/ kun spangs chen po/ bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rnam rgyal grags pa/ stag lung sprul sku/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 97 bar 'brug gi bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ ro snyoms gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ phag gru yan gong ltar la/ de nas gling ras/ yang na ti phu ba/ ras chung pa/ lo ston kun dga' dar/ sum pa seng dpal/ gling ras/

rgya ras/ yang na sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ dbon ras dar seng*/ chos rje gzhon seng*/ nyi ma seṅge/ seṅge shes rab/ spos skya ba seng rin/ bcu gsum pa seṅge rgyal po/ kun dga' seṅge/ rdo rje rin chen/ blo gros seṅge/ mkhyen brtse rtogs ldan/ 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rgyal dbang rje/ grub chen shāka 'phel/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ stag lung sprul sku/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 98 smad 'brug lo ras kyi thub pa lnga ldan gyi brgyud pa ni/ phag gru yan gong ltar la/ de nas gling ras/ rgya ras/ lo ras/ bde skyong*/ grwa dga' ldan pa/ dbon po bsod nams dar/ 'gir phu ba nges 'byung dar/ 'od zer rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ skyes mchog smon lam pa/ g.yam skyil blo gros chos rgyam/ ngag dbang chos rgyal man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ 99 /stod 'brug ri chos snying po drug gi brgyud pa ni/ rgya ras yan bshad ma thag pa ltar nas/ rin chen rnam bzhi/ mchan bur ko rgod pa 'bri zer ba 'dug pa yang dgon pa rang gis de dag las brgyud pa gsan yang brgyud pa gong ma gzhan nas 'dren pa las gtsang pa rgya ras nas thams cad 'dren thub par mi snang ngo*// yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba/ smon lam pa/ sle chung bsod nams dpal bzang*/ yar rgyab kun spangs chos 'khor sgang pa/ bsod nams rgyal mchog rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 100 phyag bzhi pa'i sku rags ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ rta dbyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rtsa mi lo tsā ba/ rgwa lo/ a seng*/ phag gru/ rgyal ba rin chen/ bla ma 'ol kha ba/ dge slong rin rgyal/ slob dpon rdor rin/ slob dpon mgon gzhon/ yar klungs pa seng rgyan/ bka' brgyud nang brgyud gcig yod dam snyam yang bar skabs nas chad pa'i grub mtha' gzhan nas gso dgos byung bar snang ngo*// 'jam dbyangs rgyal mchog bdag chen grags blo/

stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ sbas tshul khrims mchog grub/ stag lung sprul sku/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 101 gur gyi nang khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ lo chen/ brag steng pa/ mal lo/ sa chen/ yar sgom se po/ rgyal tsha lung mang*/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seng bzang*/ yar klung pa seng rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mchog bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ drung btsun dpal rgyan/ rje sangs rin/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas rdo ring rin po che/ grol mchog man 'dra/ grol mchog gi gsan yig tu bla ma dam pa nas bla chen kun rgyal ba yod pa'i gsang khrid kyi brgyud pa bgrangs 'dug mod/ nang khrid la ni nges par yar klungs pa rang dgos par mngon no/ 102 /bram ze chen po'i do pa skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bde ba'i mgon po/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ mnga' ris jo dan/ gro shul pa/ par spu ba/ gyer sgom zhig po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ brag 'bur ba/ ri pa gzhon rin/ dkon mchog rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ jo stan rje khol ba/ grub chen smon lam/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ shāka mchog a mo gha sid+dhi/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 103 grub thob chos drug gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub thob brgyad cu/ mkha' 'gro ko ka li/ mkha' 'gro dharma pa/ dpa' bo 'od gsal/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la/ grub thob tsha ba ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta mi 'jigs sbyin pa/ mi nyag lo tsā ba smon grub shes rab/ de sras rin chen/ rin chen bla ma/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ rgan mo lhas pa/ stag ston gzhon nu/ bag ston pa/ mkhan shes rdor/ gnyal pa bde legs/ 'phags mchog bsod dar/ dmar ston pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shāka bzang*/ gnyug la paṇa chen/ tre bo chos rgyam/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/

104 pad+ma lam rim gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang*/ longs sku rdor sems/ sprul sku pad 'byung*/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ nyang chen ye 'byung*/ zur shāka 'byung*/ zur chung*/ shāka bzang pa/ shāka seng*/ rtsad tsha shāka rdor/ gnyos nag rgyal mtshan/ 'ban rgya lu khams pa/ shākya pa/ sangs rgyas seṅge/ kun dga' rin chen/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog bzang po/ zur hwaṃ shāka 'byung*/ sras mchog shāka dpal/ rje btsun dpal bzang*/ zur hwaṃ bshes gnyen/ khams pa grags rgyan/ se ston chen po/ ras chen nam rgyan/ mnyam med bde legs/ kun dga' mchog grub/ grol mchog man 'dra/ 105 rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku srong btsan sgam po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ khri srong lde btsan/ grub thob dngos grub/ nyang ral/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ shākya bzang po/ lha rje dge 'bum/ lcam mo ye shes mchog chu sgom pa/ mtha' bzhi bya bral/ tshul chen bsod seng*/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chu rags pa blo rgyan/ 'phags mchog nor bzang*/ hor bka' bzhi pa/ bla ma dpal legs/ dka' bcu byang dpal/ 'phags pa blo rin/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 106 nor bu mthong grol gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub chen ya brgyad/ sa ra ha/ sha ba ri/ mi tra dzo ki o rgyan pa/ yum bzhi/ bram pa kun tu bzang po/ 'khrul zhig kun dar ras ma/ rngog grags pa dpal 'byor/ rngog nor bu rin chen/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/ 107 dung mtsho ras pa'i sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar mi sgom gsum/ skyes bu ye rdor/ dung mtsho ras pa/ sne phu ras pa/ 'gro mgon chos dbyings dbang phyug mgar ljong mgon rgyan/ mkhyen rab rje/ gzhon nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog man 'dra/

108 khrid brgya'i mtshan tho/ lo rgyus spyi chings brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa'ang nos so// 'di la rgyal dbang lnga pas brgyud 'debs nas bla ma gzhan la kha 'phangs pa gsan yig na yod med ci rigs snang zhing rang lugs su zhal gyis 'ches ma thag tu de dang nang 'gal sogs kha yar 'dug pas rdzong chung pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang tshar chen la sogs pa'i sgros gtsang dpyad bzod du ma mngon yang chos rgya cher 'tshol ba'i dam pa'i rnam thar du yi rang mdzad 'dug go/ ༈ //kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas stong gi bstod pa bskal bzang rgyan phreng gi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ dge bshes 'on phug pa/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ rin chen dbang phyug mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang*/ khro phu ba rin chen 'bum/ ri khrod pa rgyal ba/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rje rat+na war+dha/ ngor chen lha mchog seṅge/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge/ thar pa rtse ba nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ de gnyis ka las ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ e waṃ pa kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshos chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku rim du mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs bklags pas chog pa mdo sde las btus pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/

sad na legs 'jing yon/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ khri skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ mnga' bdag bkra shis lde/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ mnga' bdag lha lde/ mnga' bdag 'od lde/ mnga' bdag rtse lde/ mnga' ris dgra bcom pa/ dge bshes zhu ldan sgrub khang pa'i gsan yig tu snar byang chub tshul khrims zhes pa zhig 'di'i tshab tu byung ba mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin min brtag shes rab grags/ ra sa chu las pa dar ma rgyal 'di la'ang zar zhes byung*/ mtshan/ dpal ldan gro mo che pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seṅge skyabs/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ spro lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ chos lung mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa bzang po dpal/ 'khus lo tsā ba 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ mkhan po seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bla ma grags pa seṅge/ chos rje rong po blo bzang ba/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag gi dbang po kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho nas/ bo dhi satwa chung ba/ rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/ jo bo rje a ti sha lha btsun byang chub 'od/ te se ba chen po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ kong po lo tsā ba/ dgra bcom pa rgyal mtshan/ gya pa dbang mdzes/ gya pa dpal mdzes/ yon tan dbang phyug shangs pa 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ 'khus lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan ye shes seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan dar po/

mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug stong rwa ba kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas seṅge/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mtshungs med

snar thang dpal gling ba/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub bam bsod nams dpal ldan/ kun mkhyen dpal chos/ de dbon rin chen mchog grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs thub pa'i ring lugs la dam pa'i chos dang chos ma yin pa'i rnam par dbye ba ma nub pa'i sgrib pa'i mun pas sbags pa bsal bar bya ba'i ched du lha bla ma khu dbon gyi lhag bsam gyi mthu dang sbyor byung gi brtson pa la brten/ 'phags pa'i yul nas mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar dpal mar me mdzad ces chos kyi sgron ma chen po nyid gdan drangs te kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa rin po che dbyar mtsho ltar ches cher 'phel bar mdzad pa'i ched du zab rgyas kyi chos rgya cher stsal ba rnams kyi nang nas zab pa las kyang ches zab pa gsang chos bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i skor la/ jo bo lha gcig dpal ldan a ti sha la bstod pa phun tshogs bhad+ga ma 'brom gyis mdzad pa/ jo bo'i bstod pa brgyad cu pa nag tsho lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ jo bo lha gcig dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam thar bla ma'i yon tan chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba jo bos rgyal srid spangs nas thar par gshegs pa'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma 'brom gyis mdzad pa/ jo bo gser gling du byon pa'i rnam thar dang*/ gser gling pa dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus te de thams cad kyang gser gling du chag phebs shing bla ma dang mjal ba'i tshul lags so'i mtha' can dpe tshan gnyis 'brom gyis mdzad zer ba/ jo bo'i rnam thar rgyas pa mchims kyis mdzad pa/ jo bo'i rnam thar lam yig chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'brom gyis rwa sgreng dpal gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ 'brom gyis logs su nan gyis btab pa glegs bam gyi bka' rgya chen mo/

bstan pa rin po che lha chos bdun ldan gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i mjug snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lha chos nyams len gyi man ngag thig le chen po'i dbyings su byang chub kyi sems gnyis spel ba zung 'jug nyi zla'i thig le zhes bya ba dbang chog dang khrid yig zung du 'jug pa/ 'brom ston gyis mdzad pa'i rang rgyud la bskul ma gdab pa dad pa'i ljon shing*/ thugs dam jo bo yab sras kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gter mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis dpal snar thang du mdzad pa/ glegs bam dngos kyi bzhugs tshul la/ pha 'dir pha chos bu chos zhes tha snyad gdags pa'i rgyu mtshan pha 'brom ston gyis zhus nas jo bos gsungs pa la pha chos dang*/ bu khu rngog gis zhus nas gsungs pa la bu chos zhes grags pas so// chos nor bu'i phreng ba'i rtsa ba byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba/ pha chos le'u nyi shu rtsa drug las zhu lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum dang*/ ka bas dbu mdzad pa'i mkhas btsun mang po dang yon bdag shāka mgon la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs du ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su lha chos bdun ldan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba las 'phros nas nan gyi sgo nas chos 'di bka' rgya du mas gdab pa'i le'u/ lha ri snying po'i mgul du bla ma la 'bul mo che mdzad pa las 'phros nas ma 'ongs lung bstan pa'i skor/ shing pho rta'i lo lha ri snying por bzhugs pa'i tshe sgrol mas snye thang du 'byon par bskul nas mthar bla ma dga' ldan du 'byon pa'i bar gyi tshul rnams mgur du bzhes pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu ste kun dril bas pha chos le'u nyi shu rtsa drug bu chos skor la/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis zhus pa'i rngog chos nyi shu/

khu chen pos zhus pa'i khu chos gnyis te dril bas nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam thor bu rnams lo tsā ba la sogs pa'i rje'i sras dam pa rnams kyis zur du glengs pas kha bskang ba ste le'u tha ma/ de ltar glegs bam dngos gzhi le'u bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ gang gi lo rgyus/ bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gter/ thig le bcu drug bka' rgya/ rang rgyud la bskul gdab pa rnams kyi steng du/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen des dkon mchog gi spyan sngar thun mong ba'i mchod pa re bshams nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab yan lag bdun ldan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bshes gnyen gsang phu ba jo bo yab sras kyi drung du 'byon par bskul ba'i lo rgyus kyi tshoms tshigs bcad ma kha bskangs pa dang bcas kun dril bas yig sna lnga bcu rtsa drug rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgya chen spyod rgyud/ zab mo lta rgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa gsum ni yongs grags ltar yin la/ brgyud gsum chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa jo bo rje dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen gsang phu ba rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ byang chub sems dpa' mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor ka ma ba 'brom rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston dar ma rgyal mtshan/ stabs ka ba 'brom byang chub bzang po/ ston pa nam mkha' rin chen/ snar thang pa 'brom gzhon nu blo gros/ snar thang mkhan po nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dga' lung pa rin chen byang chub/ gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du gling kha zhes snang*/ dga' lung pa rigs kyi bdag po'i dpal/ dga' lung pa byang chub dpal/ nyug pa'i slob dpon bsod nams 'od zer/ gos sngon chu ser ba sangs rgyas bzang po/ bya bral ba bsod nams bzang po/ thar rtse ba'i gsan thor 'di gnyis go ldog tu 'dug pa brtag

bla ma dpal ldan pa/ stag tshang chos 'khor ba mkhan chen nam mkha' 'od zer/ pa tshab dga' gdong pa/ gnas brtan ye shes tshul khrims/ nub chos lung pa mkhan chen rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang 'chi med kyang zer/ dwags po phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mnga' ris pa mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rje byams pa phun tshogs/ 'dren pa dpal 'byor shes rab/ rin po che dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar chen ye shes bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan yin nam/ de nas mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa nas/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ rje nam mkha' dbang phyug chos rje kun dga' legs grub/ lum pa kun dga' chos grags/ bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ de dbon mkhyen rab ngag dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na mnga' ris pa lha dbang blo gros nas/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ khams ston dga' ba shes rab/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dpal ldan pa nas/ gtsang pa blo bzang grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man 'dra/ yang na rje byams pa phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med dpal 'byor shes rab/ sgrub khang dpal don man 'dra'o// ༈ //skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi man ngag brgya rtsar grags pa la/ thog mar sems nyid ngal gso'i brgyud 'debs/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha can gyis ri bo po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus phar phyin drug gi nyams len/

skyes bu bzhi'i nyams len/ rten 'brel thabs bzhi'i man ngag stong nyid snying rje'i man ngag zhol spong bzhi'i man ngag sku bzhi ngo sprod mkhas pa bzhi'i rtsa rgya gzhung*/ tshig de'i 'grel pa/ de'i man ngag mdor bsdus/ 'bum skyabs la spring ba'i chos bco brgyad/ thabs mkhas bzhi'i man ngag kha sar+pā ṇi'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ smin grol gyi zhal gdams/ 'da' kha ye shes kyi 'chi kha che paṇa chen gyi/ kha'i man ngag bla med theg pa'i man ngag bco lnga/ thabs mkhas bzhi'i man ngag bzhi tshan bzhi'i man ngag bla ma bzhi'i man ngag rdo rje gsum gyi ngo sprod/ grub pa'i bcud len gyi man ngag gnad kyi 'pho ba/ 'chi kha'i gdams pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ bdud rtsi thig le'i gdams pa/ stong nyid dgu phrugs pa/ skyid sdug lam khyer gyi gdams ngag snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ gnad kyi gzer drug gi gdams pa khyad par can/ chab gtor bsdus pa bya tshul/ sgrol ma la brten pa'i 'chi kha'i gdams pa kha che paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung khro los bsgyur ba/ zhi byed drug pa dkar po dang blud kyi sgrib sbyong ba'i man ngag thugs rje chen po la brten pa/ rang la bskul ba 'ga' zhig chu shul 'pho ba lung du sbyar ba/ gnad kyi ngo sprod gsum pa bdud rtsi'i lta ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i nying khu lta bu'i man ngag dgu pa/ yang zhal gdams 'ga' zhig mtha' bzhi mdud 'grol gyi man ngag mdo khams dga' ston tshul khrims grags la gdams pa/ 'chi kha'i gdams pa/ yang 'chi kha'i gdams pa sgrol ma la brten pa gcig yang 'chi kha'i gdams pa'i gnad/ yang de'i man ngag rgyas 'debs gsum/ rang sems ngo sprod kyi gdams pa/ yang rang sems ngo sprod gcig skyid sdug lam khyer/ de gsum gyi bsdus rin po che'i 'bras bu lta bu'i nyams len/ don/ thugs rje chen po la brten pa'i klu'i gdon 'grol/ ngo sprod gsum gyi zhal gdams/ sgrol ma la brten nas rten mngon shes su 'char ba'i gdams pa/

bdud rtsi bum pa'i man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rje btsun ma u rgyan la zhal gdams/ mchog gi gdams pa rnam gsum/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gdams pa/ gnubs lo tsā ba'i skyel ma ring po/ tshe 'dir sgom pa'i ngo sprod gnad gsum pa/ rin ce 'bru gsum gyi man ngag phan med bcu gnyis pa'i zhal gdams/ tshang bcu gnyis pa'i zhal gdams/ man ngag gnad kyi lde mig de'i don 'grel sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi gdams pa 'bring po/ snying po don gyi ngo sprod gsum pa/ gnad drug gi 'pho ba'i gdams pa/ 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar yod pa'i 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa khro los bsgyur ba/ de'i 'grel pa khro los mdzad pa/ mi tra dzo ki brgyud bcas la bstod khro los/ pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i sems rnam par sbyong ba'i lam 'bras zhes pa bud+dhā shrīs mdzad pa khro los bsgyur ba/ de'i 'grel pa khro los mdzad pa/ bud+dhā shrī brgyud pa dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ khro los/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces pa kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa khro los bsgyur ba/ de'i 'grel pa khro los mdzad pa/ kha che paṇa chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bstod pa khro los mdzad pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i grub pa nges bstan gyi rtsa ba/ snying gtam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi rtsa ba/ de'i 'grel pa shin tu zab pa/ snying po don gsum gyi rtsa tshig de'i bsdus don/ de'i don 'grel shin tu rgyas pa/ lta bsgom spyod pa'i mgur/ yang de'i mgur/ yang sems la gros 'debs kyi mgur shin tu gces pa'i man ngag dwags po rin po che'i zhal gdams/ rje sangs rgyas kyi zhal ngo blta 'dod na zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams/ yid smon bya ba'i man ngag phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad bsrung thabs/ kha sar+pā ṇi'i snying gi mun sel gyi man ngag khro los la stod kyi lcim lung du bkod pa/

chos spyi'i lung nod pa'i man ngag zab mo/ gtum mo'i gdams pa zab mo/ 'bral med bzhi'i man ngag thugs rje chen po'i man ngag mkhan po 'dzad phu ba la gnang ba'i mtha' can/ chos spyod yan lag brgyad pa dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bkod pa/ mdo chen bdun gyi man ngag bi ma la shrī dang khro los bsgyur ba/ chos spyi'i gsung rang grol gyi man ngag dge rtsa gsum gyi man ngag bogs 'don gsum gyi man ngag zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa/ bar chad sel thabs/ blo las 'das na zhes pa 'gor yod pa'i a cang che'i zhal gdams phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi 'don thabs/ shākya shrī'i man ngag sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub tu grags pa/ sgrol ma'i lam gyi rim pa/ man ngag rin chen 'bru dgu'i zhal gdams/ yang zhal gdams tshigs bcad ma/ 'gor sgyu lus kyi chu bur zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams rigs kyi bu bdun ma/ gces pa drug gi zhal gdams/ 'gor nam yang myur du zhes yod pa'i zhu ba drug gi zhal gdams/ 'gor 'chi ba 'di la zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams lcags kyi brag dmar du bkod pa/ 'gor rang lus 'di la zhes yod pa'i ngo sprod gsum pa/ 'gor sngon chad ces yod pa'i zhal gdams gsung sgros tshig bskul ma chu shul 'pho ba lung du bkod pa/ bskul 'debs brgyad pa/ dpe don ma'i zhal gdams chu shul 'pho ba lung du bkod pa mnyam med chos rje'i gsung*/ 'gor dngos po'i zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams chos rje'i gsung rgyun/ 'gor rje btsun sku drin can zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams chu shul 'pho ba lung du bkod pa/ yang mnyam med lo tsā ba'i zhal gdams/ bdud rtsi thigs pa'i zhal gdams/ mchog gi gdams pa gsum gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa/ zung 'jug bzhi'i rtsa ba/ de'i man ngag nyams grib sel ba'i man ngag rang rdo rjer bskyed pa/ shes phyin 'don pa'i man ngag zab mo bla ma paṇa chen gyi zhal gdams/ rdo rje gug skyed kyi gdams pa mi tra'i gsung khro los bsgyur ba/

bla ma paṇa chen gyi man ngag thor bu/ nad gdon lam khyer gyi man ngag g.yung drung ye shes la skyes su bskur ba mjug tu tshigs bcad gcig yod pa/ nying khu lta bu'i man ngag rtsa ba/ de'i rgyas bshad gnad kyi lde mig 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos zhes pa niṣ+ka laṅkas mdzad pa lo chung shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bud+dhā shrī'i man ngag tshang bsrung ba'i man ngag de'i bsdus don/ ye shes g.yung drung la spring pa/ mi tra dzo ki'i man ngag 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i mi tra'i gdams pa i thi'i mtha' can/ sbyin bdag rgyal mo la gdams pa/ jo bo kha sar+pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs/ 'gor na mo gu ru zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams rdo rje tshig bzhi'i gdams pa/ tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa zab mo khyad par can/ 'gor brgyud rim dang bcas pa'i yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'gor bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes yod pa'i yan lag bdun pa/ 'gor na mo gu ru zhes yod pa'i 'chi blu gzhan la mi spel ba'i mtha' can/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i byams pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ner tis mdzad pa khro los bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i byams pa'i bstod pa khro los mdzad pa/ 'gor thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i yang snying gsung gi man ngag 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i rmi lam sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa khro los bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa mi tra'i

jo bo'i bka' bzhin mi tras mdzad pa/ spyan sngar khro los bsgyur ba/ rtogs brjod do ha sum cu pa'i rnam bshad khro los mdzad pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i phyag len khyad par gsum ldan bla ma lo tsā ba'i gsung bzhin khro los mdzad pa/ 'gor na mo gu ru zhes yod pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor shin tu zab pa bka' rgya can/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i rgyal po zla ba'i spring yig mi tras mdzad pa lo chung tshul khrims shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ lha sa'i jo bo la bstod pa khro los mdzad pa blo brid drug pa'i zhal gdams/ kha che paṇa chen gyi thugs dam dzam+bha la nag po'i chu sbyin sgrub thabs skad shan sbyar yod pa kha che paṇa chen gyi gdams pa khro los bsgyur ba 'gor sa brgyad dbang phyug ces yod pa'i bstod pa/ dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs kyi gnad sbas pa 'bum 'khyil du grags pa paṇa chen gyi gsung sgros khro los bkod pa/ gshin bsngo bya tshul/ rgya gar grub chen brgyad kyi gsol 'debs/ dzam+bha la nag po'i lo rgyus bla ma paṇa chen gyi gsung khro los bkod pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dzam nag gi sgrub thabs gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba sbas pa 'bum 'khyil paṇ+ḍi ta nor can gyis mdzad pa kha che gser gdugs can yang zer/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang khro los bsam yas su bsgyur ba/ de'i bsdus don khro los mdzad pa/ 'gor 'phags pa dzam+bha la zhes yod pa'i dzam nag sbas pa gsum 'khyil gyi lo rgyus shin tu ya mtshan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' rten/ grong khyer shing thag can gyi lo rgyus 'dul lung las btus pa/ dzam nag gi las tshogs gter bum la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ rta gzugs la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ thod pa la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ rig ma la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ dzam nag gi steng bzhengs thabs/ gzhan gyi ngag mnan thab/ dgra bo rengs pa'i man ngag rigs brgyud bcad pa/ dgra bo bskrad pa/ 'byung po 'dul ba/

klu'i gdon 'grol/ char 'bebs thabs/ nor bdag gnad la gzir ba'i thabs/ yi ge bcu pa'i phrin las la oṃ gyis dbang du sdud pa/ dzam gyis nor sgrub pa/ bhas 'jigs pa skyob pa/ la yis rkun po bsrung ba/ dza yis bu ster ba/ len gyis tshe bsring ba/ tra yis phyugs skyong ba/ ye yis skyed tshal rgyas pa/ swā yis dbang bskur ba/ hā yis nad zhi ba rnams kha che paṇ+ḍi ta'i gdams pa gzhan la ma gnang ba'i khyad chos khro los yi ger bkod pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dzam+bha la'i thun mong gi bstod pa/ skad shan sbyar yod pa'i khyad par gyi bstod pa/ phrin las nyi shu pa paṇ+ḍi ta nor can gyis mdzad pa kha che paṇ+ḍi ta dang khro los skyid grong du bsgyur ba/ 'gor 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yod pa'i bstod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i bstod pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ dzam+bha la'i/ bstod pa 'dod 'jo'i ba dzam+bha la'i/ mo tshigs bcad brgyad pa bla ma paṇa chen gyis zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa/ sems kyi bde ba bcu gsum pa'i zhal gdams bla ma paṇ+ḍi tas gro mo dur khrod phag ri sogs su gsungs pa'i zhal gdams kha thor ba sna tshogs khro lo byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ chu bo bzhi 'dor ba la gdams pa khro los mdzad pa/ mkhan chen rin po che'i zhal nas zhes yod pa'i shangs pa blo gros kyis sems la phan par gdams pa/ rin po che'i zhal nas zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams shangs pa blo gros grags kyis yi ger bris pa/ skad shan sbyar yod pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta zla bas byin gzhon nus mdzad pa bud+dha shrī dang khro los bsgyur ba/ de'i bsdus don khro los mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i sgo nas tshe bsring ba'i man ngag shin tu zab pa/ mjug tu ltas ngan g.yang len gyi gdams pa dang bcas pa zab po'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo tā ra zhes yod pa'i lho brag gtam shul du byon pa'i tshe slob ma rnams cung zad 'khrug pa'i tshe rje btsun ma la smre sngags kyi sgo nas 'bod pa/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor shākya shrī'i gdams pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang zhes pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma dang bcas pa khro los mdzad pa/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa'i bstod pa khro los mdzad pa zhus dag pa'i mtha' can/ mjug tu zhal shes phran bu/ gsang 'dus dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs khro los bsgyur ba/ skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs dus zhabs pas mdzad pa bud+dha shrī dang khro los bsgyur ba/ 'gor dkon mchog gsum la zhes yod pa'i smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi cho ga paṇa chen gyi gsung rgyun rgyas bsdus 'tsham par khro los bkod pa sems bskyed kyi brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ dzam+bha la nag po'i chu sbyin pa'i man ngag dzam+bha la'i chu sbyin gyi lo rgyus smon lam rin chen sil ma/ de'i bsdus don/ smon lam sil ma tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa rnams khro los mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma'i sgo nas dbul ba sel ba lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ de'i sngags bzla thabs dang bcas pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī dang khro los bsgyur ba/ skad shan sbyar yod pa'i nor 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ oṃ dzam+bha la zhes yod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzungs/ paṇa chen gsung bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad zab mo/ khro lo chen po'i gsung mgur 'chi dus ma rang la gdams pa/ yang bla ma rin po che zhes yod pa'i mgur ma blo bde bzhi ma/ na mo gu ru zhes yod pa'i re skyid ma'i mgur ma/ na mo gu ru zhes yod pa'i ser ba bsrung ba'i man ngag shin tu zab pa hūm̐ dmar ma khro lo'i phyag bzhes ma/ rang la gros 'debs sh+lau ka gcig rje btsun sku drin can la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i rang la gros 'debs i thi'i mtha' can/ 'chi ba sems kyi zhes yod pa'i rang la gros 'debs me long bdun pa rnams te chos tshan de rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

khro phu lo tsā ba/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seṅge/ dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ byang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje grol mchog rje karma bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shākya bstan 'dzin/ mkhas dbang shākya nor bu/ sde snod 'dzin pa kun dag legs pa/ lo chen bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ rgyal sras rgyal mtshan bzang po/ smra dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ don grub chos gling pa bstan pa rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //rnam 'dren bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpag yas rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang mi gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che rnams kyi lung gi tshogs legs par nos pa la/ ngor rdzong gong dkar ba gsum la chos tshan gyi grangs la mang nyung dang go rim cung zad mi mthun pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig mchis par/ 'dir rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos glo bo smon thang gi rgyal por dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma yab sras gsum gyi gsung rab rnams rin po che sū war+ṇa las grub par bzheng bcug skabs mdzad pa'i dkar chag gi sgrig rim dang mthun par rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i dkar chag ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar pa byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje pa rnams kyi gsan yig la gzhi byas nas gsung rab chos tshan gyi ngos 'dzin zhib tu dpyad nas 'god pa la lnga ste/ dang por bstan pa'i bdag po chos kyi rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brtse ba chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sa skya pa kun dga' snying po'i gsung rab rin po che'i tshogs rnams lung du mnos pa'i rnam grangs la/

dpal ldan bi rū pa (9)(24) la bstod pa 'dir khyed kyi gzi yis rtog pa kun bral te/ zhes sogs dang mngon sum du bstod pa'i tshig nyams kyi shugs kyis byung ba zhes pa'i tshig gi zhal gzigs ma yin par gsal lo/ /lhan skyes spros bral ma/ zhang ston la don gyis byin rlabs stsal ba'i bstod (9)(24) pa yon tan mchog mnga' ma/ rgyud (9)(24) sde spyi'i rnam gzhag chung ngu 'gor/ bla ma rin chen lta bu dang*/ zhes dang*/ cha shas kyi bshad pa'i rgyud sam+pu ṭa yin no'i mtha' can/ brtag gnyis kyi sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi rgyud ces bya ba dang*/ mjug tu bdag gis mi shes blo dman phyir// rgyud don ji bzhin ma rtogs pas// zhes sogs dang*/ brtag gnyis kyi bsdus don rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ kye'i rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud (9)(24) brtag pa gnyis pa'i tshigs 'grel bla ma mnga' ris pas mdzad pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa mkha' ltar zhes pa dang*/ mi phyed phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur shog gi mtha' can/ sgyi chu bas (9)(24) mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis kyi dka' 'grel 'gor/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// kye yi rdo rje rnal 'byor che// zhes pa dang man ngag don gsal zhes bya ba rmongs pas rtogs sla ba'i don du bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na sgyi chu ba'i dka' 'grel dang ṭīka chung man (9) ngag don gsal zhes so sor gsungs pa ltar 'dug kyang gcig yin par 'di nyid kyi mjug na gsal/ 'on kyang 'og sa chen nyid kyis mdzad pa 'di gsan yig rnams na mi snang bas dpyad/ brtag gnyis kyi dka' 'grel 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros mtshungs med 'jig rten kun gyi mig

/ces bya ba dang*/ yang dag rdo rje sems dpa' 'thob ces dang*/ kye'i rdo rje'i dka' 'grel bla ma sa chen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can dang rtsa bshad kyi rgyud du 'jog tshul 'thor bu 'ga' re dang bcas pa/ rdo rje gur (9)(24) gyi tho yig 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud la 'bum tsho lnga byung ba ni zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par// zhes pa la sogs pas bstan to sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ gur gyi (9)(24) bshad pa'i chings 'gor/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// de la thog mar zhes pa dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam bstan pa'o rdzogs pa'i mtha' can/ gur rigs bsdus kyi rig pa'i dbang gi bshad pa 'gor 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa la bzhi ste zhes pa dang des lus rtag pa ste rnam snang du 'gyur i thi'i mtha' can/ gur gyi rgyud kyi dka' (9)(24) gnas bshad pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// le'u dang po 'khor gyi lha mo'i zhes pa dang lhag ma go sla'o'i mtha' can/ mchog sgrub pa'i dang las rgyas pa'i lha'i grangs 'gor 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur 'dis zhes pa dang gong du bstan pa'i gsal bar ston to'i mtha' can/ rdo rje glu'i bshad (9)(24) pa 'gor rdo rje glu'i bshad pa la don gsum ste zhes pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su rtogs par byas shing goms par byas pa'o'i mtha' can/ rtsa'i mngon (9)(24) rtogs 'gor rtsa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i don bstan pa las zhes pa dang de ni byang sems la brtsis pas phra ba'o// sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ rdo rje snying 'grel snga (9)(24) 'gyur gyi yig sna 'gor/ 'jig rten spyod pa zhes pa na mar zhes pa dang khyab byed ces bya ste ma lus so// sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ gur gyi (9)(24) rgyud kyi zin bris 'gor le'u dang por rgyal ba rigs lnga zhes pa dang dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la ji ltar gus par bya ba bstan to// sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/

'di la gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por le 'grel zhes gsung*/ sam+pu ṭa'i rgyud kyi dka' (9)(24) 'grel 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal yang dag par sbyor ba zhes pa dang dka' ba'i gnas rnams bsdus pas nongs par gyur na bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ kha rgya mtshor rdzogs rim gyi man ngag gsung*/ sbyor thig le'i don 'byung (9)(24) ba 'gor dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud chen po las kha sbyor thig le'i don zhes pa dang nyams su blang ba'i man ngag sngar bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// yang spyir rang byin gyis brlab pa la zhes pa dang gang rung 'ong gsung i thi'i mtha' can cig sam+pu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma'i rnam par (9)(24) bshad pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// brtag pa bcu gcig pa rgyud phyi ma'i zhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bka' chad mi stsal bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can/ kha sbyor phyi ma'i brtag pa (9)(24) bcu'i don bshad 'gor/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// de la yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud phyi mas bcu pa'i don zhes pa dang*/ brtag pa gsum pa dngos su mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa rtogs par bya'o'i mtha' can/ bsdus pa'i dkyil (9)(24) 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i rtogs pa zhes pa dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi sgrub thabs kyang 'di nyid kyis shes par bya ba kho na yin no'i mtha' can/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por sam+pu+u ṭa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i tho yig gsungs pa 'di yin nam dpyad/ bde mchog nag po pa'i lo rgyus (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon brtul zhugs spyod pa zhes pa dang gzhung drug po de dag gi gseb chags nas bton pa yin gsung ngo'i mtha' can/

gzhung drug spyi'i rnam (9)(24) gzhag 'gor slob dpon nag po pa'i gzhung 'di zhes pa dang*/ brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'o'i mtha' can/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i zhes pa dang*/ spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o i thi'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor slob dpon nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i zhes pa dang*/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra'o i thi'i mtha' can/ sbyin sreg sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i zhes pa dang*/ phur bu dbyung ba la sogs pa mjug gi cho ga bstan pa'o i thi'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal

(9) ba'i sa bcad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad spyi bos len/ slob dpon spyod pa bas zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba'i 'grel pa i thi'i mtha' can/ o la (9)(24) pa ti'i sa bcad 'gor na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ o la pa ti zhes pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis la sogs pa'o i thi'i mtha' can/ dpyid kyi thig le'i sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor dpyid kyi thig le la don gsum ste zhes pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang ba'i rim pa'o rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil (9)(24) chog 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// nag po cho ga la brten nas// zhes pa dang*/ bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs so gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ mngon rtogs kyi ṭīka gsal byed kyang gsung*/ chung (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di zhes pa dang*/ nag po mngon rtogs kyi ti pa na i thi'i mtha' can/ sbyin sreg gi ṭī ka (9)(24) 'gor shrī wāṃ gu ru bha drā ya na maḥ dngos grub ma grub pa grub par byed ces pa dang*/ tshig gi don rnams ni gzhung nyid nas gsal lo sbyin sreg sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ sbyin sreg gi (9)(24) lag len 'gor kṛṣ+ṇa ā tsār+yas mdzad pa'i zhes pa dang*/ 'di ni la ma ka la sogs pa'i spyod yul yin gsung ngo i thi'i mtha' can/ ro sreg gi cho ga (9)(24) 'gor bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa pa'i zhes pa dang*/ gzhan dag gi ni bsreg rdzas dang yon bdag tu bya ba'i lugs kyang bzhed de brgyud pa 'dis mi bzhed do'i mtha' can/ gsang (9)(24) ba'i kho na nyid kyi ṭī ka 'gor/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba'i gsal byed rdzogs pa'i mtha' can/

de'i tshig don bsdus (9)(24) pa'i go 'byed 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang ba'i de kho na nyid ces pa dang*/ tshig don gnyis bsdus pa'i go 'byed cung zad tsam bstan pa'o rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ yang de'i don gyi cha bla ma'i gsung gnang ba bris pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang*// zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi don gyi cha tsam bla ma'i gsung dang gzhung na snang ba bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ o la pa ti'i rnam (9)(24) bshad 'gor na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa lā ya/ rje btsun bla ma zhes pa dang o la pa ti'i rnam par bshad pa i thi/ yang de'i man (9)(24) ngag 'gor/ dbyu gu gcig la sum brgya zhes pa dang*/ o la pa ti'i man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ dpyid thig gi ṭī ka (9)(24) 'gor na mo gu ru bh+yaḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa lā ya/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dgongs pas zhes pa dang*/ dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba'i rnam 'grel i thi'i mtha' can te de rnams la nag po gzhung drug gi man ngag nag 'bum du grags so// de rnams la gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gzhung drug gi tho yig ces sbas pa tsam las ma gsungs/ rim pa bzhi'i gdams ngag 'gor/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa gsum na mtshungs pa med pa'i zhes pa dang*/ mang ba dang nyung ba khegs gsung ngo i thi'i mtha' can/ yang de'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa sogs man ngag thor bu ba 'ga' re/ 'jigs byed rtog (9)(24) bdun gyi ṭī ka 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal khri drug stong yod pa'i le'u drug pa zhes pa dang*/ bsad pa'i las su sbyar ba yin sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ sgrol ma (9)(24) lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil mchog 'gor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes pa dang*/

dbang gi cho ga'i tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas bstan pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag gces pa (9)(24) btus pa rin po che'i phreng ba bir+wa pa'i sgrub thabs sogs nas mdzes ma rgyan 'khor gyi bar man ngag gi rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug lhag tsam phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i gdams pa rnams so// 'di rnams grub pa'i slob dpon du ma'i man ngag dang rje btsun chen po'i phyag len gces btus dang sa paṇa gyi lam sbas bshad sogs nas kyang blangs pa'i slob brgyud cig gis phyis su bsgrigs pa'i lung rgyun mkhan chen sher rdor bas gsan pa 'dir bcug par mngon/ 'di nang gi chos tshan mang po'i brgyud pa lam 'bras kyi cha lag glegs bam rnams dang yang gcig go /gur las gsungs pa'i khro bcu'i srung (9)(24) 'khor 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i uṣ+ṇī ṣa zhes pa dang bla ma'i man ngag gis bsdebs pa yin no// khro bo bcu'i mngon par rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs so'i mtha' can dang*/ ma hā mā yā'i rgyud stong phrag bco brgyad pa las phyung ba bha ya (9)(24) nā sa'i srung 'khor 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bha ya nā sa 'di ni zhes pa dang rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal bya'o bsrung ba'i mchog go rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ skyu ra a (9)(24) skyabs la zhu yig 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan rin chen dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas// zhes yod pa dang*/ bum gter 'jug pa'i man (9)(24) ngag 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mchod rten nam gtsug lag khang zhes pa dang*/ tshul 'di bzhin shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ khyung khra'i man (9)(24) ngag bstod pa bcas pa'i 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lding bsgom par 'dod pa'i zhes pa dang*/

rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi bstod pa'o'i mtha' can/ dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub (9) skor tshigs bcad ma 'on kyang tshigs bcad ma 'di bla ma bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa 'dzim los 'gyur ba de ngos 'dzin dgos te/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa ni de'i 'grel pa tshig lhug pa bsnyen sgrub las tshogs dang bcas pa 'di yin pa'i shes byed ni/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad ma de la 'dir 'grel par byas pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa shin tu gsal bar bzhugs pas shes shing*/ da ltar dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo rgya gzhung bai ros mdzad pa dang*/ rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub skor las tshogs thor bur bcas pa dang*/ yar klungs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge rnams dang bcas pa thams cad kyi lung zur du mdzad pa na'ang bzhugs pas lung rgyun tshang bar yod do// 'di bka' 'bum gyi dpe snga ma 'gar bris 'dug pa ltar dang*/ de'i 'grel pa sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gor phyag 'tshal dang*/ dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi// gdams pa gzhung dang mi 'gal ba// zhes yod pa/ bdag gzhan bsrung ba'i bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyar ba rnams kyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa/ 'di la mos shing sgrub pa rnams// bar chad med par dngos grub kun// ci 'dod pa ni grub nas su// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i man ngag lag len sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ las tshogs dum bu la 'gor yul du rims nad byung ba la zhes dang des ni mi phyugs nad rnams khegs kyi mtha' can/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i yig chung*/ tsakra'i rab gnas/ bsrung ba'i man ngag rnams kyi yig chung re/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag 'gor/ dam tshig ldan pa'i gang zag gis zhes dang*/ mjug tu las sbyor ni las tshogs so so'i skabs bzhin shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ sku rten sba ba'i man ngag kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur ro// 'di ni rten gyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/

yang sku'i mdun du mchod gtor 'bul ba'i man ngag des dga' mgur 'du ba yin no'i mtha' can/ yang yab yum gyi sku sba ba'i man ngag rten gyi man ngag logs su bkol ba'o'i mtha' can/ bstod bskul dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni zhes dang bstod cing bskul ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rdzas dang sngags la brten nas smyo ba 'dul ba gzhan zhig 'drir bcug pas kyang 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ de'i las sbyor dam nyams bsgral ba'i las tshogs drag po'i las so'i mtha' can/ yang dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul dpal sa skya pa chen pos g.yu mkhar mo sgrol ma lha khang du bris so'i mtha' can rnams so// bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i ṭī ka (9)(24) mu tig phreng ba 'gor/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i ge sar rdul gyis sku byugs pa// zhes pa dang*/ ṭī ka mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'di bla chen mal dang rje sa chen gnyis char gyi slob ma rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyi slob dpon bla ma gnyan phul byung bas rje sa chen gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pas bka' 'bum dngos dang khyad par med cing gsan yig thams cad la'ang yod pas lung rgyun bzhugs/ slob dpon mtsho skyes (9)(24) kyi lo rgyus 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs o ḍe bi sha zhes dang*/ slad kyi sems can gyi don du sgrub thabs 'di brtsams so zhes dang*/ de ltar brgyud khungs so i thi'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi (9)(24) bsdus don 'gor/ dpal kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon pad+ma badz+ras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la zhes bya ba dang*/ brtsams pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan don du bsngo ba'o sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ mtsho skyes kyi mngon rtogs (9)(24) tshig gi bum pa 'gor/ bla ma rje btsun sgyi chu ba'i// zhes pa dang*/

des ni bla ma la gus shog sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa zhes pa dang mngon rtogs tshig gi bum pa zhes pa gnyis so sor bgrangs 'dug kyang rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtshor/ mtsho skyes kyi bshad pa tshigs bcad ma zhes 'di la ngos 'dzin mdzad 'dug pas phyi ma'i yi ge ma dag pa yin nam snyam/ kye rdo rje'i gdan gyi rnam (9)(24) dag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gtso bo'i gdan gyi tshangs pa zhes pa dang*/ spyi gtsug tu ni hūm̐ mdzad do'i mtha' can/ sngon byung gi rnam (9)(24) 'phrul 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha'i rnam pa'i skabs su zhes pa dang*/ sngon byung gi rnam 'phrul skabs bstan zin to'i mtha' can/ ḍom+bi pa'i de nyid bcu'i gsal (9)(24) byed 'gor/ bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ḍom+bi he ru ka'i zhes pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas gsungs pa yin no'i mtha' can/ kag chol gyi sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha// zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje rin po che'i myu gu zhes bya ba rdzogs so i thi'i mtha' can/ bde mchog rtsa brgyud kyi le 'grel (9)(24) 'gor/ nā ro chen po'i bzhed pa yis// zhes pa dang*/ deng sang blo ldan rnams kyis sbyong bar rigs/ sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi (9) bsdus don 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// nā ro chen po'i bzhed pas zhes pa dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bsdus don rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rtsa rgyud kyi (9)(24) dka' ba'i gnas kyi zin bris 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ la ghu sam+ba ra zhes pa dang*/ dka' ba rnams rang don du yi ge bkod pa'o// sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ nag po dkyil chog gi tho yig

(9) the tshom can du bzhed pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud/ ces pa dang nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tho yig tsam du sbyar ba'o rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams so// 'dir dpe ma rnyed pa lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bla (9)(24) ma la mchod pa brjod tshul gsungs pa gnyis lung ma thob// ༈ //gnyis pa grub pa'i slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhes yongs su grags pa'i slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung rab la/ rgyud (9)(24) sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po la (9)(24) bstod pa 'gor tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bu zhes yod pa/ brgyud pa dang bcas (9)(24) pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'gor/ gang thugs kun nas dga' ba'i dpal mnga' ba// zhes pa dang*/ de 'dra snying la 'dod nas 'di brtsams so sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ bshes gnyen rgya sgom (9)(24) tshul khrims grags la spring ba 'gor/ oṃ swa sti/ dpal sa skya'i dben gnas zhes pa dang*/ bya lo zla ba gsum pa la bris pa'i mtha' can/ slob dpon (9) cha ba'i bris sku 'di gsang phu na bzhugs pa'i thang sku las ngor chen gyis bshus nas bka' 'bum gyi bsdebs 'dir bzhugs su bcug pas lung rgyun yod med dpyad gzhir snang*/ la bstod pa 'gor brtse chen spros bral zhes dang*/ gsum bdun don bstod 'dir ni 'jug pa'i rigs kyi mtha' can/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i brgyud (9)(24) brtag pa gnyis pa'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer 'gor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ na maḥshrī he badz+rā ya/ gang gis spros pa'i zhes dang*/ bris las dge ba gang thob pas// 'gro rnams rgyud don rtogs par shog

/ces pa'i mtha' can gyi rgyud kyi bsdus don dang*/ 'gor bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// kye yi rdo rje la de bzhin// zhes dang rje btsun dam pas rgyud don gsungs nas lo bcu drug lon pa shing pho rta'i lo la mdzad pa'i mtha' can gyi rnam bshad chen po nyi ma'i 'od zer/ bzang po yongs gzung gi rab (9)(24) gnas kyi 'grel pa 'gor/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs legs par bsdu ba'i lugs kyis zhes yod pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi 'grel (9)(24) pa 'gor/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhes yod pa/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes (9) ṭī ka 'gor/ oṃ sid+dhi rastu/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la blo gros thugs rje gsal ldan pa zhes yod pa/ nas gling ma'i (9)(24) dkyil chog 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma gong ma nas dbang gi brgyud pa dang ldan zhes yod pa/ las dang po pa'i bya ba'i rim pa 'gor/ dpal ldan 'khrul pa kun bcom zhing*// zhes yod pa/ ḍom+bi (9)(24) lugs kyi dkyil mchog 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma yongs su smin par byed ces yod pa/ brtag gnyis kyi sa

(9)(24) bcad 'gor/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye rdo rje'i brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can zhes pa dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don to rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sam+pu ṭa'i brgyud kyi (9)(24) bsdus don 'gor/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud chen po la bsdus pa'i don lnga ste zhes yod pa slar yang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhus dag mdzad pa dang*/ sam+pu ṭa'i ṭī ka (9)(24) gnad kyi gsal byed 'gor na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ na maḥshrī he badz+rā ya/ gang gi thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa zhes yod pa/ sam+pu ṭa'i brtag (9) pa gnyis pa'i rab byed gnyis pa'i ṭī ka 'gor/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos kun yod med gnyis min gnyis ka'i mtha'// zhes yod pa/ chos la (9)(24) 'jug pa'i sgo 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhi rastu/ sna tshogs rab bkra dngos rnams de kho na// zhes yod pa/ yi ge'i (9)(24) bklag thabs byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa 'gor/ 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig thams cad mkhyen pa dang*// zhes yod pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa yan (9)(24) lag bzhi pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig thugs ni spros pa kun bral yang*// zhes yod pa/ dbang gi chu bo chen (9)24) mo 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gzhi zhes bya ba dang*/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa bskur ba'i lugs bla mas ji ltar phyag len mdzad pa bzhin bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ kye rdo rje'i rab gnas (9)(24) bzang drug 'gor/ dpal kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rab tu gnas par byed na zhes pa dang*/ dge bsnyen bsod nams rtse mos sbyar ba la dus phyis rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhus dag bgyis te legs par bsdebs pa'o// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

kye rdo rje'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa rdzogs nas zhes yod pa/ skabs 'dir dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yin na las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gsungs pa phyi mo rnams na gong gi bzang po yongs gzung gi sbyin sreg (9) gi 'grel pa de 'dug pa bzhin las gzhan ma rnyed/ bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig (9)(24) 'gor rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i rim gnyis bsgom zhes dang*/ ne tsho sbal ston la spring pa'i yi ge bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig dge'o'i mtha' can/ bde mchog dril bu (9) pa'i mngon rtogs 'gor sid+dhi rastu/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dngos kun de nyid sdom gcig pu// zhes yod pa/ de'i dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus kyi (9)(24) bshad pa 'gor sid+dhi rastu/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin mkha' 'dra spros pa'i 'ching kun bral// zhes yod pa/ bde mchog gi mchod phreng (9)(24) 'gor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ gtsug tor rnam (9)(24) rgyal gyi rtog pa'i ṭī ka 'gor/ na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ brtse bas lhag bsam brtan mdzad nas// zhes pa dang*/ dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa ni// legs par sdebs shig lung gnang bas// grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis ni// cung zad gsal bar bgyis pa lags// zhes pa'i mtha' can/ de'i sa bcad 'gor/ na mo gu ru we/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa la gnyis te zhes pa dang*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i bsdus don i thi'i mtha' can/ seṅge sgra'i (9)(24) sgrub skor gyi 'gor bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi thugs ni shin tu rnam dag cing*// zhes yod pa'i bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ srung 'khor/ bsdus don/ gdon 'grol dang bcas pa'i rje btsun seṅge sgra'i sgrub skor dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'di rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

don zhags kyi lo rgyus (9)(24) 'gor/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i lo rgyus ni zhes pa dang*/ de'i slob ma ba ri lo tsā ba la'o'i mtha' can/ don zhags kyi mdo'i sa bcad (9)(24) 'gor/ a mo gha pā sha na mo/ rgyud 'di la don gsum ste zhes pa dang lcags su gtor ma mi phyed pa'i rgyu mtshan no'i mtha' can/ lha lnga'i bstod pa (9) 'gor/ sems can sdug bsngal me tshogs kyis gdungs la// zhes pa dang*/ lha mo khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal bstod// lha lnga'i bstod pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ don zhags mdo'i rnam (9)(24) bshad rin chen phreng ba 'gor/ bla ma dang mgon po thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi thugs rjes 'gro ba yi// zhes yod pa/ gtor chen gyi lo rgyus dang cho ga (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i lo rgyus ni zhes pa dang*/ zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag go i thi'i mtha' can/ rdo rje gdan (9)(24) pa'i thugs dam chos drug 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rtog pa'i 'ching rnams bcad// ces pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam chos drug phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i brjed byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ phyi'i bar chad/ nang gi bar chad/ rims nad zhi ba/ dus min 'chi ba dang rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ tshe tshad las lhag par thub par byed pa/ las sgrib zad par byed pa rnams so/ mi g.yo sngon po'i sgrub (9)(24) skor 'gor/ bgegs rnams sreg pa'i gnyis med ye shes me 'od ces bya ba sogs yod pa/ zhar las rgya gzhung gi srung 'khor (9) dang bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rdo rje dang lo tsā ba nam mkha' rdo rjes bsgyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa (9)(24) la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa 'gor/

shākya seṅge la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs gtso bor phyogs bcur rab grags pa// zhes yod pa rnams so// ༈ //gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab la/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon (9)(24) shing 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang dbang gsung gi rin chen gter// zhes yod cing chos rje sa paṇa gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ stong thun sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dang dpal ldan bir+wa pa la phyag 'tshal dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi gsung gi don kye'i rdo rje zhes yod pa/ 'di'i phyi mo gong dkar ba'i par ma las bshus pas thun mong ba'i lam rim skabs kyi sa bcad bsdus tsam las med kyang 'di nyid yongs grags yin pa dang*/ slad nas sa paṇa gyis gzhung gnyis po'i zhus dag mdzad pa'i skabs cung zad bsdus pa yin nam snyam/ gzhan du sngon gyi dpe rnying rnams las spyi ljon gyi gzhung nas ji ltar 'byung ba'i sa bcad shin tu rgyas pa can mang po 'byung*/ lam 'bras (9)(24) brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'gor/ na mo gu ra we/ bla ma rdor 'dzin 'jam mgon spyan ras gzigs// zhes yod pa/ slob dpon rin po che la rnam thar dang mthun par bstod pa khyod nyi ma/ rje sa chen gyi (9)(24) rnam thar bsdus pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad kyi ston pa zhes yod pa/ bla ma bsten pa'i thabs sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa'i (9)(24) gsal byed/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs la gus pa yi// zhes yod pa/ byin rlabs tshar (9)(24) gsum khug pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ga ya dha ra bod du byon dus zhes yod pa dbang phyug 'od zer gyi ngor mdzad/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs

(9) bcad nyer brgyad pa 'gor/ dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal te// zhes yod pa bra ston blo gros kyi ngor mdzad/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i rnam par bshad pa ma dag pa rnams 'joms par byed pa'i rnam bshad (9)(24) dag ldan 'gor rje btsun bla ma rin po che dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po zhes yod pa/ rgyud sde'i dum (9)(24) bu 'gor/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// e waṃ ma yā shru ta me kasmin sa ma ye zhes yod pa 'di sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin yang snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris 'dug bla ma brgyud pa rgya bod kyi lo rgyus (9)(24) rnams so// dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dang gsan yig rgya mtsho na gsol 'debs che chung zhes 'dug kyang chung ba de'i phyi mo ma byung*/ rdo rje (9)(24) gur gyi rgyan zhes bya ba'i rnam 'grel 'gor/ na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ gang gi thugs ni lta ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal ba// zhes yod pa/ gur gyi bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la don gsum ste zhes yod pa/ gur gyi thig (9)(24) chog 'gor thig gi cho ga rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba rgya skad dang bod skad du byas pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po yan (9)(24) lag drug pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rin chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /zhes pa dang*/ mthar mngon rtogs kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bcas 'di la phyi mo 'ga' zhig tu sngar bshad pa'i 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab ces pa nas/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i rdzogs rim mdor bsdus pa'o zhes pa'i bar 'di dpe gcig las ma gtogs ma byung yang 'dir bris yod/ kye'i rdo rje (9)(24) dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las thun bzhi'i zhes yod pa/

'di'i mjug tu bra ston chos kyi grags pa la gnang ba'o zhes brgyud pa'i kha skong lhag po 'dug kyang dpe snga ma thams cad na 'di bzhin 'dug bdag med lha mo (9)(24) bco lnga'i mngon rtogs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag ni zhes yod pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i (9)(24) lag len gyi tho yig 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa/ tshogs (9)(24) 'khor 'bring po 'gor/ yon tan rin chen skyed byed spros bral ba'i// zhes yod pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhib tu (9)(24) bstan cing rnam gzhag mdor bstan 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// kye'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas zhes yod pa/ yang de'i (9)(24) las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus te rnam gzhag rgyas par brjod pa 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// da ni las bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus te rnam gzhag rgyas par brjod na zhes yod pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rnam par (9)(24) bshad pa 'khrul pa spong ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid don ston bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// zhes yod pa/ he ru ka'i chas (9)(24) drug gi bshad pa 'gor/ bla ma rje btsun thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun bla ma zhes yod pa/ rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng gi de kho na nyid (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i de kho na nyid ni zhes bya ba yod pa 'di dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na the tshom can du bzhed/ dga' ston rdo rje grags (9)(24) la spring ba 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/

dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa nas zhes yod pa/ rgyud 'bum gyi dkar (9)(24) chag 'gor na mo gu ru bud+dhā ya/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud la zhes pa dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dkar chag che rags lags so'i mtha' can/ bla ma gong ma'i chos skor gyi dkar (9)(24) chag 'gor mal gyo las 'ongs pa'i zhes yod pa/ kye rdo rje'i chos skor gyi (9)(24) dkar chag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brtag pa gnyis pa zhes yod pa/ rnal 'byor byang seng gi dri ba 'gor na mo gu ra we/ sa skya'i rje btsun chen po'i drung*// zhes pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan thugs la 'dogs par zhu'i mtha' can/ de'i dris (9)(24) lan 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gtsang la stod kyi grom pa sa skya'i dgon pa nas zhes yod pa/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed brgyud (9)(24) pa nyis ldan gyi cho ga 'gor/ rje btsun sa skya pa la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs 'gro thun mong ba tsam dbog par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen 'bar ba sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan la (9)(24) phan pa'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'das pa rnams kyi don bya bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i (9) bkra shis mtshungs med bla ma zhes pa/ kye'i rdo rje yab kyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍa (9) ka 'gor/ bdag gis thal mo spyir sbyar nas// zhes yod pa/ yum gyi bstod pa (9) dri ma med pa'i rgyan 'gor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi// zhes yod pa/ de'i bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor de la don gsum ste zhes dang*/ brtsams pa'i dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba'o'i mtha' can/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i bla ma (9)(24) brgyud pa'i lo rgyus 'gor/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bcom ldan 'das kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i zhes pa dang*/

rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gtam rgyud bla mas gsungs pa bzhin bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ bla ma mal la sa skya bla chen gyis zhes pa'i lo rgyus 'thor bu cig dpal he ru ka'i byung (9)(24) tshul rnam par gzhag pa bla ma'i gsung las cung zad btus pa 'gor/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal he ru ka'i byung tshul lam zhes yod pa/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi sa (9)(24) bcad 'khrugs can 'khrugs (9)(24) med dang sgrub thabs kyi sa bcad (9)(24) dang sbyin sreg gi sa bcad (9)(24) re re ste de bzhi ka'i 'gor/ oṃ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i zhes yod pa/ nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'grel pa (9)(24) 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rnams dang spros bral gzugs sku mkha' 'gro ma// zhes yod pa/ 'di dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig tu bshad sbyar gsungs pa 'di yin/ nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga lag
