(9)(24) tu blang ba'i rim pa 'gor/ he ru ka dpal bla chen gyi// zhes yod pa/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lo rgyus (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa 'di zhes yod pa/ dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs (9)(24) bskyed pa'i rim pa'i gzhung gsal bar byed pa 'gor/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyin byed 'jigs byed dus mtshan rab tu brdzis// zhes yod pa/ dril bu rim lnga'i gsal (9)(24) byed 'gor/ dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka dpal gyi// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig tu 'di gnyis ka la don 'grel gsung*/ tshes bcu la (9)(24) sogs pa'i dus kyi mchod pa'i yi ge 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshes bcu'i mchod pa ni zhes yod pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs (9)(24) pa sgom pa'i rim pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang dang*// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor mngon par rtogs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du phye ba zhes gsungs pa 'di yin/ phag mo zhal gnyis (9)(24) ma'i sgrub thabs 'gor/ bskal ba'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od ldan zhing*// zhes yod pa/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi byin (9)(24) rlabs zhes bya ba'i rdzogs rim 'gor/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// zhes yod pa/ phag mo las bcu'i gsal (9)(24) byed 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun bla ma dang*// zhes bya ba yod pa ste de gsum la mi dbang chos gsum du grags/ mai trī mkha' spyod kyi rgyud chung (9)(24) 'bum phrag gsum pa las byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen mo ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i rgyud las phyung ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na dang btsun pa sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/

sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis (9)(24) med rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ rjes gnang (9)(24) gi cho ga rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa la paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na dang sum pa lo tsā'i 'gyur/ 'di gsum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa dang mchan btab pa rnams rje btsun gyis mdzad pas 'dir bris par snang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs su ma ti dang pradzñā kīrtis bsgyur ba la sa chen gyis mchan btab pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub (9)(24) bsgrub pa dbu na'ang tshig de nyid yod cing*/ bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal gdams don bcu gcig ma 'gor/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan ras gzigs gsum la phyag 'tshal dang*/ bdud rtsi lta bu'i don byang chub sems dpas bkrol ba'o'i mtha' can/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge 'gor/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can zhes pa dang*/ gzhon nu ma la ston mo bya ba yang dam tshig go'i mtha' can/ tshogs kyi mchod pa 'gor/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na zhes pa dang*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o'i mtha' can/ yang tshes bcu'i mchod (9)(24) chung 'gor/ bla ma dam pa dang rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pas tshes bcu'i mchod pa zhes dang*/ nyams pa thams cad 'dag gsung gi mtha' can/ sbyin sreg (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas zhes pa dang*/ bdag nyid la bsdu'o'i mtha' can/ mar me'i sbyin sreg 'gor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg zhes pa dang*/ zhal gdams gzhan la phan pa'i blos bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ lam gyi yan lag pra se

(9)(24) na dbab pa 'gor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na zhes pa dang*/ pra se na dbab pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// don yod grub pa yi dam du byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag ces pa dang*/ bla ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i man ngag yig chung rdzogs so'i mtha'/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub thabs (9)(24) 'gor/ de nas gnod sbyin mo'i rtog pa bshad par bya ste zhes pa dang*/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag tu byas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag (9)(24) 'gor/ gnod sbyin mo'i bcud len dang zhes pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ khol po pa ti'i man ngag (9)(24) 'gor 'ong nges pa zhes pa dang*/ pra yats+tshadz+dza zhes brjod kyi mtha' can/ sman chen po'i bcud (9)(24) len 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lam gyi yan lag sman chen po'i bcud len ni zhes pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go i thi'i mtha' can/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po gong sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa man chad nas 'di bar la jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gsung ngag de'i man ngag 'thor bu rnams tshang ma zhes pa tsam las so sor ma gsungs kyang thams cad bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no// dbang gi las kyi man ngag 'gor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes pa nas zin bris chig brgyud du byas pa i thi'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i gnad lnga zhal shes dang bcas pa'i tho yig sogs man ngag 'thor bu shin tu gsang ba gal che i thi'i mtha' can te 'di rnams rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin yang phag mo skor gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris pa ltar gzhag go /rtsa (9)(24) dbu ma'i man ngag 'gor/

bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i zhes yod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul (9)(24) 'khor bri bsgom gyi man ngag 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun bla chen dang*// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor 'di la 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyang zer gsung*/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bshad (9)(24) thabs kyi man ngag (9)(24) bsdus don bcas 'gor/ bla ma rje btsun rin chen lta bu dang*// zhes yod pa/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi gsal byed (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spang bya'i dri ma ma lus kun spangs shing*// zhes yod pa/ (9)(24) ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs la don gnyis te zhes yod pa/ tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg zhal gdams dang bcas (9)(24) pa'i 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa 'di rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u zhes yod pa/ dgra nag gi sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ dri med rgyud don ston mdzad bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod (9)(24) pa 'gor/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /ces pa dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa i thi'i mtha' can/ yang de la bstod pa dpal (9)(24) rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos po kun gyi de nyid chos dbyings kun rtog bral// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na bstod pa gnyis yod med kyi nges pa ma mdzad kyang gsan yig rgya mtsho dang*/ dbang gi rgyal po gnyis ka nas gnyis kyi gsal ka byung bas gong mar mdzad byang med pa sogs la the tshom ma za zhig

phyi ma 'di rtse mo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa la/ slar yang rje btsun gyis kha skong mdzad pa gzhung tshig gis gsal lo// slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi brgyud pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'khrul 'khor las sbyor dang bcas pa'i 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i sgrub thabs dang bstod pa 'don thabs las kha tshar dang (9)(24) bcas 'gor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgrol ma zhi khro gnyis// zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang sgrol ma la// zhes pa dang*/ spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ so so'i sgrub thabs (9)(24) 'gor/ yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// spyi'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus kyi rnal 'byor zhes yod pa dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ bstod pa 'don (9)(24) thabs kyi brjed byang 'gor/ oṃ swa sti/ thun mtshams su phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa 'don par 'dod pas/ zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gong sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro nas 'di'i bar la sgrol ma'i chos skor gsungs pa tsam las ming so sor ma smos kyang yi ge nyung ba'i phyir du phyogs gcig bsdus nas gsungs pa yin pas lung bzhugs pa yin no// sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka dang (9)(24) sa bcad 'gor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por bla ma la btud nas// zhes yod pa dang*/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i las tshogs kyi bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ces yod pa/

dbang bskur ba'i sa bcad/ le'u bcu pa dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis te zhes pa dang*/ sa bcad do'i mtha' can/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'gor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes pa dang*/ dbang gi cho ga'i tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bstan pa dbang gi mngon rtogs 'di sa skya pa chen pos mdzad do// dgu pa dbang bskur ba'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ sgrol ma la lus dkyil gyi sgrub (9)((24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas rigs dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa zhes dang bshad na mtha' yas par 'gyur mod/ bod skad thad sor bsgyur mi btub lags/ mchan med pa rnams kyi thad sor de skad gsung bar zhu'i mtha' can/ 'di mchims chos seng gi don du mdzad pa yin no// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa (9)(24) bcad na mo bud+dha ya/ bstod pa la don gnyis te// zhes yod pa/ bstod pa'i rnam bshad (9)(24) gsal ba'i 'od zer 'gor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma ni zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di rje btsun gyi sgrol bstod la mchan mdzad pa de gang zag rjes ma cig gis dkyus su bcug pa snang ngo gsungs pa de shin tu 'brel che ste mchan dkyus su song tshe tshig gi khrigs gong 'og cung zad 'khrugs pa ltar snang ngo*// gnyan lo tsā ba'i lugs kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las tshogs dang bcas pa'i 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos// zhes yod pa/ gsol 'debs maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa/ (9)(24) na mo gu ra we/ srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas// zhes yod pa/ rje btsun pa'i rnam thar mnal lam khams pa (9)(24) sbal ston gyis bris pa 'gor/

oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i mnal lam bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa yin na'ang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin yin pas 'dir bzhag pa yin gsungs/ gsang sngags nang gi lhung bzed rin po che'i gzhal yas khang brtag (9)(24) pa 'gor/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rin po che'i gzhal yas khang brtag pa la zhes yod pa/ 'di yang rje btsun gyi gsung las ji ltar byung bzhin du sna ro'i ban+des bris pa yin no// ga ring rgyal po la rtsis bsdur (9)(24) du btang ba'i yi ge 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhes yod pa/ 'dir lam 'bras glegs bam bzhugs pa'i chos tshan gyi rkang grangs ni gong gsung ngag rin po che'i skabs su smos pa ltar ro// ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi (9)(24) spyi don 'gor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos ngo bo nyid// ces yod pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di la don bzhi ste/ zhes pa dang*/ 'di ni dpal ldan sa skyar bris kyi mtha' can/ yo ga rdo rje 'byung ba'i yig (9)(24) sna 'gor/ chos rnams rang bzhin med gzigs kyang*// zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i gzhung so so'i yig sna 'gor/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs kun gyi ṭīka chung re dang bsdus don bcas (9)(24) 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu 'dir bzhag 'dug dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i tho yig mun sel sgron ma'i gzhug na sa skya pa chen pos mdzad par bzhed 'dug sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam gzhag

(9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir 'khor ba la thog ma med ces pa dang sgrub thabs kyi gtad rgya'o i thi'i mtha' can/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs (9)(24) dang las byang*/ yang de'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ gsan yig rgya mtshor phur ba'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ phur pa'i tho yig rgyun gyi man ngag la sogs pa'i las kha tshar ba 'ga' gsung*/ gong gi tshig lhug pa 'di rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin na'ang 'dir glegs bam kha longs pa'i ched du phur pa'i sgrub skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bris pa dang*/ kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la (9)(24) phan pa'i 'od zer 'gor/ rgyud don gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i cho ga bsdus pa gzhan (9)(24) nyer mkho 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba/ kun rig nas 'byung ba'i phyag len/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs pa de thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus so// arga'i cho ga (9)(24) 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gsar pa la zhes yod pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga don gsal (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*// zhes yod pa/ bya spyod rigs gsum spyi'i rigs

(9)(24) gtad kyi cho ga 'gor/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur bar 'dod na zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel man ngag don (9)(24) gsal 'gor/ rin chen lta bu'i bla ma mchog rnams dang*// zhes yod pa/ mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa rim pa gsum pa 'thad par ldan (9)(24) pa 'gor/ dad pas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum (9)(24) 'khor lo 'gor/ mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs (9)(24) bcad ma 'gor/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang zhes yod pa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na sngon gyi dpe rnying 'ga' la rtse mos mdzad zer ba 'dug pa de dag pa yin no gsung*/ mtshan brjod 'don (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag la gsum zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs the tshom (9)(24) can du bzhed pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing zhes pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mthong shog gi mtha' can/ 'di ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu singha shrī zer ba cig gis byas pa snang gsung*/ rje btsun 'phags pa a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i (9)(24) dbang gi cho ga ye shes snang ba'i sgron ma 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim (9)(24) pa 'gor na mo bud+dhā ya/ de nyid don ston bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga (9) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// maṇ+ḍal bya ba ni dri zhim po'i chus byugs la zhes pa dang*/

me tog maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su spungs la gzhag go i thi'i mtha' can/ lha lnga'i bstod (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bde gshegs kun las thugs rje mchog gyur pa// zhes pa dang*/ thugs rje'i sgo nas bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'o'i mtha' can/ srung 'khor bri tshul tshan pa (9)(24) gnyis 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i srung ba'i 'khor lo la don lnga ste zhes pa dang spyi dang mthun par gda'o'i mtha' can/ lag na rdo rje don kun gos sngon can yin/ grub pa'i gzungs kyi lag tu (9)(24) blang ba'i rim pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'dzin dbang dpal ldan bla chen gyi// zhes yod pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka (9)(24) 'gor/ don dam ston byed nus pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i sa bcad 'gor/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo 'di la gnyis te zhes pa dang*/ phan yon bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'di gnyis la dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na the tshom can du bzhed yod do// dpung bzang gi mdo 'grel (9)(24) 'gor/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo sde 'di la zhes yod pa/ bar 'dir gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po sogs su mkha' lding gi man ngag gsungs kyang dpe rnams na yod pa ni gong sa chen gyi skabs na yod pa dang zhus dag pher ba yod pas logs su ma bris so// mi g.yo ba gsang ba chen po'i rgyud kyi (9)(24) man ngag 'gor/ bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad dngos grub kun stsol ba// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rtog pa dang po'i rnam 'grel gsungs pa 'di yin no// gtor chen kha la me 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi don (9) lnga ma 'gor/ bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso// zhes yod pa 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag dang dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig gnyis ka na rtse mo dang mi mthun pa'i shes byed kyis the tshom can du bzhed do// gtor ma brgya rtsa

(9)(24) 'gor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yab// ces yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i zhes gsung*/ shākya rnams kyi rgyal (9)(24) rabs 'gor/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na gang gi gsung*// zhes yod pa/ bod kyi rgyal (9)(24) rabs 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ bod kyi rgyal rabs khri bdun ldeng gcig ces yod pa/ rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo (9)(24) 'gor/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig gang la brten pa yis// zhes pa dang*/ legs pa'i gtam 'di shes par gyis kyi mtha' can/ dus tshod nges par (9)(24) bzung ba'i rtsis yig 'gor/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// lo gang la zla ba'i lhag ma yod pa zhes pa can/ gza' skar gyi 'phrod brtag (9)(24) 'gor/ 'gro rnams dge dang mi dge bstan pa'i phyir// zhes yod pa/ zhes dgu (9)(24) phrugs kyi yi ge 'gor/ 'gro mgon mnyam med ji snyed kun gzigs shing*// zhes pa dang*/ rtse sprod rgod po gshog dang lnga'i mtha' can/ phyag rgya chen po gces btus (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba yod pa sogs man ngag sum cu tham pa bla ma so so'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sbyin sreg 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rdza gsar pa zhes yod pa/ las dang po pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa chos spyod rin chen phreng (9)(24) ba 'gor/ sku gsum rin chen de'i gsung dri ma med// ces yod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsal bar ston pa sh+lau ka nyi shu (9) pa'i bshad pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo dang*/ don ston don byed bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// zhes yod pa/ spyod 'jug gi bsdus (9) don 'gor byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag ces bya ba yod pa/

zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa gnyis kyi dang po'i 'gor bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe zhes pa dang*/ nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'di rje btsun gyis mdzad pa yin min brtag gnyis pa'i 'gor/ bka' (9) drin can gyi bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba'i nyams (9)(24) dbyangs 'gor/ na mo gu ra we/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad la zhes pa dang*/ bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi mtha' can/ khams bde dri ba'i nyams (9)(24) dbyangs 'gor/ rje bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// ces yod pa dang*/ e ma'o 'gro ba nyon re mongs/ zhes pa'i mtha' can/ yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// zhes pa'i man ngag ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba cig dang*/ bdag dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la/ zhes yod pa cig gnas bstod kyi nyams dbyangs 'gor dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa zhes pa dang*/ glu mgur gyi rta la bskyon la long*/ i thi'i mtha' can/ rmi lam (9) nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs 'gor/ grong dang gnas gzhi tshong dus gsum// zhes dang*/ rmi lam nyams (9) len brgyad kyi dbyangs i thi'i mtha' can/ gnyen po bsten (9) tshul gyi nyams dbyangs 'gor/ sems kyi rang so ma tshugs pas// zhes pa dang*/ sems gnyen po bsten nas blangs pa yin gyi mtha' can/ sems 'dul (9) tshul gyi nyams dbyangs 'gor/ mngon shes mig bral bdag ni las mang zhing*// zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin skyon can klong du 'gro mi bya'i mtha' can/ sgrub pa nyams (9) su len tshul 'tshal ba brgyad yod pa/ gsang sngags nang pa'i nyams len 'tshal ba bcu yod pa/ rang gis rang la bskul ba 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni nyon mongs kyis bzung 'khor ba'i chos la dad// ces yod pa/ nyams (9)(24) dbyangs chen mo 'gor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyor mdzad pa'i// zhes yod pa/

'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu gling ras kyi zur za chen mo la bcos nas gzhan zhig gis byas pa yin nam zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo zhes the tshom can du bzhed/ gso dpyad (9)(24) rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces grags pa yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub nas lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bar rim par brgyud de/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba chen po la byung ba'i gdams ngag rnams rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ bla ma dpal chen 'od po rnams kyis gdams ngag 'thor bu mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag klu sgrub nas lo chen rin chen bzang por brgyud de bla ma mal las byung ba'i gdams ngag yin zhing mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i lung yod/ dang po 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag nas mthar mgo bcos kyi bar gyi sman dpyad 'thor dpyad sogs rten 'brel gyi gdams ngag mang po rnams bzhugs so// ༈ //bzhi pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i zhabs kyi gsung rab la thub pa'i dgongs (9)(24) pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ legs par (9)(24) bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ gzhung lugs legs par bshad pa 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ rol mo'i bstan (9)(24) bcos 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ blo gsal (9)(24) zhing don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu rnams la ji ltar dri ba'i tshul 'ga' zhig brtsam 'phro la bzhag pa 'gor swa sti/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ zhes pa dang*/ de ltar tshig gis nga la dris// zhes pa'i mtha' can/ mkhas (9)(24) pa 'jug pa'i sgo 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/

sgra la 'jug (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden pa brnyes pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor// zhes yod pa/ smra sgo'i sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// smra ba'i sgo la don gsum ste zhes yod pa/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa'i rnam bshad byis pa (9)(24) la phan pa 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba (9)(24) 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*// zhes yod pa/ rnam par gcad bya ji ltar sbyor tshul 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par gcad pa'i yi ge'i tshul cung zad brjod na zhes yod pa/ sngags kyi bklag thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags log par bzlas gyur na// zhes yod pa/ sgra nye bar bsdus (9)(24) pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bzlas brjod 'dri dang klog sogs la// zhes yod pa/ tshig gi gtor (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ sdeb sbyor sna (9)(24) tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs (9)(24) rje la bskul ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bla ma rje btsun chen po'i (9)(24) rnam thar thun mong du grags pa 'gor dpal chos kyi rje khams gsum gyi mgon po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po zhes yod pa/ nga brgyad ma rtsa (9)(24) 'grel 'gor/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sgra pa nga yin zhes dang*/ bshad pa 'di la 'gal ba ci mchis pa// de ni mkhas pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can/ tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa ba

(9)(24) dang 'grel pa gnyis/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ de'i lung (9)(24) sbyor 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// zhes yod pa/ gnyan phug chung bas mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i 'bru (9) 'bum 'di dpe snga ma rnams su sa chen gyi skabs na bris 'dug kyang 'dir glegs bam kha longs pa'i ched du bris/ bstan bcos sdom pa (9)(24) gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'jam (9)(24) pa'i rdo rje la mchod pa brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa 'gor/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan blo gros dhīḥlas byung*// zhes yod pa can/ rje btsun chen po la bstod pa (9)(24) 'gor/ srid pa'i 'khri shing drwa ba dral mdzad cing*// zhes yod pa/ bi rū pa la (9)(24) bstod pa/ dad pa'i chu las tshig gi me tog 'di// zhes yod pa/ bde mchog brgyud (9)(24) pa'i gsol 'debs 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi skye dang 'jig pa dag /ces yod pa/ 'di'i bar skabs su kha skong sh+lau ka gnyis 'di bla ma phyi ma zhig gis mdzad par bsams nas yig chung byas bris yod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems (9)(24) dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i phrin yig 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams (9)(24) la spring ba'i yi ge 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor// zhes yod pa/ lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad (9)(24) dgos tshul 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*// zhes dang*/ gzu bo'i blo yis dpyad par zhu'i mtha' can/

rtogs ldan (9) rgyan po'i dris lan 'gor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhes yod pa/ rnel phu ba'i zhus lan 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i don du chos rnams kun// zhes pa dang*/ mdor bsdus pa 'di legs par dgongs kyi mtha' can/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na 'di'i tshab tu rtogs (9) ldan zhig gi dris lan gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam nas bzhag pa las nges pa ma byung*/ zhang lo tsā ba la gdams (9)(24) pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum pa 'gor/ na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i// zhes yod pa/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha (9)(24) rnams la spring ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang tshigs su bcad pa gong 'og gnyis/ smras pa (9)(24) / cung zad dben na zhes dang*/ brgya tshar mnyan pas zhes yod pa'i dbu can/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams su bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du gnyug mar gnas pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun (9)(24) rnams la gnang ba'i yi ge 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams na chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhes yod pa/ nyi ma

(9)(24) la spring ba 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas zhes yod pa/ sho dgon pa 'gro mgon rin chen la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden par smra ba 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor// zhes pa dang*/ sho dgon dge 'dun rnams la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter yon tan pad+mo'i tshal// zhes pa dang*/ sde dgon yon mchod rnams kyi phyag tu phul gyi mtha' can/ lam zab mo bla ma'i (9)(24) rnal 'byor 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis bskal pa du mar dka' spyad pa// zhes yod pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gu shi jo 'bum (9)(24) gyi don du mdzad pa 'gor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ spyir 'o skol rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams zhes yod pa/ sgrub pa lung (9)(24) 'bogs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa lung 'bogs pa'i zhes dang*/ mjug tu/ dbang rdzogs nas gdams ngag sbyin/ de rdzogs nas lung sbyin/ de byin nas rgyas gdab bo// zhes yod pa/ sgrub (9)(24) pa lung sbyin 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa'i zhes yod pa/ rten 'brel (9)(24) lnga'i yi ge 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa zhes yod pa/ lam (9)(24) sbas bshad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sa bdun pa yan chad 'khor bzhi'i rgya zhes pa dang*/ yi ge snga mar gsal bas 'dir ma bris so māp+ta'i mtha' can/ grub chen bcu'i man ngag 'gor/ na mo bi rū pā ya/ rdo rje lce yi sbyor ba zhes sogs kyis mdor bstan nas/ bla chen la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam mang du yod pa zhes pa'i rtogs brjod mdor bsdus bcas yod pa/ rgyas par bshad pa la thun mong gi dngos grub la dang por tshe sgrub pa na sa bcu pa rang gzhan phyi mar gar skye brtag pa'i bar gyi gnad bcu cung zad zhal las shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/

phra mo brgyad kyi man ngag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal dang*/ phra mo brgyad las dang po gza' rigs bsrung ba nas brgyad pa dge mi dge'i ltas brtag pa'i bar gyi las phran tshegs brgyad dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go'i mtha' can/ phyi nang gsang (9)(24) gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul chog 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi (9)(24) bshad snying po don gsal 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// an+da rnyil btags zhes yod pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lag tu blang ba'i rim (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i// zhes yod pa/ de la dgos pa'i rdo rje gur gyi (9)(24) lung sbyor/ rnam 'joms rgyud kyi bshad (9)(24) pa bdud rtsi spel ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu phrag bdun dang lnga phrag gcig /ces yod pa/ lam 'bras khrid kyi dkar chag dkar chag 'di bka' 'bum po ti rnams na mi bzhugs pas gsan yig rnams su'ang ma byung bas lung yod med dpyad byar snang ngo*// na mo gu ra we/ mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi rgyun// zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs kyi gsal byed 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i brgyud pa ni zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma (9)(24) ljang gu'i mngon rtogs 'gor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun ma sgrub pa'i gang zag gis zhes yod pa/ kag chol gyi rjes gnang 'gor na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// zhes yod pa/ ba ri ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ yang man ngag bsdus pa gcig dang bcas/ gza' thams cad kyi (9)(24) yum gyi mchod chog 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/

rigs drug gi mtshan don dang ye shes bsre ba'i bshad pa 'gor tshangs pa la brah+ma zhes pa'i sgras zhes yod pa/ rigs kyi rab dbye'i bshad (9)(24) sbyar 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgra sgrub dum bu (9) dgu pa ni dā na zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na zhes pa'i dbu can/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i bshad (9)(24) pa 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa (9)(24) 'gor dri ma med pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa zhes yod pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i sa (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhes yod pa/ bla ma la (9)(24) thun mong ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'gor/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// zhes yod pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs (9)(24) pa 'gor/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces yod pa/ bod yul la (9)(24) bsngags pa bstod tshig pad+mo'i phreng ba 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yis// zhes yod pa/ shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba (9)(24) 'debs pa tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig byang chub shing dbang drung du zhes yod pa/ thub pa'i bstod pa tshig lhug pa/ 'dir gsan yig tshor byung yang dpe ma rnyed pas lung ma byung*/ bde bar gshegs pa (9)(24) khams gsum gyi mgon po la bstod pa tshigs bcad dgu pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag 'phags pa'i gtso dang lha dbang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis// zhes yod pa/ 'jig rten dbang (9)(24) phyug la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha brgya'i gtsug gis zhabs mchod pa// zhes yod pa/

lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams la (9)(24) bsngags pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zla ba kha ba kun+da gangs ri'i mdog /ces yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad yi ge (9)(24) nyung ngu zhes bya ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros gtsug na yon tan nor bu'i 'od gsal zhing*// zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi phyag (9)(24) mtshan ri mo'i yi ge 'gor/ sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho// zhes yod pa/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgom (9)(24) chen rnams la spring ba 'gor/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgom chen mang yod de// zhes yod pa/ bu slob rnams (9)(24) la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bod yul la bsngags pa zhes byung ba 'di min pa gzhan mi 'dug pas yig skyon yin nam snyam/ bod 'bangs spyi la gdams pa zhes dpe dngos la 'dug bka' gdams (9)(24) do kor ba'i zhu ba/ do kor ba'i zhus (9)(24) lan 'gor/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// so sor thar pa 'dul ba bzhin// zhes yod pa/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa drug (9)(24) btul ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rgya mtsho'i gos can zhes pa'i dbu can yon tan sgrogs pa'i tshal (9)(24) la bstod pa 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// do shal phreng ba sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// zhes yod pa/ pa gor zhes bya ba'i sgra las bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la (9)(24) bsngags pa 'gor/ lha dang lha dbang klu dbang mi yi gtso// zhes yod pa/ don mo ri pa'i gtsug lag khang du rje btsun gyis ri mo mdzad dus kyi tshigs bcad gnyis/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa

(9)(24) 'gor/ na mo gu ra we dang tshig de nyid yod pa/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thub pas chos rnams gang gsungs pa// zhes yod pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams (9) pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir dal 'byor gyi lus thob ces yod pa/ snang ba (9)(24) mtha' yas kyi sgom don 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i zhes yod pa/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams (9)(24) ngag ngo mtshar can 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro// zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa sdud pa sogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don thabs (9)(24) 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa sdud pa la sogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'dod par 'dod na zhes bya ba yod pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don (9)(24) thabs/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa'i man ngag ni zhes yod pa/ spyod pa (9)(24) rnam dag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa 'gor spyod pa rnam par dag pa zhes yod pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i man (9)(24) ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ chags lo'i zhu ba (9)(24) 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ sdom pa gsum ldan rig pa'i gnas lnga thugs su chud pa zhes yod pa/ de'i zhus (9)(24) lan 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bde byed chur nyal rang byung me tog mda'// zhes yod pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes (9)(24) rab rin chen la spring ba 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas zhes yod pa/ bka' gdams pa nam (9)(24) mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa zhes yod pa/

ston pa blo gros (9)(24) rab gsal gyi dris lan 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig rnams su 'dir gur ston zhus lan dang*/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan 'gor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa zhes yod 'di gnyis dpe ma rnyed pas lung ma byung*/ pa/ snye mo sgom chen gyi dris lan (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dad pa dang 'dun pa dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa/ rnal 'byor pa (9)(24) phru ma'i dris lan 'gor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta hor yul du chag phebs pa'i mdo smad kyi lam khar zhes yod pa/ bsngo ba yon bshad 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba dgra rgyal chos kyi rgyal po yi// zhes yod pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs ras pa shes rab 'od kyi don du mdzad pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes 'di gnyis gsan yig rnams su ma byung bas lung med/ pa yi// zhes yod pa/ rlung 'di gnyis gsan yig rnams su ma byung bas lung med/ gi rten 'brel 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de// rlung gi rten 'brel zhes yod pa/ mnal lam tshigs bcad ma 'gor/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang*// zhes yod pa/ dbang gi rgyal po'i sbyin sreg (9)(24) 'gor/ gsum pa mjug gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i zhes yod pa/ dme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs 'gor/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ khro bo stobs po che sgrub par 'dod pas zhes bya ba yod pa/ lus kyi zag pa sbyin pa gtong ba'i gzungs 'gor/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi ming de nyid dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rang gis rang la gros 'debs 'gor// yon tan rin chen dpal gyis lham me ba// zhes yod pa/

(9)(24) dug bcos 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyor ba dang po 'dis zhes pa dang*/ yang dug glo bur ba zhes pa gnyis/ sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i kha (9)(24) rgyan 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ dang*/ tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'dir legs par bshad pa gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba dang*/ legs bshad 'phrul gyi drwa ba 'dir bka' 'bum rnams su legs bshad gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan zhes pa dang 'phrul gyi drwa ba zhesapa gnyis byung yang*/ snga ma ni sa paṇa gsung yin par rin spungs sa spyod rin po ches gsungs pa dang*/ phyi ma 'di sa paṇa gyi gsung yin min the tshom gyi gzhir snang yang gsan yig rnams su mi 'byung bas gnyis ka la lung med do// 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yis// zhes bya ba yod pa rnams so// rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i rgyud brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad sna (9) bsring ba zhes pa dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma byung*/ phyag rgya chen po yan lag bdun ldan gyi rtsa (9) ba 'gor/ chos kun nye bar zhi ba can zhes yod pa rnams so// ༈ //lnga pa khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung rab la shes bya rab tu gsal (9) ba 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag (9)(24) mchod mi 'phrogs ma/ rgyud 'grel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang shes rab kun tu mnyam sbyor zhing*// zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ku mu ti dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs gsungs pa 'di yin no// ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// zhes yod pa/

'jigs byed (9)(24) brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// zhes yod pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan (9)(24) 'bum saṃ skṛ ta'i skad can/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed spel (9)(24) ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mchog sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// ces yod pa/ yang gsol ba 'debs (9)(24) pa'i rab byed sku'i spyod pa la spel ba/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa mu tig phreng ba (9)(24) mjug tu tshig de nyid yod pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa (9)(24) gnyis 'gor/ na maḥshrī māṃ pa ra ma gu ru tsa ra ṇaṃ ka ma la s+ya ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ blo chen ldan pa zhes dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi sngon du byang chub brnyes gyur kyang*// zhes yod pa/ chos spyod bcu pa cung

(9)(24) zad rgyas par spel ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las srid dang rnam grol ba'i// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig na gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam/ chos spyod yan (9)(24) lag bcu pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa ri bo rtse lngar (9)(24) sbyar ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis tshogs ni rdzogs gyur cing*// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog gsum (9)(24) la bstod pa 'gor/ bsod nams chu gter dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*// zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa'i mtshan la spel ba'i bstod pa (9)(24) gnyis 'gor 'gro kun gang la zhes pa dang*/ bde legs 'byung gnas zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa la (9)(24) bstod pa bzhi gang gi thugs zhes pa dang*/ bsod nams gser gyi zhes pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i tshogs kun zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i snying po zhes yod pa/ thogs med sku mched sogs (9)(24) la bstod pa tshul khrims lhun po zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa (9)(24) la bstod pa gnyis 'gor gdong bzhi thor tshugs zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i chu 'dzin zhes yod pa/ thos pa rgya (9)(24) mtsho ma/ mchog brgyad kyi bstod pa (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhung lugs mi 'dra'i chu bo zhes yod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa (9)(24) gang drin ma'i 'bru 'grel/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs (9)(24) pa sho dgon gyi slob dpon sbyang nga ba'i don du mdzad pa/ bla ma'i rnal (9)(24) 'byor la 'o shu'i don du mdzad pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs (9)(24) pa phyogs bcu dus gsum ma dge slong gnas brtan byang chub bzang po'i don du mdzad pa/

chos rje pa'i rnam thar bsdus (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin kun nas rnam dag ces yod pa/ chos rje pa la (9)(24) rnam thar gyi sgo nas bstod pa me tog phreng ba 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhes yod pa/ lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi gsan (9)(24) yig 'gor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la// zhes yod pa/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas mtshal mdor bsdebs pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i (9)(24) bsdus pa'i don 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs ljon chung (9)(24) 'gor phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes dang*/ mjug tu dge ba bcu las nas nges 'grub 'gyur gyi mtha' can/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dag ldan chung (9)(24) ba 'gor dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'di 'chad par byed pa la zhes dang*/ brtag pa phyi ma'i skabs su babs pa spyi don bshad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal kye rdo rje'i spyi don gsal ba 'gor tshig de nyid dang rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par dbye ba'o'i mtha' can/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u'i 'brel (9) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal po'i pho brang du bshad pa'i tshe mdzad pa/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bskul ba ltar shin kun mkhar du mdzad pa/ yig brgya bzla ba'i man (9)(24) ngag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i man ngag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa ba'i bla ma la zhes yod pa thang skyar sbyar ba/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon (9)(24) par rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa sa pho rta'i lor go pe la'i pho brang du sbyar ba/

kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs srung 'khor dang bcas (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam sbyor bde chen rtag pa'i sku// zhes yod pa/ spre'u lor rgyal po rgyal sar phyung dus sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por yig brgya bzla ba'i tshul gnyis gsungs pa gcig 'di'i mgo na yod pa bgrang ba yin/ mngon rtogs yan lag (9)(24) drug chung 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang zhes yod pa rgyal bu ji big de mur gyi don du sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi drug gi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gsungs pa'ang 'di yin no// bsnyen pa'i grangs (9)(24) tshad kyi zhus lan 'gor/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pas dri ba byed pa gang yin pa// zhes yod pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i rjes la bya ba'i smon (9) lam 'gor tshig de nyid kyi phyed yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing (9)(24) dbang blang ba'i cho ga 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bdag 'jug dpal 'byung ma gsungs pa'ang 'di yin/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len gyi rim pa tshigs (9)(24) bcad ma/ bdag 'jug gi cho ga snying po gsal ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag gnyis med bde chen rtag pa'i sku// zhes yod pa rgyal bu jim gyin gyi don du mdzad pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa (9)(24) blang ba'i lag len 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ rgya mtshor go go can gyi don du mdzad pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ kye'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i lus sems gdod ma nas// zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud

(9)(24) rtsi'i bum pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i lung sbyor rdo rje gur (9)(24) nas phyung ba/ tshogs 'khor (9)(24) bsdus pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur pa'i// zhes yod pa/ chu mo phag gi lo'i dbyar zla 'bring por rgyal po'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa'i lag len bdud rtsi 'byung (9)(24) ba 'gor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud rtsi lnga dang zhes yod pa/ dpal rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal bu jim gyin gyi ngor sbyar ba/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i bstod pa rnam (9) dag gi phreng ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dag pa (9)(24) gsum gyi khrid yig 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes yod pa/ dbang gsum pa'i lam 'gor dbang gsum pa'i lam la rgyas bsdus gnyis las zhes yod pa/ tshogs sbyor gyi mngon rtogs (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs la btud de// tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs bri bar bya// zhes yod pa/ 'pho ba'i (9)(24) rnal 'byor 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor sgom par zhes dang*/ bar do nyid du rig 'dzin go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro zhes yod pa/ khro bcu'i bstod (9)(24) bskul 'gor/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong dkyil du// zhes yod pa/ seṅge mtha'i (9)(24) zhus lan rnam par nges pa 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho yi// zhes dang*// 'di yi legs chas 'gro la dge bar shog gi mtha' can/ ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris (9)(24) lan tshigs bcad ma 'gor rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba yod pa mtshal mdor sbyar ba/

dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs (9)(24) 'gor/ na mo gu ru kā la tsakra ya zhes yod pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi sdom tshigs (9)(24) bcad ma 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs// zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing (9)(24) dbang blang ba'i cho ga 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa chu sprel lor shing kun du mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal po'i pho brang kha'i phing hur sbyar ba/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu (9)(24) bzang po'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi sdom tshigs (9)(24) bcad ma 'gor/ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra/ nyon mongs bud shing kun bsregs shing*// zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga (9)(24) rgyas pa 'gor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs nyung zhing gsal (9)(24) ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa ston pa shes rab kyi ngor mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs rim pa gsal (9)(24) ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa lcags lug lor shing kun du sbyar ba/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa (9)(24) 'gor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa shing kun du sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por ngag 'don gsungs pa 'di yin/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags (9) dpal nā ro pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa 'gor/ bla ma dang bde mchog la phyag 'tshal rgya skad du yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa'i

(9)(24) rab tu byed pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa cang to'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ sgo mtshams ma (9)(24) brgyad kyi bstod bskul 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ nga ni sku gsum mnyam sbyor zhing*// zhes yod pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus (9)(24) pa tshigs bcad ma 'gor/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dngos// zhes yod pa/ lus dkyil gyi bdag (9)(24) 'jug 'gor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa shing kun du sbyar ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa'i man (9) ngag 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa dur gar dur mis kyi ngor dpal sa skyar mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil (9)(24) 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal bu ji big de mur gyi ngor mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa yu gur gyi ban+de saṃgha mi tra'i ngor mdzad pa/ yang de'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs jo sras phag mchu'i don du mdzad pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su (9)(24) bcad pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'di kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la tshig rkang ma mnyam pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhus dag dang kha skong mdzad pa yin/ yang jim gyin la gnang ba'i shis brjod he ru ka dpal ma dang*/ go go can la (9)(24) gnang ba'i bkra shis dpal mchog bde chen ma/ rwa lugs phag mo lha so bdun (9)(24) ma'i mngon rtogs 'gor rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba slob dpon shrī u ma pa ti tas mdzad pa'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs (9)(24) 'gor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa sa sbrul shang tor mdzad pa/ yang de'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa me byi lor mdzad pa/ de'i tshogs (9)(24) 'khor 'gor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes yod pa dang*/ de'i sbyin sreg (9)(24) 'gor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa gnyis ka go go can gyi don du mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil (9)(24) 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa lcags rta'i lor shang tor mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' (9)(24) 'gro'i sdig sbyong gi cho ga 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgo nas zhes yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga (9)(24) dbang rnam par rol pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa dang*/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) sgyu 'phrul rnam pa rol pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa gnyis ka shing glang lor dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bsdus (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma hā mā yā bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa bya lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes gsum la sbyar ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal bu ho ko'i don du mdzad pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa shing kun du sbyar ba/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha mo'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lha mo bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa rgyal bu g.yung drung ta'i don du mdzad pa/

gur gyi rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa thang ngo ta'i don du mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil (9)(24) 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa nyi sbas las brgyud pa/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du byas pa/ 'di 'phags pas mdzad pa min yang kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang 'phags pas rgya'i yul cang to mkhar du bsgyur ba yin/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrol ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ma// zhes yod pa 'dam gyi char sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por au ḍ+yān gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'ang de nyid yin no// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang (9)(24) ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa grags pa bzang po'i ngor shing kun du sbyar ba/ phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub

(9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa sa skyar sbyar ba/ 'di sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rjes su 'brang ba yin/ sgrol ma lha bcu (9)(24) bdun ma'i dbang chog 'gor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa dbon mo go go can gyi ngor dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ mdor byas kyi sa bcad (9) 'gor 'di la gnyis te zhes dang nye bar bsdu ba'o'i mtha' can/ gsang (9)(24) 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang chog 'di klu byang dang sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyi dkyil chog dang kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa yin/ 'gor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes yod pa chu khyi'i lor rgyal po'i pho brang kha'i phing hur mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi rnam thar (9)(24) dang brgyud pa'i rim pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sngon byung ba rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul zhes yod pa go pe la'i pho brang du bris pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha (9)(24) bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa me rta lor rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang du mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) bsdus pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa lcags mo bya lor rgyal po'i pho brang du mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par (9)(24) rtogs pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa sa pho 'brug gi lor sba wang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs 'gor dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes yod pa tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa (9)(24) phag lo'i zla ba dgu pa'i nyer dgu la sbyar ba/ yang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa a rog che'i don du mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'gor tshig de nyid dang 'bum phrag nyi shus bsnyen pa bya'i mtha' can/

phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ya mān+ta ka bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa sa pho'i 'brug gi lor rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i don du mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bdag (9)(24) 'jug 'gor dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga zhes yod pa chu mo bya'i lor shing kun tu mdzad pa/ de'i sbyin sreg (9)(24) 'gor dpal chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa shing khyi'i lor hun chang hū'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ zhe dgu ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor 'jam dpal zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa shing mo phag gi lor mdo khams tsom mdo gnas gsar du sbyar ba/ rab (9)(24) gnas saṃ gha mi tra'i don du mdzad pa 'gor/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i// zhes yod pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub (9)(24) pa'i thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa lha bcu gsum ma lcags mo lug gi lor rgyal bu maṅga la'i ngor cang to'i mkhar du sbyar ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa chu mo bya'i lor shing kun mkhar du sbyar ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs 'jigs pa med pa rnam par rol pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod cing tshogs 'khor dang bcas sa mo sbrul gyi lor cang to'i pho brang gsar pa'i dag byed khrus khang du mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan skyes kyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa chu pho spre'u'i lor shing kun gyi sa'i char sbyar ba/ yang lhan skyes sgrub thabs sa pho sbrul gyi lor cang tor sbyar ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'i rnam par (9)(24) bshad pa dam tshig rab tu gsal ba 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa nyi ma 'bum gyi don du sa pho spre'u lor g.yar mo thang sa'i cha shing kun du sbyar/

bla ma lnga (9)(24) bcu pa'i bsdus don 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gang gi bskal pa du mar rnyed dka' ba'i// zhes yod pa me 'brug lor hu chur mdzad pa/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag yas bsod nams ye shes tshogs las nyer bsgrubs pas// zhes yod pa sa mo lug gi lor rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid dang*/ bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi zhes yod pa chu mo glang gi lor tsom mdor mdzad pa/ tshe dpag med kyi bstod pa (9)(24) pad+mo'i phreng ba 'gor/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa zhes yod pa jim gyin gyi don du mdzad pa/ 'od dpag med kyi bsgom (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas zhes yod pa slob ma do da zhes pa'i don du sbyar ba/ mi (9)(24) 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med bla ma chos rje rin po che dang zhes yod pa ye shes bzang po'i ngor me sbrul lor sbyar ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ rnam 'joms kyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs byab bsrung sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'gor rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa rgyal mtshan dpal gyi ngor chu pho khyi lor sbyar ba/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom par zhes yod pa me 'brug gi lor rgyal bu lu ga'i ngor mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal (9)(24) dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa shing stag lor mdo khams sgang du sbyar ba/

thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung (9)(24) 'jug tu nyams su len tshul 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// stan bde ba la zhes yod pa me ston tsa ge ju phur gyi ngor me byi lor skya ka mdor sbyar ba/ thugs rje chen po'i (9)(24) sgrub thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa rgya yul du sbyar ba/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs rdo rje khye'u 'dren gyi don du sbyar ba/ seṅge sgra'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs me pho byi ba'i lor sgang rar sbyar ba/ rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs shing phag gi lor tre'i sa char bkod pa/ byams pa'i chos skor yan lag (9)(24) dang bcas pa 'gor/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa dang 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes chos skor yan lag dang bcas rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun mi g.yo ba zhes yod pa sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin sbyar ba/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod cing sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa (9)(24) 'gor/ gang gi drin gyis bde 'gro'i 'byor pa dang*// zhes yod pa yon tan 'bum gyi don du me 'brug zla tshes la sbyar ba/ rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs stong mchod dang bcas pa 'gor rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das ma zhes yod pa/ gdugs dkar bsgom thabs gzungs (9)(24) bklag thabs dang bcas pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa shing phag gi lor tre'i sa char bsdebs pa/

ri khrod lo ma can sgrub (9)(24) thabs gzungs chog dang bcas pa 'gor rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa ba ri ba las brgyud pa/ ri khrod ma'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs chos rje sa skya pa'i man ngag yi ger bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// zhes yod pa chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du mdzad pa/ tsun+da'i sgrub thabs (9)(24) rgyud las byung ba'i rim pa 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa sa pho rta'i lor mdzad pa/ srung ba lnga'i dbang chog gi skor gtor ma/ byur bsal/ dug dbyung*/ dbang chog gi sdom/ dbang bskur ba dngos te de rnams rgyas pa zhig 'og tu bzhugs kyang*/ 'di nyid kyi sngags rnams la 'dra min mang po byung ba phyi mo mang po la gtugs nas zhus dag nan cher byas tshe 'di ltar byung la/ 'og ma ni bka' dang bstun pa'i zhus dag bgyis pa yin pas lung brgyud gong ma 'di thos pas 'thus so// phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa me pho byi ba'i lor dpal sa skyar sbyar nas rgyal bu a rog che la phul ba/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs tshigs bcad ma 'gor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang (9)(24) bcas pa'i 'gor lha mo 'od zer can sgrub pa'i thabs/ rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las 'od kyis zhes yod pa chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du sbyar ba/ yang de'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs bstod pa bcas 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'od zer can sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa skad gnyis smra ba du lag gi ngor mdzad pa/ lha mo 'od zer

(9)(24) can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'gor tshig de nyid yod cing*/ 'di dang gong gi sgrub thabs gnyis lo tsā ba saṃ gha'i don du chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du mdzad pa/ de'i bstod pa (9)(24) rgyas pa 'gor bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma'i bstod pa zhes yod pa lcags pho rta lor mdzad pa/ spyan ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa sa rta lor mdzad pa/ gza' yum gyi sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor rje btsun ma gza' thams cad kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa me byi lor thang skyar sbyar ba/ 'dod pa'i lha rnams (9)(24) la bstod pa 'gor/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras// zhes yod pa/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i tshig tshan (9)(24) pa gnyis kyi 'gor/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang ma// zhes yod pa dang*/ na mo badz+ra satwā ya/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo zhes yod pa gnyis ka chu mo glang gi lor kha'i phing hur mdzad pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por che brjod dang mchod gar gsungs pa de yin/ srung ba lnga'i sdom ring (9) thung gnyis kyi 'gor/ rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis// zhes dang*/ rje btsun ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas rig sngags 'chang ba zhes yod pa/ de'i mtshams (9) gcod 'gor gnas dang yo byad byin phab nas zhes dang*/ rol mo dang bcas te gtor ma gtong ngo'i mtha' can/ de'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs bsdus pa 'gor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa dang*/ de'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs rgyas pa 'gor gong gi tshig de nyid yod pa gnyis shing mo yos bu'i lor mdzad pa/ de'i bstod pa 'gor srung (9)(24) ba lnga'i lha mo la bstod pa zhes yod pa mi'i dbang po go pe la'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ yang de'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa

(9)(24) 'gor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa zhes yod pa/ 'di slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa la 'phags pas kha skong mdzad gsung*/ phyogs kyi gtor ma (9)(24) 'gor de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtong ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ gza' (9)(24) skar gyi gtor ma 'gor gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces yod pa/ byur (9)(24) bsal ba de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ dug (9)(24) dbyung ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// zhes yod pa/ rgyal (9)(24) bar byed pa 'gor na mo bud+dhā ya zhes yod pa/ dbang (9)(24) bskur ba dngos 'gor de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇ+ḍal phul la zhes yod pa/ 'di yan dkon mchog lhun sgrub pa'i gsan yig dang dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kar gza' skar gyi gtor ma sogs gsungs pas sogs khongs su bsdus par nges shing phyi mo mang po na yang dpe tshan gcig tu byas 'dug dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma 'gor/ tad+ya thā oṃ gi ri gi ri zhes yod pa/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa 'gor bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis zhes yod pa/ shis pa brjod pa 'gor nad pa'i zas dang skom dang zhes yod pa ste bco lnga pa'o'i mtha' can/ bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud sde phal che ba'i dkar (9)(24) chag 'gor/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn maḥshrī bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka badz+ra dha rā ya zhes dang*/ bde legs shog gi mtha' can/ mgon po'i sgrub (9)(24) yig 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa chu pho byi ba'i lor mi nyag gi yul du sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi (9)(24) lnga mchod 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes yod pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa (9)(24) 'gor/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/

hūm̐ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// zhes yod pa/ lcags pho khyi'i lor mi nyag gi yul byang ngos su sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bstod pa gnyis gsungs kyang 'di las ma byung bas yig skyon yin nam brtag lcam (9)(24) dral gyi gtor chog 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang zhes yod pa jim gyin la phul ba gsungs pa 'di yin/ bshags (9)(24) pa 'gor dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral zhes yod pa tshig lhug pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bstod (9)(24) pa 'gor dpal gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas gcig bsdus zhes yod pa/ dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa dzam+bha la bsgom par zhes yod pa dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma (9)(24) 'gor/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs su lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma zhes pa nas byang phyogs su bya ba gnod sbyin thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sa skya pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs

(9)(24) dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la zhes yod pa las dang po pa rnams kyi ngor lcags mo lug gi lo la shing kun tu mdzad pa/ cha gsum gtor ma 'bring po 'gor bgegs gtor ni/ bsang ba nas zhes yod pa/ klu (9)(24) gtor 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// klu gtor gtang bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las phyung bzhin mdzad pa/ chu gtor gtang ba'i rim (9)(24) pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang zhes dang rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan ngag rin po che'i rgyan (9)(24) rnam par bkra ba 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya dang tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa sa mo lug gi lor cang to'i mkhar du mdzad pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por chos rje sa paṇa la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya (9)(24) thub pa'i bstod pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ shing pho stag gi lor 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba mthong tshe bstod pa yin/ 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas (9)(24) bstod pa 'gor/ na mo mañdzū gho ṣā ya/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// zhes yod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa dang*/ 'jam dpal la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng (9)(24) ba 'gor/ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ shes bya kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba (9)(24) 'gor/ na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs// zhes yod pa gsum ka me mo sbrul gyi lor ri bo rtse lngar mdzad pa/ phyag mtshan ri mo'i bstod tshig la (9)(24) spel ba 'gor/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs thub pas sa gsum snyan par bsgrags// zhes yod pa/

'jam dpal brtan (9)(24) pa'i 'khor lo la bstod pa 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub pas// zhes yod pa/ ri bo rtse lnga'i rtse mo rnams su phyag 'tshal du byon pa'i tshe rigs so so dang mthun (9)(24) par bstod pa 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byams pa'i lte ba rab tu brtan cing zhes yod pa/ ā nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' (9)(24) bo'i 'khor lo bris pa 'gor/ pañtsa sarba ta bi kri ḍā zhes dang dpa' bo'i 'khor lo nyid bris pa zhes pa'i mtha' can/ 'jam dpal la bstod pa (9) 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam pa sna tshogs lo 'dab kyis bkra zhes gru mur du yud tsam la sbyar ba yod pa/ skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti la mnal (9)(24) lam du bstod pa 'gor/ na maḥshrī lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po zhes dang bya lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin rmi lam du byung ngo*// lhag ma rnams ma dran no'i mtha' can/ byams (9)(24) pa mgon po la bstod pa 'gor/ byams pa'i thugs kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas// zhes yod pa gru mur du yud tsam la sbyar ba/ gnas brtan bcu drug (9) la bstod pa 'gor/ dgra bcom blo mchog dbang dul ba// zhes yod pa/ yan lag (9)(24) bcu pa 'gor/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du// zhes yod pa/ yan lag bdun pa phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang (9)(24) bcas pa'i tshigs bcad 'gor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs// zhes yod pa/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga (9)(24) bsdus pa 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i zhes dang chos bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig gi mtha' can/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba (9)(24) dang bcas pa 'bring du bstan pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spyir bstan pa'i gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhes dang*/

byang chub chen po thob par shog gi mtha' can/ yang de gsum (9)(24) bsdus pa yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang gi don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam (9)(24) gzhag bo lod kyi don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi bslab (9)(24) bya rgyal po a rog che la phul ba/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i (9)(24) rab tu byed pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa shing kun du sbyar ba/ de'i bsdus don 'gor mkhyen rab kyi dbang (9)(24) phyug 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhes yod pa tre'i sa cha dga' ldan gnas gsar du sbyar ba/ theg pa chen po gsal (9)(24) ba zhes bya ba yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ theg pa chen po gsal ba la don gsum zhes yod pa rong po'i snyi'i lung par mdzad pa/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long tshigs su bcad (9)(24) pa bzhi bcu pa 'gor ming de nyid yod pa sa pho rta'i lor sbyar ba/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam (9)(24) du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa sa skyar sbyar ba/ rgyal bu maṅga la la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa me pho byi ba'i lor mdo khams kyi char sbyar ba/ rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa tshigs su bcad pa (9)(24) brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa shing kun du sbyar ba/ rgyal po ho ko'i don du mdzad pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi rnam (9)(24) gzhag 'gor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rgyal po ho ko'i don du zhes yod pa shing kun du mdzad pa/ rgyal bu de gus bho ga la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa me pho byi ba'i lor mdzad pa/ rgyal bu de mur bho ga la gdams (9)(24)

pa zla ba'i 'od zer 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa gnam du sbyar ba/ dpon mo pun+da ri'i don du mdzad pa sgrub pa'i rim pa rab tu gsal ba 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la phyi dang nang gi zhes yod pa lcags 'brug gi lor dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ rgyal sras jim gyin la spring ba (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas zhes yod pa byi ba'i lor gra mda' nas bskur ba/ yang jim gyin la spring ba (9)(24) gnyis kyi 'gor/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen te// zhes pa dang*/ brtse ba'i dbang phyug (9)(24) thams cad mkhyen pa zhes yod pa rma chu 'gram nas springs pa/ a tsa ra la spring ba (9) 'gor/ mi gang dal ba 'byor pa thob gyur cing*// zhes yod pa shing kun du mdzad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ldong ston gyi don du spring (9) ba'i yi ge 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'byung na// zhes yod pa sa skyar mdzad pa/ ye shes 'bum la gdams pa (9) bdud rtsi'i thig le 'gor bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa cang tor mdzad pa/ rigs par smra ba grags (9)(24) bzang la spring ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa zla ba mig gis mthong tshe bris pa/ bden pa gnyis rnam par nges pa (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa kha'i phing hur sbyar ba/ zab mo snang ba zhes (9)(24) bya ba'i rab tu byed pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa mdo khams sa char sbyar ba/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i man (9)(24) ngag 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// ces yod pa ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba/ de'i khrid yan lag (9)(24) bdun ldan 'gor phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i man ngag yan lag bdun pa zhes yod pa mi nyag gi yul du mdzad pa/

yan lag bdun gyi gtam (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgya'i yul du sbyar ba/ dam chos pad dkar gyi tshig don la gzhan gyi log par rtog pa (9)(24) dgag pa 'gor/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las byung ba'i gsung rab kyi zhes yod pa me glang lor chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du mdzad pa/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag (9)(24) par bsdus pa 'gor theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes yod pa sa sbyar ba/ snying po'i (9)(24) sdom/ thabs la mkhas (9)(24) pa'i sdom/ ting nge (9)(24) 'dzin gyi sdom/ byang chub sems (9)(24) dpa'i sa'i sdom/ sangs rgyas (9)(24) kyi sa'i sdom ste zab mo'i mdo lngar grags pa'i sdom rnams kyi 'gor so so'i tshig de rnams yod pa/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi bsdus (9)(24) don 'gor/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*// zhes yod pa rgya yul go pe la'i pho brang du sbyar ba/ skyo ba'i gtam (9)(24) 'gor/ na mo gu ru mañdzu nā thā ya/ thugs kyi bang mdzod yon tan nor bus gtams// zhes yod pa sa mo lug gi lor sbyar ba/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel (9)(24) ba'i gtam 'gor/ 'dir smras pa/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snyigs ma'i ngang tshul can// zhes yod pa me sbrul rgyal gyi zla bar sbyar ba/ theg pa'i rnam (9)(24) par dbye ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa mdo khams kyi sa'i char zla snying mar me mdor sbyar ba/ bsam gtan shes rab kyi dris (9)(24) lan 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can// zhes yod pa 'dam du bris pa/ ka sogs sum (9)(24) cu la spel ba'i tshigs bcad 'gor/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ ka la piṅka'i dbyangs ltar snyan gsung gis// zhes yod pa yi ge sbyor tshul 'gor/

yang dag lam la zhes yod pa/ ldan yul du skyes pa'i ston pa brtson 'grus kyi dris lan (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dris pa'i lan cung zad gdab par bya ste zhes yod pa shing mo phag lor gdu bu'i zla bar sbyar ba/ byang chub (9)(24) lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa 'gor tshig de nyid yod pas stag gi lor dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ dran pa gso (9)(24) thabs 'gor/ gang gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por lta ba ston pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs pa 'di 'dra/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge tshogs dpag med rin chen las bsgrubs shing*// zhes yod pa/ tsha rong pa (9)(24) la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing*// zhes yod pa/ sdom brtson cig (9)(24) la spring ba 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*// zhes yod pa/ zab mo nyams su len (9)(24) tshul 'gor bsdus 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag tu 'chi ba bsam par bya// zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur (9) la spring pa 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba// zhes yod pa/ yang de la spring pa 'gor/ ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// zhes yod pa/ yi gyang jus glegs bam bsgrubs pa la bsngags (9) pa 'gor/ na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te// zhes yod pa/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang ba'i rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la (9)(24) gnang ba'i bka' yig gser gyi rdo rje'i rten can 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zag pa med dbyings nam mkha'i khams// zhes yod pa/

rgyal bu al go la spring pa (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs pa// zhes yod pa cang tor mdzad pa/ rin chen pak+ṣi la spring pa (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// zhes yod pa cang tor mdzad pa/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mī ka ra la (9)(24) spring pa 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong blo gros kyi ming dang ldan pa zhes yod pa cang tor bris pa/ shong ston lo tsā ba la spring pa (9)(24) bla ma 'phags pas zhes yod pa/ rwa dbon la (9)(24) spring pa 'gor/ gzhung lugs brgya phrag du ma'i chu klung dang*// zhes yod pa/ rigs (9)(24) pa'i ral gri la spring ba 'gor/ mkha' dbyings dag pa skye dgu'i sgron me'i dpal// zhes yod pa/ spyi bo lhas (9)(24) pa bshes gnyen rin chen la bskur ba 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas nyer zhi zhi ba'i lam gyis zhes yod pa khyi lor pho brang kha'i phing hur bris pa/ chag (9)(24) lo tsā ba/ dbus (9)(24) gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spyi/ dbus kyi bka' (9)(24) gdams pa spyi/ stag (9)(24) lung pa/ dbus kyi sgom (9)(24) chen pa spyi rnams la rim pa bzhin du ma chags lo bdag ces pa dang*/ dmigs med thugs rje'i zhes pa dang*/ ji bzhin gzigs pas zhes pa dang*/ srid dang zhi ba'i zhes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang zhes pa rnams kyi dbu can/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba (9)(24) gsum gyi 'gor ye shes dkyil 'khor zhes pa dang*/ spros pa med pa'i zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i dpal zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ dpon mo du gal dur mis la (9)(24) bskur ba gnyis kyi 'gor/ dpal ldan don yod zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rgyal (9)(24)

bu jim gyin/ ho (9)(24) ka grags (9)(24) bzang*/ ston gzhon (9)(24) rnams la spring ba'i 'gor/ 'dir smras pa/ deng sang 'di na zhes pa dang*/ stobs sogs yon tan zhes pa dang*/ mdangs dang dri ro zhes pa dang*/ blo che rlom che zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ gos dar lnga stong dang (9)(24) dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang bsngo ba 'gor/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' las mngon 'phags shing*// zhes yod pa/ tshe dpag med la (9) bstod pa 'gor/ sna tshogs 'dab rgyas chu skyes zhes bya ba yod pa'i sh+lau ka gcig yang 'di la ma (9) dmigs zhes pa dang*/ yan lag (9) drug cu zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'thor bu gnyis/ mgon g.yag (9)(24) la bsngags pa 'gor/ gang lus char sprin phung po ni// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por glang po che la bsngags pa gsungs pa 'di nyid la yig skyon zhugs pa 'dra/ chang la (9)(24) bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'gor/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*// zhes yod pa/ mchod 'os la bsngags pa 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs zhes yod pa/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza'
