(9)(24) lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi rin po che'i 'od zer dri ma med pa 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso// zhes yod pa/ nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa (9) 'gor/ gsal zhing thogs med myur du 'jug /ces yod pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal (9)(24) ba'i sgron me 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ de'i don yang dag par bsdus (9)(24) pa 'gor/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rab byung sogs bsdoms bcu gnyis zhes yod pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal (9)(24) bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag (9)(24) dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba 'gor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od rab gsal zhing*// zhes yod pa/ dh+rū ba gnyis (9)(24) pa'i rtsis 'gor/ na mo gu ru rat+na bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā ya/ gang gi thugs rjes 'gro kun rab bzung nas// zhes yod pa/ lo bdag nyi shu rtsa (9)(24) gnyis kyi rtsis 'gor/ mkhyen pas shes bya kun gzigs nas// zhes yod pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid rin po che'i sgron ma (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ chos 'khor dus kyi bstan (9) rtsis 'gor sangs rgyas bltams pa'i dus la sogs nas zhes yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi'i ngos 'dzin 'gor/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan nas zhes yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i/ gsal (9)(24) byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa rgyal po jim gyin gyi don du dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ yang des rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa la bsngags pa smar khams sgang du sbyar ba/ yang des dam pa'i chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa

(9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ maṅga la yab yum gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum (9)(24) dang phal po che bzhengs pa la bsngags pa 'gor chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes yod pa tsom mdo gnas gsar du sbyar ba/ ji big de mur gyis phal po che/ gser 'od dam pa/ stong phrag brgya (9)(24) pa rnams bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i thugs ni kun nas rnam dag cing*// zhes yod pa shing kun du mdzad pa/ rgyal po a rog ches (9)(24) 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi'i bde legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// zhes yod pa/ go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed 'gor gsung rab rin po che (9)(24) rnam par bkod pa'i mtshon byed ces yod pa smar khams tsom mdo gnas gsar du sbyar ba/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyi yum rgyas 'bring bsdus (9)(24) gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa la bsngags (9)(24) pa 'gor chos bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed nye bar bkod pa bsod nams rin chen zhes yod pa/ zin shing gi ston pa bcu bdun yang dag pa'i rigs pas pham par byas te rab tu byung ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs (9)(24) bcad 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// yod dang med pa la sogs pa// zhes yod pa/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dang slob mas lam nyams su blang ba'i tshul gyi rnam dbye bstan pa (9)(24) 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gtsang mkhas rab brtan byams par ldan// zhes yod pa h+ying hu'i dgon par sbyar ba/

chos rje pa bde bar gshegs dus dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen (9)(24) rnams la spring pa 'gor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// zhes yod pa/ khro phu lo tsā ba la (9)(24) bskur ba dang gdams pa gnyis 'gor/ dpal ldan nyin mor byed pa'i gzi ldan zhing*// zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer gyis// zhes yod pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus (9)(24) gnyis kyi 'gor/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun rnams zhes yod pa dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ bsnyen (9)(24) gnas kyi cho ga 'gor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshul ni zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por 'di gsal kha med kyang phyi mo thams cad na gong gi las chog dang 'brel nas 'dug pas lung rgyun yod pa 'dra/ rgyal po yab sras kyi mchod rten bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor daṇ+ḍa ka (9)(24) 'gor/ na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ dpal dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rgyal bu jim gyin sogs la bsngags pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ bsngags par 'os pa'i rab tu byed pa (9)(24) 'gor tshig de nyid yod pa smar khams kyi sa'i cha tsom mdor sbyar ba/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga po rgyal po go pe la la bsngags par gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad 'gor/ gang gi srid gsum rgya mtsho'i zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por jim gyin la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs 'gor/ srong btsan sgam po me mo glang la 'khrungs/ zhes yod pa shing mo phag gi lor skyar ka mdor sbyar ba/ lung dang brgyud pa sna tshogs kyi gsan (9)(24) yig 'gor/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang zhes yod pa/

'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi brgyud pa nas brtsams te rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa'i bar gyi gsan yig rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ slob dpon bsod nams seṅge'i spyan sngar phrin du (9)(24) zhu ba 'gor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes yod pa chu pho byi ba'i lor ling chung rtser khab kyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa/ grags pa rin chen gyi zhus (9)(24) lan 'gor/ dpal mchog bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis// zhes yod pa 'dam gyi sa cha gang skyar sbyar ba/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong la bka' bsgo gnang ba 'gor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang zhes yod pa gur chen du bris pa/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang 'gor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma kho nar mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong zhes yod pa me mo yos bu'i lor 'dam gyi sa char sbyar ba/ rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas pa la bde legs su bya ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ shing yos dpal (9)(24) ldan ma/ me 'brug (9)(24) bsod nams ma/ me sbrul (9) dpal 'byung ma/ sa rta (9)(24) bkra shis ma/ 'dir lug sprel gnyis la mi snang*/ lcags (9)(24) bya tshe dang ye shes ma/ chu (9)(24) khyi 'gro ba ma/ chu phag (9)(24) bde legs ma/ shing byi gang (9)(24) mnyes ma/ shing glang (9)(24) byang sems ma/ me stag he ru ka dpal ma/ me yos rgyal (9)(24) mtshan rtse mo/ sa 'brug (9)(24) ji snyed ma/ sa (9)(24) sbrul rgyal ba ma/ lcags rta (9)(24) bkra shis ma/ lcags lug (9)(24) chos nyid ma/ chu sprel skyob pa (9)(24) ma/ chu bya dngos (9)(24) grub ma/ shing khyi sa (9)(24) dbang ma/ shing phag (9)(24) bla med ma/

me byi dngos (9)(24) grub ma/ me (9) glang don grub ma/ sa stag (9)(24) gang la bkra shis ma/ sa yos (9)(24) gang drin ma/ lcags (9) 'brug thub dbang chos rgyal ma rnams te lo gsar gyi tshe gnang ba'i bkra shis nyer gsum/ rgyal po maṅga la (9)(24) yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis gcig tu gzhan phan ma/ rgyal po ji big yab (9)(24) yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis sangs rgyas rnam rgyal ma/ dpon mo chen mo la (9)(24) gnang ba'i bkra shis sangs rgyas kun phrin ma/ yang dpal (9)(24) ldan khyed sku lhun po ltar brtan zhing*/ zhes bya ba'i bkra shis sh+lau ka (9) gcig rnams so// 'di dag gi go rim bsgrigs pa'i gzhi ni ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun rnams la zhib tu gtugs tshe/ snga phyi'i go rim 'dra min dang chos tshan mang nyung sogs kyi khyad par 'ga' re mchis kyang*/ 'dir sngon gyi bka' 'bum phal cher dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dang mthun shas che ba byung bas 'ga' zhig de nyid gzhir gzhag da lta'i lung rgyun dpal mchog nas sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan pa 'di nyid khyab che ba snang yang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i de dang snga phyi'i go rim dang chos tshan mang nyung dang*/ bstan bcos kyi ming gzung yang 'ga' zhig gzhung tshig dang*/ 'ga' zhig kha byang las dras nas btags pa sogs kyis las dang po pas ngos zin dka' bar 'dug par/ 'dir gong 'og thams cad kyi khyad par ngos gzung sla ba'i ched du bstan bcos ngos 'dzin dka' ba rnams kyi mgo mjug gi tshig smos pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig gi mtshan byang thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas sgo khyim la aṅgi dgu pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa dgu pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas gsan ltar rtogs pa dang*/

aṅgi nyer bzhi pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas gdan sa nyer bzhi pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan ltar rtogs par 'gyur la/ gzhan paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gsan pa'i lung rgyun ni brgyud pa'i kha skong ma gtogs pa yan chad dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig ji lta ba bzhin yin no// rtags gang yang med pa rnams ni gsan yig na dngos su ma smos kyang glegs bam gyi gras su sngar yod pa dang phyis rnyed pa gsar 'dzud zhus pa rnams yin pas/ slar 'di dag gi lung rgyun brgyud pa yid ches pa las btsal te rgya cher spel dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du bzhag pa yin pas bstan pa rin po che la gces spras byed pa rnams kyis dgongs 'tshal/ ji skad bshad pa'i bstan bcos rin po che de rnams kyi lung mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong ma yab sras gsum po'i gsung rab rnams kyi lung dang glegs bam dang po nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ma byung ba la/ dus phyis bla ma dpal ldan seṅge'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nam rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas rang nyid la gang bzhugs pa rnams mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje dang*/ dbus pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis la gnang*/ ma bzhugs pa rnams mkhan po shes rab rdo rje dang*/ dbus pa rin rgyal gnyis la bkas bskul te phyogs kun tu btang nas lung su yod las zhur bcug cing dpe rnams phyogs gcig glegs bam du bsdebs pa mdzad/ chos rje bla ma dam pas kyang sngar ma gsan pa rnams sher rdor ba las gsan pas lung thams cad phyogs gcig nas brgyud pa med mod/ 'on kyang mkhan po shes rab rdo rjes bla ma so so las gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni lam 'bras la sogs pa'i lam skor dgu/ man ngag gces bsdus dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ des bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// yang na chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ de gnyis ka las chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// 'on kyang gsung ngag rin po che'i skor rnams nyams khrid ma gtogs bklag lung byed pa'i srol med do zhes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan yig rgya mtsho las gsungs/ rgyud sde spyi'i stong thun/ rnam 'grel dag ldan/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa ljon shing*/ gur gyi sa bcad/ rnam bshad/ gur gyi rgyan rnams kyi sgos brgyud ni/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// nag po dkyil chog de'i ṭīk+ka/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/ tshangs pa'i bu mo 'gugs pa/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// sgrol ma spyi sgrub/

so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs/ nyi ma sbas pa'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa'i ṭīk+ka/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ des mkhan po shes rab rdo rje la'o// sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyi ma sbas pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ nag po pa/ gu rub lo tsā ba/ rong pa/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ mchims khu dbon gnyis/ bla ma 'jam gsar ba/ lce mdo sde seṅge/ rong pa shes rab seṅge/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ dā na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ mchims chos kyi seṅge/ mchims blo brtan/ bla ma 'jam gsar ba/ sre'u chung ba/ rje btsun rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong pa shes rab seṅge/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ des mkhan po shes rab rdo rje la'o// sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ grub pa dpal bzang po/ bla ma bzang po pa/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'o// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa byab bsrung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'o// dkar mo nyi zla'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bla chen kun blo/ des chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'o// sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ ṭī ka bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel/ sa bcad/ mal lo'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i ṭī ka che ba/

rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa'i ṭī ka che ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ des dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i sam+pu ṭa'i ṭī ka rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal/ he ru ka'i chas drug gtor ma brgya rtsa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ shes rab rdo rje/ des bla ma dam pa la'o// sgrol ma zhi khro gnyis kyi sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇa chen/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ gar thig pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// rje btsun mi g.yo ba sngon po'i chu srung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// ku ru kul+le sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seṅge/ spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ la ru ba yon tan dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'o// gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇa chen/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ des bag ston pa la'o// dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/

byang chen pa nas/ bag ston pa la'o// rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ spro lung kun smon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ slob dpon rin chen dpal/ bla ma rgyal ba dpal/ bla ma thogs med pa/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// don yod zhags pa'i lo rgyus/ sa bcad/ rgyud chung gi ṭī ka de'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ gtsong po zho ra ba/ la ru pa/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhan chen dwangs ma ba/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ des chos bla ma dam pa la'o// dril bu pa'i dbang chu/ sgrub thabs gnyis dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan gong ltar la/ de nas bo dong rin po che/ khro phu ba rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seṅge/ bu ston rin po che nas/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa la'o// sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭī ka mtshan brjod 'don thabs bcas kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ des mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje la'o// kye rdo rje'i dbang gi chu bo chen mo/ dkyil chog nas gling ma/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa/ de'i rnam bshad/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs gsum/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs/ las bcu/ mchims chos seng la spring yig gzhan phan nyer mkho/ ar+gha'i cho ga kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam skya/ bla ma a mo gha/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje nas/

chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ dril bu rim lnga/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bri thabs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ stod lo/ slob dpon a mo gha/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ ṭī ka nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig ma'i las tshogs dang sa bcad rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma thub pa mgon/ bla ma a mo gha/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// rigs gsum spyi'i rigs gtad/ a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rnams kyi brgyud pa'ang gong dang 'dra'o// dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shangs pa bsod nams rin chen/ slob dpon gzungs 'dus/ rin po che bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan po shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// brtag pa gnyis pa'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ khu dbon gnyis ka las shangs pa bsod nams rin chen/ sras kun rin/ shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// rab gnas bzang po drug pa/ dus tha ma'i cho ga bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dbon 'phags pa rin po che/ cog ro ston gzhon/ chos brtson/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje nas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa'i ṭī ka'i brgyud pa ni/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khams pa dbon po/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ ā ka ra/ sangs rgyas rin chen/

mkhan po shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la'o// tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs che chung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ skyob pa dpal/ gzhon nu bkra shis/ rdo rje dpal/ gu rub shes rab rin chen nas/ sangs rgyas rin chen la'o// kye'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje la'o// klu'i bshad pa la sogs pa mngon rtogs/ bstod pa la sogs pa drug cu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa ni/ sa skya pa chen po yab sras gsum/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seṅge/ shes rab rdo rje nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ klu sgrub nas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyen lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ rin chen grags tshul ba/ mkhan po shes rdo rje nas/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa la'o// de dag rnams las mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mtshungs med nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rin po che dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/

chos kyi rje rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun grub pa khams ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel nas/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra'o// gnyis pa chos rje khu dbon gnyis las/ dang po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung rab rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ chos rje byang chub seṅge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun grub pa khams ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// ༈ //gnyis pa 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che nas/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/

brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ chos rje byang chub seṅge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun grub pa khams ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shar khang ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// yang bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstod pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi tshul du nos shing*/ bstod pa chos rgyal ma/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge g.yag phrug mi pham sangs rgyas dpal gyis mdzad pa/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs bla sgrub tshigs bcad mchan bu ma rnams kyi lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen/ kun mkhyen g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston shes bya kun rig kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ kun dga' chos bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ rab 'byams nor bu phun tshogs/

paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros/ gnas rab 'byams pa byams pa phun tshogs/ nags dgon pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug de sras sngags 'chang bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen e waṃ pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na rong ston nas/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ 'bras mo ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ drin chen tshe dbang bkra shis/ rje tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis so// yang she'u ris blo gros rgyal mtshan nas/ nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa las brgyud pa yang mthong ngo*// ring brgyud ni sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla mchod gong ma tog ti shrī grags pa 'od zer/ sru lung kun dga' smon lam/ byang pa dkon mchog grags pa/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa man 'dra'o// ༈ //rgyal ba'i sras po 'jig rten dbang phyug thogs med bzang po dpal ba'i bka' 'bum gyi skor la/ bshes gnyen thar pa dpal gyis bskul ba'i don du mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen gyi bstod pa sngon sbyangs ma/ byang sems rin chen mgon gyi bstod pa rin po che'i cod paṇa nam spyi gtsug nyi zla ma/ yang de'i bstod pa dad pa skyed byed mkhyen rab ma/ mkhan chen byang chub rtse mos bskul ba ltar mdzad pa'i snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i gsol 'debs sku tshe dpag med ma/ bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs dkar pos bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i chos rje bu ston rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsol 'debs tshogs gnyis ma/

bshes gnyen mi nyag blo ldan dpal dang slob dpon dpal ldan ye shes gnyis kyis bskul ngor mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsol 'debs legs rgyu dge tshogs ma/ bya bral ba dpal rin gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi brgyud 'debs gnas spyi gtsug ma/ dmar khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba shes bya ma lus ma/ bshes gnyen shes rab bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi brgyud 'debs tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs ma/ rten 'brel snying po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs theg bde ma/ bcu gcig zhal gyi smyung gnas brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba 'gro kun ma/ don yod zhags pa lha lnga brgyud pa dang bcas pa la bstod pa 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ma/ sems tsam lugs kyi byang sems sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs mkhyen brtse ma/ bla ma se ston gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i dbu ma lugs kyi smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi brgyud 'debs shes bya ma lus ma/ byams chos pa byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi ngor mdzad pa'i bla chen lugs kyi bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs thams cad mkhyen pa ma/ bshes gnyen shākya ye shes kyi ngor mdzad pa'i sum pa lo tsā'i snyan brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs zag med ma/ skyid sdug lam khyer gyi brgyud 'debs rig pa'i gnas lnga ma/ bla ma se ston gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i snying po don gsum gyi brgyud 'debs rab mdzes ma/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la bstod pa rgyal ba mnyes byed shar phyogs ma/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nus mdzad pa'i chog khrigs ltar sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bstod pa rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa bla med gser mdog ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo'i gleng gzhi las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug gi bstod pa mkhyen rab ma/

sman bla de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal ba bcom ldan ma/ jo bo skor ba rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dang po byang chub ma/ bshes gnyen dpal ldan ye shes kyi ngor mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa tshig rgyan me tog gi phreng ba mtshan dpe cha shas ma/ yang de nyid la bstod pa sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa stobs bcu ma/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la bstod pa mkhyen brtse ma/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i don du mdzad pa'i rgyal sras lag len ma/ gnyen po bsten pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshul bzhin yid byed ma/ sdig spong dge sgrub la bskul ba dge ba dge bshes ma/ chos la bskul ba'i gtam rin po che'i rgyan gser gyi mchod sdong ma/ rang gi sems la gros 'debs pa gang zhig skyon bral ma/ rang la gros 'debs pa'i gtam ang drug ma/ slob ma rnams la snying gtam du gsungs pa dpag yas mkhyen brtse ma/ rang la bskul ba mkhyen brtse nus pa ma/ rang la bskul ba sngar spyad bde sdug ma/ rang gi sems la 'dri bar bskul ba nyon mongs dug lnga ma/ sgo yig dang po bdag la phrad 'dod ma/ sgo yig gnyis pa bdag ni sngon las ma/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa'i cho ga jo bo chen po'i gzhung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin mdzad pa/ jo bo chen pos mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bdag nyid kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'am sems bskyed dang sdom pa rang gis blang ba'i cho ga dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dpal rdo rje snying pos bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha lugs kyi smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i cho ga smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam chen/

las dang po pa 'ga' zhig gi don du gsungs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas bsdus pa/ rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig rten 'brel snying po'i khrid dmigs pa zur 'debs gsum dang bcas pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun legs pa'i ngor mdzad pa'i skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid/ ngan song sbyong ba'i mngon rtogs shin tu bsdus pa/ bya bral ba dpal 'byor bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i 'od dpag med kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bya bral ba dpal 'byor bzang po'i ngor gnang ba'i thugs rje chen po'i gtor ma/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyi chos spyod kyi rim pa la skyabs 'gro/ zas kyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa/ yan lag bdun pa/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ yi dwags kyi chu sbyin/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi/ khrul gtor dzam lha'i chu sbyin/ dkar cha bzhi/ sāts+tsha gdab pa'i rim pa/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa/ yang dag pa'i don spros bral bsgom pa/ rgyal mtshan dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i byang sems rin chen mgon gyi nang rten dkar chag bsod nams 'od zer gyi don du mdzad pa'i lam rim rgyas pa chos tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa'i man ngag pha jo g.yung drung dpal gyi don du mdzad pa'i lam rim bsdus pa yang dag sgrub pa/ yang de'i don du mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las gsungs pa'i yan lag bdun pa/ la shing mkhan po shes rab grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i zhal gdams tshul gnas ma/ bshes gnyen rab rtse nam mkha' grub la gdams pa'i blo sbyong phar phyin drug ldan ma/ yang de la gsungs pa'i zhal gdams thugs rje chen po ma/ stag lung pa shākya dpal bzang po la gsungs pa'i zhal gdams shākya bstan 'dzin ma/ yang de la gsungs pa'i zhal gdams chos brgyad lam du slong ba/

yang de la gdams pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i blo sbyong dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma/ stag lung ka drug pa la gsungs pa'i zhal gdams rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma/ si tu chen po la nag can zhig skyob pa'i phyir du phul ba'i phrin yig mchod gnod ma/ bla ma rdzogs chen pa chos nyid rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan dkon mchog ma/ bshes gnyen dpal ldan ye shes kyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i gnod byed la phan gdags pa'i dam bca' dang smon lam sngon bcom ma/ lhag bsam zla ba ches pas bskul nas dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i thabs yon tan 'od zer ma/ bsod nams dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngos 'dzin thugs rje chen po ma/ drung nas pa'i dris lan bsam mi khyab/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab pa'i smon lam bdag gam bdag bshes ma/ rigs dang bsod nams thugs dgongs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa byams chen par phul ba'i zhu phrin/ chen po bsod nams bzang po'i thugs dam bskul ba sngon chad bsod nams ma/ byang pa dpon shākya bzang po zhabs bsnyun pa'i dus gdams pa/ stag lung sangs rgyas dpal la dam bca' brtan pa'i don du gdams pa gnod byed ma/ slob dpon nam mkha' rin chen dpal bzang po la gdams pa bde lam ma/ des bskul ba'i phar phyin drug gi ngos 'dzin yon tan dkyil 'khor ma/ rong po chos blo'i don du mdzad pa'i dkon mchog gi ngos 'dzin sgrib gnyis ma/ bon po khyi thul gyi sems la phan pa'i gdams pa/ mkhan po lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo'i dris lan rje mnyam med ma/ sa skyar dge bshes shig gis dris lan nad la sogs pa lam du 'khyer tshul bdag zhen ma/ dge bshes shākya bsod nams la gdams pa shāka seng ma/ slob dpon nam mkha' dpal gyi phrin lan/ de la gdams pa dam chos mthar thug rin chen phreng ba phrin las bzang po ma/ gnas rnying pa rgyal dbang la gdams pa blo dkon mchog ma/

slob dpon chen po grags pa rin chen la gdams pa bslab gsum ma/ slob dpon ldong ston gyis bskul ba la brten nas gdams pa phan bde ma/ slob dpon chos blo dbon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gdams pa shes bya ma lus ma/ de la gdams pa chos kyi blo gros ma/ yang de nyid chos la bskul phyir thogs med ces byas sbyar ba/ mkhan chen gro sa ba la phul ba'i zhu phrin yang dag ma/ slob dpon chos mchog la phul ba'i zhu phrin/ de nyid shig nad kyis bsnyun dus su phul ba'i zhu phrin/ bla ma spo tog pa'i don du gdams pa dal 'byor rin chen ma/ sbud skra'i rtogs ldan bsod nams rin chen gyi dam bca' bzhi po brtan pa'i don du mdzad pa dngos grub rtsa ba ma/ 'od zer bzang po la gdams pa nyes pa'i 'byung gnas ma/ yang mgon gdan sa pa bla ma ri pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam gsal 'debs dal 'byor rin chen ma/ rtsibs ri ba slob dpon gzhon nu byang chub kyi dam bca' brtan pa'i don du mdzad pa gzhan phan ma/ sgom chen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gdams pa chos kun ma/ khams pa blo gros dpal la gdams pa dal 'byor mi lus ma/ mi nyag rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi don du gdams pa dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma/ mi nyag bla ma rab ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa la gdams pa snyigs dus ma/ rin po che skyob pa dpal la gdams pa sems rtog med ma/ rgyal sras lag len gyi pha yul spong ba'i skabs su blang dor byed pa dang brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can gnyis po gang yin la 'ga' zhig ma 'cham par rgyal btsugs pa yin zer nas dris ba'i lan/ nam mkha' bzang pos dris pa'i lan dkon mchog ma/ dge slong chos dbang rin chen grogs mched gnyis kyi phrin lan/ bshad gsar ba rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi mol gtam/ ma ṇi ba zla bzang gi drang po'i gtam/ bya bral ba rin chen dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i bsngo ba yon bshad/

dpon rin chen bzang po'i don du mdzad pa'i smon lam bdag gi skye zhing ma/ khams pa ma ṇi pas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i smon lam bdag ni byang chub ma/ dpon rin gyi yum bar ma gser las bzhengs pa'i rab gnas kyi don du mdzad pa'i bkra shis thugs dbang ma/ bshes gnyen rgyal mtshan dar ras rkyang ba'i kha chems dris lan gtum mo 'bar ba ma rnams kyi lung legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug thogs med bzang po dpal// rnal 'byor dbang phyug lo chen byang chub rtse// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bud+dha shrī// mkhyen rab dbang phyug ngor chen kun dga'i mtshan// thugs rje'i dbang phyug mus chen dkon rgyal zhabs// phrin las dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen dpal// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// btsun pa'i dbang phyug brang ti nam mkha' dpal// bzang po'i dbang phyug chos rje dpal grub pa// rgyal kun dbang phyug 'dren pa dpal mchog las// mkhyen

mkhan chen bkra shis lhun pa'i gsan yig tu byung*/ rab dbang phyug sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// grub pa'i dbang phyug kun spangs ku sa li// lung rtogs dbang phyug bkra shis lhun gyis grub// snyom las dbang phyug tshul khrims rin chen la// yang na dbang phyug brgyad ldan dpal mchog zhabs// btsun pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan las// thugs rje'i dbang phyug bkra shis lhun grub kyis// le lo'i dbang phyug tshul rin bdag la'o// yang na rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nas// rgyal ba lha yi mchog gyur seng ge'i mtshan// kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //sgron ma'i bskal pa'i rnam par 'dren pa bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs kyi rgyal srid chen po skyong ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i glegs bam bzhi'i lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa/ shar chen la bstod pa lnga/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ mkhan chen bkra shis rin chen/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rje sa skya pa chen po rnams la bstod pa re/ sdom gsum bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ lam zab brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi kha skong*/ lam 'bras/ bsam mi khyab/ lhan cig skyes grub/ mchod rten drung thob/ yi ge med pa/ pad+ma pa'i lam/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam ste lam skor dgu'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bde mchog rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma'i ring brgyud/ rtsa dbu ma'i nye brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po/ ma hā mā yā/ spros med/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ shin tu spros med/ spyod 'jug zhen pa bzhi bral rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/

'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil chog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ shes phyin dkar mo/ 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu/ nor rgyun ma lha bcu dgu'i bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa/ sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams te de rnams la bstod pa le tshan re/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar gsung sgros ma/ grub chen bud+dha shrī'i rnam thar/ sa bzang 'phags pa'i rnam thar/ rje nyid kyi gsan yig rgya mtsho/ lam 'bras chos 'byung rtsom 'phro/ bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ zhus lan gsal ba'i sa bcad/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ mngon rtogs tshul bzhi'i sdom tshig phyi nang gi bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sdom tshig nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma/ lus dkyil/ rtsod spong che chung*/ rgyud gsum gnod 'joms rtsa 'grel/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams rnam par bshad pa/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud kyi byung tshul dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ brtag gnyis kyi 'gyur chad bsabs pa sh+lau ka gnyis/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i dkar chag kye rdor ḍom+bi lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ phrin yig dbang po rdo rje/ gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par gzhag pa/ 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs dang ḍom+bi lugs kyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog gi tho yig sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod chog 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/

shes phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sbyin sreg gar gyi shan 'byed/ sangs rgyas kyi gar/ phyogs bzhi gtor ma'i gtang thabs/ chos skyong gi man ngag rnams kyi dkar chag mgon rkyang gi sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel las phyung ba/ lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang*/ gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal/ gtor sgrub kyi man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ bka' srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga kye rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ sam+pu ṭa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdo rje dbyings kyi mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg bkra shis dge legs nyi ma rnams dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsang ba kun rgyan/ yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo kun bzang rnam rol/ bde mchog bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rab rgyas/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang gi rnam gzhag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ mkha' spyod kyi man ngag zab mo/ bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshe sgrub/ lwa wa pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan lha bcu gsum pa'i cho ga la dgos pa'i zin bris/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs dang*/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rin po che'i mdzod/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i sngags phreng gsang sngags rin po che'i mdzod mtshan ma/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi snye ma/ mchod phreng bsod nam rin po che'i mdzod/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ de'i gtor chog mchod phreng*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg rab gnas/ bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho/ gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rim shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba/ rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa chog dgra nag gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i char 'bebs/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dag pa/ sgrub thabs kyi lung sbyor/ dkyil chog spros med mdzes rgyan/ kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sgrib pa rnam sel/ kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga cha gsum gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags kyi bshad pa/ spyod rgyud spyi'i rnam gzhag bya rgyud spyi'i rnam gzhag mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga 'phags pa 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog dri med lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang*/ 'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub/ seṅge sgra/ sna tshogs yum/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rta mgrin rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i chog sgrig sems bskyed rang gis blang ba'i cho ga dbu ma lugs/ gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga mchod sbyin chen po'i zin bris/ gtor chen gyi dbang gzugs/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sngags la zhus dag mdzad pa/ dge tshul gyi rags sdom bcu'i bslab bya/ bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag mdor bsdus gcig rdo rje theg pa'i bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mtshan nyid bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag slob ma rnams la spring ba'i yi ge sa bzang pa bsod nams dpal/ lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal/ dge 'dun mgon/ a mo gha/ bla chen chos rin pa/

gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsam bzang*/ dbu ma pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ mdo stod pa bshes gnyen dge bzang rnams kyis dris lan re/ sde snod 'dzin pa rat+na shrī la gdams pa/ gsang sngags pa kun dga' gzhon nu la gdams pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gdams pa dang bsngags pa gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig rgya rong pa bkra shis dpal la gdams pa/ sgrub pa po blo bzang la gdams pa/ nyag re sangs grags la gdams pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la springs pa/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma no bo dhi yab sras la springs pa/ dpon po rgyal mtshan dpal yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ ya tshe rgyal po hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ de'i blon po la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig a ya dbang phyug bkra shis la gdams pa/ dpon rgan thar pa ye shes la gdams pa/ slob dpon bzod chen la gdams pa/ phyi nang gi yas gtam/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam/ der ma thus pa chos rje shar pa'i rnam thar/ 'di man gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por ma bzhugs pas lung rgyun yod med brtag mngon byang gi bshad pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i rnam bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi spyi rnam rtsom 'phro/ kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ bka' shog thor bu ba kha yar rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mun chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ bstan pa'i sgron me sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/

kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de dbon mtshungs med rin chen mchog grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// ༈ //zab cing rgya che'i chos kyi 'dren byed rnam par 'di de sngon ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyi dbang gi bris/ yangs pa mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po (ba) la bstod pa sde snod ma/ yang de la bstod pa (ra) gnyis/ sdom gsum brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong snga phyi gnyis/ gsung ngag brgyud 'debs sogs tshan pa lnga'i kha skong*/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog la bstod pa gnyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/ bstan srung rnams la bstod pa/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra gsum la bstod pa re/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims ( ) kyi rnam thar/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun ( ) dga' bzang po'i rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa/ gsan yig mthong ba dad 'di ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su ma byung*/ 'jug sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho'i gsan tho/ 'dul ba'i brgyud yig dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs ( ) yan lag drug pa/ 'byung po thams cad ( ) pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga bar chad kun sel/ lus dkyil gyi nyams len ( ) lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang chu ( ) gsal ba'i me long*/ kye rdo rje'i sta gon gyi skabs ( ) kyi swa shing sogs kyi dgos pa nyung ngu*/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang gi chu bo chen ( ) mo'i sa chog gi skabs kyi lhan thabs/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gnad kyi gsung sgros zin bris/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim gyi yi ge

bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i lhan thabs/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rim nyams su len pa'i gnad zab mo/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bshad srol las dril bu pa'i zhabs kyi dgongs pa'i lus dkyil bshad pa'i zin bris/ lo nag dril gsum gang 'di rmor gyi gsan yig na ma byung*/ zag gcig gis nyams su len tshul/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi chu bo'i skabs kyi bum bskyed gsal bar bya ba'i lhan thabs/ nag po dkyil chog la dgos pa'i lhan thabs/ bde gshegs sa gzung gi lag 'di rmor pa'i gsan yig na ma byung*/ len/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed kha skong*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ zin bris 'di'i nang du 'jigs byed la dngos yum med pa'i sgrub byed mang du snang ngo*// thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer gyi dgongs pa'i lag len 'di'i nang du sngags spel tshig can zhes pa tshe 'das sam chai mo sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā zhes brjod par bshad de/ jo bo chen po'i phyag na shog dril zhig 'dug pa bstan par zhus pa'i nang du gtsug tor dri med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ kun rig gi rtsa sngags rnams 'dug par bik+ṣu dī paṃ ka ra sarba karma a wa ra ṇa zhes sogs snang zhes khungs 'dren par mdzad snang ngo*// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa dang tshe sgrub kyi man ngag zab mo/ sāts+tsha'i rab gnas bsdus pa/ mkhan po bod+dhi sa twa'i dgongs don gsal byed gtsug tor dri med kyi cho ga'i lag len gyi rim pa/ gcod skor gsum gyi nyams 'di ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams na ma byung*/ len/ skyabs 'gro yan lag brgyad pa/ smon lam lnga pa/ rnal 'byor bla med nas gsungs pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'i grub mtha'i shan 'byed/

de las 'phros rmor pa'i gsan yig na ma byung*/ pa'i rno cha/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len byed tshul/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa/ 'di gnyis ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su ma byung*/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyang pa'i gdams ngag gdams pa phran bu'i skor la/ rje rang la bskul ba'i gdams pa/ gso sbyong rang gi blang ba'i cho ga gro sa mkhan po shes rab bzang po'i dris lan/ ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su 'di gnyis ma byung*/ bdag chen rgya gar ba'i dris lan/ dgon pa bde ba can pa la spring pa'i yi ge dge bshes nam mkha' dpal bzang la gdams pa/ yang dge bshes nam mkha' dpal bzang la gdams pa snying gtam rin chen ma/ bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang la gdams pa gnyis/ bla ma blo rin la gdams pa/ bla ma chos rin la springs pa/ pa nam nang so kun dga' chos skyong la gdams pa/ slob dpon chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi snyan du phul ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rab 'byams sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa/ bsngo ba'i ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su 'di ma byung*/ gtam rnams te gsum 'bum rtags so sor ma phyes pa yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ de dbon dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ de dbon shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ chos kyi snang byed ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang na mus chen nas/ dkon mchog blo gros/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/

mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho// mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis man gong bzhin no// yang na mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan man gong bzhin las/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// g.yung drung gi rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ mus chen nas/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ de dbon kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen pa man 'dra'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub yan gong ltar las/ de nas sangs rgyas seṅge/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// ra'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje nas/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ gling stod pa dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge'i zab mo sngags kyi phyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung rab kyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ bla ma rin 'byung la gsol ba 'debs pa

(mai) bsod nams rab rgyas/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa (mai) bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa/ yang de la bstod pa lha bcas ma/ rje mus pa la bstod pa rnam thar (mai) dang mthun pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun/ yang de'i kha skong gang la yon tan ma/ yang de la bstod pa rin chen dkon mchog ma/ blo gros dbang phyug la bstod pa zab yangs blo gros ma/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug la bstod pa dpal ldan kun dga' ma/ gung ru shes rab bzang po la bstod pa (mai) rgya chen shes bya ma'am phrin las char 'bebs ma/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa kā li la spel ba/ yang de la bstod pa dpal ldan lha dbang ma/ chos rje gung ru la (mai) bstod pa shes bya ma/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i 'grel (mai) pa lugs kyi brgyud 'debs kha skong*/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog brgyud 'debs kha skong*/ sher phyin brgyud 'debs 'gro bla ma/ tshad ma'i brgyud 'debs mtha' dag ma/ byams mgon la bstod pa theg mchog gnad kyi sgo byed/ sgrol ma la bstod pa dngos grub rgya mtsho ma/ gur mgon lha brgyad la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen/ rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa zab mo bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi spel ba/ phar phyin gyi mchod yar/ rnam 'grel gyi mchod yar/ brda 'grol nges pa'i dpal gter/ rje mus pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa (mai) ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ de'i kha (mai) skong dang bcas pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang gi dkar chag gzhal yas khang gi chag tshad sgo sbrags sogs kyi bshad pa le tshan gnyis/ gur rigs (mai) bsdus kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ dkyil chog bde chen rgya mtsho/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi drwa mig bde mchog chos 'byung (mai) / sgrub thabs (mai) mngal sgong sbyong byed/

nag po rim bzhi'i gsung sgros ma'i khrid yig rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub (mai) thabs/ sbyin (mai) sreg tshes bcu'i (mai) mchod pa/ mar me'i sbyin (mai) sreg bde mchog lū hi pa'i rnam bshad 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i dpag bsam ljon pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od/ de'i dkyil chog ye shes rnam rol/ de'i phyi rol tshogs bsags kyi cho ga gtor chog phrin las rnam rol/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi khyad par sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od kyi 'grel pa lam bzang gsal ba'i snang ba/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba'i sgron me/ rdo rje theg pa la log smra tshar gcod pa rig pa'i mtshon cha/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub dkyil/ mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la grangs nges phye ba/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi ṭī ka (wa) gzhan phan kun khyab/ kun rig rtsod spong (wa) gzhan phan gnod 'joms/ kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg (wa) 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul/ sdom gsum (sa) rab dbye'i bsdus don/ sdom pa (sa) gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam bshad gsung rab dgongs gsal/ sdom gsum gyi rab (sa) tu dbye ba'i spyi don legs bshad 'od stong 'phro ba/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab (sa) tu dbye ba'i dris lan sdom gsum 'khrul spong*/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i (sa) kha skong legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba/ de'i bsdus (sa) don/ nyi zla seṅge'i dris lan/ mdo khams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ sngags 'chang rat+na shrī'i dris lan/ ga zi rin chen dpal gyi dris lan/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ ldan ma shes rab seṅge'i dris lan/ sgrub pa ba tshul khrims bzang po'i dris lan/ dris lan (sa) pad+mo bzhad pa/ bka' bcu pa rin chen byang chub kyi dris lan/

blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/ mdo khams la 'bul sdud gnang ba'i bka' shog gyad gnyer dger gsum la bskur ba/ sa skya pa chen po'i nang rten dkar chag karma mi pham mgon po'i bstod pa/ slob dpon kun dga' 'bum gyi bstod pa/ slob dpon sbyin bzang la bstod pa/ gling smad shes rab dpal ldan la bstod pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bstod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i bstod pa/ rje rin po che sku skye ba'i bstod pa/ bde chen mkhan po'i bstod pa/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa'i bstod pa/ sog po bka' bcu pa la bstod pa/ drung chen kun spangs pa la gdams pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ rtags 'jug gi ṭī ka smon lam bcu pa/ smon lam bdun cu pa/ bsngo ba mdor bsdus pa/ dpon drung g.yung pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung gsung ngag bstan pa (mai) rgyas pa'i nyi 'od kyi kha skong dang bcas pa/ snang ba (mai) gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsal byed/ dpal kye rdo rje'i (mai) lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bshad bde chen bcud kyi snying po/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i lam spyi'i rnam gzhag lam dus (mai) kyi dbang bskur tshul/ lam dus kyi dbang (mai) chog gso byed tshul/ bi srung thun mong (mai) ma yin pa'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ rnam 'joms bir lugs (mai) kyi byin rlabs byed tshul/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung bshad a seng ma'i rnam bshad/ bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig kye rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la (mai) brten pa'i rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho/ dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs man ngag snang ba/ kye rdo rje'i mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad (mai) pa man ngag gi gsal byed/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer la rtsod pa

(wa) spong ba gnad kyi gsal byed/ brda 'grol nges pa'i dpal ster/ dbang chu chen mo'i sa chog gi gsal byed dang*/ rgyud kyi tshig don la (mai) dogs gcod/ sam+pu ṭa'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dbang gi chu bo chen po'i rnam par (mai) bshad pa bde chen rgya mtsho/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa/ a seng rdo rje brtan pas sku brnyen phul ba'i mtshon byed/ thub bstan na bzhugs pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku'i ngos nas bshus pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rnam 'joms bir lugs (mai) kyi byin rlabs/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i bris sku'i nang rten gyi dkar chag rten rnying pa la bya (wa) ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga kye rdo rje'i rgyud dang mthun pa'i smon lam/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim dang mthun pa'i smon lam phun (wa) tshogs dge legs ma/ bde ba can gyi smon lam (mai) mi mjed ma ste chos tshan de rnams kyi lung thob pa las mai'i rtags can ma gtogs pa'i yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi spyan ldan bsod nams seṅge/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ brtse chen smra ba'i nyi ma kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mus pa grub pa'i dbang phyug bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rin chen la'o// sa'i rtags can rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ spro lung pa/ dkon mchog grags/ g.yag pa sangs rgyas dpal/

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mkhas pa gzhon nu seṅge/ mun chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge/ rje rat+na war+dha/ sangs rgyas seṅge/ ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ brtse chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mus chen bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ wa'i rtags can rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ ngag dbang chos grags yan gong ltar las/ de nas grub mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mus chen bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bha dra dh+wa dza man 'dra/ rtse'i rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ 'khon bsod nams bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ maṃ g.yung drung can gyi rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ mus chen bkra shis lhun grub yan gong yongs rdzogs ltar las/ de nas mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ gnyis ka las ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho man 'dra/ mai'i rtags can rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thar rtse pa yan gong ltar las/ de las khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub yan gong ltar las/ de nas dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra'o// ༈ //dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mus pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/

thog mar rnam rgyal bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa sh+lau ka gnyis/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i bstod pa sh+lau ka gnyis/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros la bstod pa sh+lau ka gsum/ shes rab blo gros la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig byams pa chos legs la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig ngor chen lha mchog seṅge dang mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis la bstod pa sh+lau ka re re/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam thar/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa'i rnam thar bstod pa dang de'i 'grel pa gnyis ka'i 'gor mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes yod pa/ rje rin po che dkon mchog 'phel ba'i rnam thar yon tan mtha' yas/ lam zab bsdus pa'i 'di dpe ma 'byor nas lung ma thob/ nyams len/ lam 'bras khrid yig dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter/ de'i kha skong shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor zhes sogs yod pa bcas/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'khrul pa spong ba'i gnad kyi gsal byed/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam par bshad pa'i zin bris/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bshad pa'i zin bris/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i phyag len/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pas mdzad pa'i dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i gsal byed 'gor/ tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo zhal bzhis legs par mdzes byas shing zhes yod pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs ma nor gsal ba'i sgron me/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i sgrub mchod kyi ngag 'don zur 'debs/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi phyag len/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gyi lhan thabs dang de'i bkra shis 'gor/ rje btsun 'jam rdor mi bskyod cod paṇa can zhes yod pa dang sh+lau ka gsum/

sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor phyi ma bcu gcig gi bdag mdun bsgrub tshul/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba'i phyag len/ de'i sta gon gyi zur 'debs/ dpal 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phrin las kun khyab/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin po che'i phreng ba/ rong ston chen po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub khyad par can 'gor phyag 'tshal gyi tshig dang*/ 'dir tshe sgrub byed par 'dod pas zhes dang*/ dkar gsum la brten te bsgrub par byas na tshe dang bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang chog 'gor tshe sgrub khyad par 'di'i lo rgyus ni zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i mngon rtogs dang*/ de'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnyis ka la kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i gsung la zin bris su bris pa'i mtha' can/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i mngon rtogs dang de'i bsnyen sgrub byed tshul dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes mngon rtogs sa paṇa de yin/ gnang bya tshul/ phyag rdor u tsār+ya'i rjes gnang byed tshul rjes spyi dang 'dra'o zab zab kyi mtha' can/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang bya tshul 'gor bla ma yi dam chos skyong la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sogs dang bsrung ba dang bkra shis bya'o'i mtha' can/ dpal nag po chen po'i man ngag rtsa gsum la brten pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum 'jam par bsgrub pa/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum rtsub par bsgrub pa/ mgon po 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang bya tshul bsrung ba rnams bya'o'i mtha' can/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa til 'bru tsam yang med par byas par bsam mo'i mtha' can/

mgon po'i gzi brjid bskyed pa btsan po'i mkhar du 'jug pa thod pa kha sprod kyi man ngag go'i mtha' can/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa zlog par byed pa dus tho rangs kyi dus su bya'o'i mtha' can/ brag rdzong 'khon nag zas su za ba'i man ngag ma'i zhal shes zab mo 'di ni zab pas te srod thun gyi mjug tu ma chag par bsgom mo'i mtha' can/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang byed tshul gtor chog lam srung dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan dud sol lha mo'i rjes gnang gtor chog dang bcas pa/ dud sol lha mo'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga gnod sbyin pho mo'i sgrub yig rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi drung du dam pa'i chos thos pa'i tho yig nyin zhag 'di ma byung*/ phrugs re'i nyams len gyi tho/ gcod khrid gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul le tshan gnyis kyi dang po la/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur spyod lam bya'o'i mtha' can dang*/ gnyis pa'i 'gor skyabs 'gro yan lag brgyad pa ni zhes dang*/ byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig dang brgyud rim gyi mtha' can/ gcod skor gsum gyi khrid chung gcod skor gsum gyi nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus te bris so'i mtha' can/ gling kha bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis kun spyod mdzad dgos tshul gyi bca' yig mdo khams kyi 'bul sdud yi ge dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa de rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas bla ma gnyis tsam btsal/ de nas mus chen kun dga' rgya mtsho/

'di yod pa rgyus ldan gyi gsung las thos so// khams ston bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bla chen kun dga' tshe brtan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lhun grub steng gi phan bde gling bla brang du stsal to// ༈ //kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs chos kyi snang byed chen po/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa sgra rgyan me tog dkar po'i phreng ba/ yang de la bstod pa dngos grub kun 'byung*/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen la bstod pa dad pa'i pho nya/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog gi phreng ba/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ngor mus sa gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa snying gi thig le/ yang de gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa la phul ba'i zhu yig bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phul ba'i zhu yig yul khyad par can la mchod brjod kyi tshig ngag gi 'dod 'jo/ phud mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku yi rnam 'gyur drug la nang gi rnam dag dang mthun par bstod pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang la snyan ngag 'khor lo'i sgo nas bstod pa bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug rje lha mchog seṅge la bstod pa mtshan rin po che'i phreng ba/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan/ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i pho nya/

de'i kha skong sh+lau ka gcig lam zab brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ shin tu spros med kyi brgyud 'debs 'od gsal snye ma/ tshe dpag med kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ mgon po'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs phrin las myur 'grub/ byams pa'i rnam thar bstod pa byams chos kyi lam rim gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mi pham dgongs rgyan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa yon tan me tog gi phur ma/ dbyangs can ma la bstod pa don rgyan rnam par bkod pa'i phreng ba/ sgrol ma dkar mo la bstod pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs/ gnyan sgrol dang 'byung 'dul la bstod pa sh+lau ka re/ rje rang la bstod pa che chung gsum/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhi bsgrub pa'i dam bca' smon lam du byas pa/ rang la bskul ba theg chen lam gyi gsal 'debs/ rang la gdams pa gces pa drug ldan/ sdom gsum 'gal med du nyams su len tshul ston pa gdams pa sgo drug sa skya pa'i gdung rabs ya rabs kyi kha rgyan/ hor gyi rgyal rabs 'phros cung zad dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan rtsis nyung ngu rab gsal/ dus 'khor lugs kyi bstan rtsis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar nyin byed snang ba/ sa lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam thar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan rnam par bkod pa/ dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i yi ge thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam tshar gsum khug pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs zab don snying po/ gsung ngag rin po che'i lam khyer gyi smon lam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ man ngag gi brda 'grol zab don snang ba/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing las 'phros pa'i dri ba tshigs bcad ma/

tshul dang po gsum gyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis ston pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i don nyung ngu'i ngag gis ston pa ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing gi gsal byed/ legs par bshad pa gong ma'i dgongs rgyan/ bdag med ma'i bstod pa'i bsdus don/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi bsdus don tshang bde nyung gsal/ gsung ngag gi sngon 'gro'i nyams len snang gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ lam gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig rgyud gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes gzung gi cho ga kye rdo rje'i dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod/ kye rdo rje'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor lung dang man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa/ sa chog mdor bsdus/ dbang gi chu bo chen po mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa'i cho ga dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan/ de'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi ngag 'don lus dkyil mdzes rgyan/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len gsal ba'i me long*/ de la ltos pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho yig bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig 'grel pa lugs kyi kye rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil ḍom+bi mdzes rgyan/ pad+ma lugs kyi kye rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil mtsho skyes mdzes rgyan/ nag po lugs kyi sku gsung thugs snying po kye rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil nag po mdzes rgyan/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor chog mdzes rgyan/ mgon po'i bsnyen pa byed tshul rdo rje gur gyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed rab gsal snang ba/ sam+pu ṭa rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed nyung ngu rab gsal/ bde mchog lo nag gnyis kyi dkyil chog gsal byed khyad par bzhi ldan/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul/ 'di mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyan/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron me/ bde mchog dpa' bo drug dang dpa' mo drug gi sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa re/ rdo rje lha mo'i bzlas bsgom la brten nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i man ngag gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying po/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bklag pas don grub/ dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis/ 'jigs byed skya lugs kyi khrid yig gsung sgros ma/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rab gsal snang ba/ de'i sgrub thabs dang gtor chog gi gsal byed bsnyen sgrub rnam rol/ rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig nyin byed snang ba/ 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg las gshin lha bcu gsum ma'i gtor chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ kun rig dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal kun dga'/ kun rig gi sbyin sreg ro sreg sāts+tsha rab gnas kyi cho ga dang bcas pa/ bya spyod kyi thig tshon byin rlabs/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil chog 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog las sgrib rnam sbyong*/ de'i sbyin sreg bum gter gzhug tshul/ ḍom+pi pa'i nyin srung mtshan srung gi byin rlabs kyi tho/ ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang byed tshul/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi yig rnying la mchan bu btab pa/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul/

sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs stong mchod rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi bum chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med dkar po'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ seṅge sgra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga gnyan sgrol gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga u tsār+ya'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dzam ser nag gi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa re/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa re/ so 'brang gi sgrub thabs/ 'chi med rang gzungs zhes bya ba lus bsrung ba'i man ngag gi sgom bzlas/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag klu sgrub lugs kyi phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs/ phyag bzhi pa lha mang gi rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam sras kyi gtor chog de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab bya/ yas gtam rin po che'i phreng ba/ bsngo ba'i bstan bcos rin po che'i me tog mkhas pa blo gros bzang po/ bsam yas lha btsun pa/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer/ zhu ston bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gnas 'ji chos rje/ bla ma byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen bkra shis dpal ldan/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ chos rje legs blo ba/ rab 'byams 'od blo ba/ chos rje grags pa ba/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ war skya chos rje/ chos rje bsam 'phel ba/ shi ri chos rje khu dbon gsum/ ri khrod pa sbyin pa 'od zer rnams la bstod pa re/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer la phul ba'i zhu yig me tog gi chun po/

lha btsun ma gur rgyal la phul ba chos gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ mi dbang ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phul ba gzugs kyi me long*/ de la phul ba'i zhu yig yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba/ sde pa rin chen dbang rgyal la phul ba/ pa nam lhun grub rtser phul ba gnyis/ shi ri chos rje/ dbon btsun seṅge rgya mtsho/ nang so dpal ldan don grub rnams la gdams pa re/ 'dzam thang sku skye/ gnas 'ji chos rje/ bla ma byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bkra shis dpal ldan/ rab 'byams pa shes rab bzang po grogs mched/ glo bo sde pa/ mi chen dpon rnams la phul ba'i zhu yig re/ ru thog jo bo la phul ba gsum/ dpon chos mdzad pa la gdams pa/ mngon rtogs ljon shing las 'phros pa'i dris lan nges don gsal ba/ gsang ba sgo 'byed las 'phros pa'i dris lan zab don snying po/ a ldong bla ma'i dris lan ngang pa'i pho nya/ gnas brtan chos skyong dpal ldan gyi dris lan/ kun gzhi'i skabs kyi dka' gnas gsal byed/ brgal lan tshangs pa'i rig sngags kyi don bsdus don tshan brgyad pa/ brgal zhing brtags pa'i lan mtha' bral bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ mdo khams su 'phul bskul gyi yi ge dkar chag gi yi ge ngo mtshar dpal gyi phreng ba/ rnga bo che la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa sogs tshigs bcad thor bu ba kha yar rnams bcas kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mtshungs med dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje btsun brang ti pa/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //e waṃ thar pa rtse pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung 'bum gyi lung thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar bka' drin thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bstod pa mtshan rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba/

so thar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub la bstod pa tshogs gnyis chu gter ma/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge la bstod pa/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rgya chen ye shes zhes bya ba/ rdor phreng bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i char 'bebs/ rdor phreng brgyud 'debs mnga' ris tshul 'od pas mdzad pa'i kha skong*/ rang bstod thugs rje nam yang ma zhes bya ba/ yang gang gi blo gros ma/ brtan bzhugs kyi gsol 'debs nyung gsal zhes bya ba/ bdag po kun dga' bde legs la bstod pa brtse chen kun dga' zhes bya ba/ chos rje blo gros grags pa la bstod pa/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge'i bka' 'bum dkar chag rje shar khang pa'i gsung 'bum dkar chag bshes gnyen bsod nams rgya mtsho la bstod pa/ rje lha mchog seṅge'i rnam thar/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge'i rnam thar dad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dad pa'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa'i yi ge dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len/ bir srung thun mong ba'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ sa bdag lto 'phye'i lag len 'khrul med/ kye rdor rab gnas kyi rten bskyed kyi cho ga'i gsal byed bsod nams rab rgyas/ kye rdo rje'i dbang bshad las spyi'i bshad pa mdor bsdus/ kye rdor la brten pa'i dus tha ma'i cho ga'i lag len gzhan phan mtha' yas/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg drag po'i sbyin sreg gi sdom/ gur gyi cho ga'i tho/ sam+pu ṭa'i zin bris pad+ma kha 'byed/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor tho yig dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bya tshul mthong ba don ldan/

bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi sgrub thabs gsang don rab gsal/ de'i smin byed kyi tho yig gsang don rab gsal bkod pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor phrin las rgya mtsho mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ yang gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor zab don bsdus pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi lhan thabs rin po che'i phreng mdzes/ de'i dbang bshad sogs kyi bsdus pa/ gshed dmar gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor zhes sogs bsdus pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i sgrub dkyil mdzes rgyan rnams dang*/ gzhan yang kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor gzhan phan mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang chog gzhan phan rgya mtsho/ phyag rdor 'chi 'joms kyi bsnyen pa byed tshul/ bar do chos bshad/ gdon 'grol gyi cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tho yig 'chi med char 'bebs/ yang tshe dpag med kyi dbang bshad/ tshe dpag med kyi dbang gi cho ga 'chi med 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ tshigs bcad byas pa gcig kyang snang*/

rab gnas mdor bsdus kyi phyag len/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig don 'grel 'dod dgu'i ljon shing rin po che'i snye ma/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ 'jam dkar gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i dme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ dbyangs can lha mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ de'i kha skong*/ sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ seṅge'i gdong can sngon mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ seng gdong dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ rta mgrin jo bo lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ ri khrod ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ yang ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ so 'brang gi rjes gnang gi tho/ shes phyin gyi rjes gnang*/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rjes gnang*/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ 'jam dpal smra seng gi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ lha mo sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang sogs bya tshul/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i cho ga gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po lha bcu gnyis kyi rjes gnang sogs/ gnyan mgon dang pu tra'i rjes gnang*/ mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha mangs kyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul bklag pas don grub/ mgon po trak+ṣad lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul/ dpal ldan sa skya'i shar dbyangs su grags pa'i dbyangs chen bco brgyad kyi grangs 'dren tshul/ gtor ma brgya rtsa'i kha skong bsam 'phel don grub/
