bde mchog kye rdor/ 'jigs byed/ kun rig tshe dpag med rnams kyi bsnyen thabs/ dris lan mdor bsdus/ mkha' lding dang*/ 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'dul ba'i las chog bsngo ba'i bstan bcos/ mdo khams su 'bul bskul gyi yi ge dge bsnyen dang skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa 'bogs chog gaṇ+ḍi'i rnam dag lnga bsdus gza' lnga sogs kyi rtsis/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'di gnyis ka dgos mi dgos brtags/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ de'i dbon/ shar pa ye shes bzang po/ mkhan 'di man cung zad brtag dgos/ chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //mkhas shing grub pa mchog gi sa la gshegs pa e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag paṇa chen de nyid kyi rnam thar tshigs bcad ma byin rlabs kyi gter chen dad ldan kun gyi re skong zhes bya ba/ bla ma'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshig rgyan gsal byed ces bya ba/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa dad pa'i chu skyes/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa/ yang de nyid la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje la bstod pa skal ldan dad skyes/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa bod kyi dbyangs gsal dang spel ba dad pa'i zhing sa zhes bya ba/ 'khon ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad zol med pad dkar phreng ba/ byang sems sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi gter chen zhes bya ba/

rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa blo gros rgyas byed/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la thugs rjes bskul ba'i phyir rgyang nas 'bod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub kyi char 'bebs/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa lung gi snye ma/ ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la bstod pa/ dbyangs can ma la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs/ sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'i mngon par rtogs pa skal bzang lam mchog 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs gegs sel dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub thabs nyin byed ces bya ba blo gros kyi pad+mo kha 'byed cing mi shes smag rum sel byed/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge'i rjes gnang gi cho ga bklag pas don grub/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi cho ga 'phags pa mnyes byed dmar khrid kyi 'pho ba/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi nyams len gyi snying po rab tu gsal ba/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga seṅge'i sgra'i bsnyen thabs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten nas char pa 'bebs pa'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la lam 'bras kyi bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang gi gsal byed/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi sngon 'gro rgya cher bshad pa blo gsal rab dga'/

dpal kye rdo rje la brten nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam par bshad pa ye shes me dpung*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bsdus don gsang gsum rigs gsum spyi'i slob ma sta gon gyi skabs kyi tho/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam srid gsum mun sel la na bza' sna lnga phul ba'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa/ chos gling drung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ bar do ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag thar lam gsal byed/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rnam par gzhag pa gser 'gyur rtsi'i phung po/ bsngo ba bsdus pa/ rgyal mo rong pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ mkhas pa'i dris lan 'khrul med rab gsal zhes bya ba'i 'bru gnon/ rab 'byams kun dga' bkra shis kyi dris lan don tshan lnga pa/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i chos skor gyi rnam gzhag rab tu gsal ba/ rje nyid kyi sku bstod sh+lau ka gcig yang bstod pa rnam dag smon lam ma/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas la bstod pa nam mkha' lta bur yangs pa'i mkhyen rab ma/ blo gsal mgon po dpal bzang la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ lha mo la 'dod don bcol ba/ dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma phul ba'i cho ga bar chad kun sel/ dpal mgon po legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub skor nyin byed snang ba/ lam 'bras 'di de sngon ma thob/ slob bshad snang gsum khrid yig la dpyad pa/ gsung rab kyi gnad la bris 'di ma byung*/ pa tshigs su bcad pa lhag bsam rab dkar/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen thabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes grangs kyis mtshon pa'i tsheg bar dang tshigs bcad sogs yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khams ston kun dga' tshe brtan/ grub dbang bkra shis bzang po/ mtshungs med nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //brtse chen snying po'i bstan pa'i snang byed chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi lung nos pa'i chos tshan gyi rnam grangs la/ rgyas pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rin 'byung gi skor gyi yig rnying dang rje rang gis mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig bstar ba las/ dang po paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung dmar chos kyi rgyal pos zin bris su bkod pa/ gnyis pa spyan snga chen po tshul khrims bzang po'i zin bris/ gsum pa mnga' ris tshul 'od kyis mdzad pa/ bzhi pa kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ lnga pa sa skya lo tsās mdzad pa/ drug pa brang ti paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ bdun pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i nyams len byin rlabs dang bcas pa rnams/ gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang gsol 'debs 'dod don lhun grub phan yon dang bcas khrigs chags su bkod pa/ bla ma rin 'byung gi bsnyen thabs dpal 'byor rab rgyas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lhan thabs jo 'bum ma'i dgongs don/ rgwa a gnyan dam pa kun dga' grags kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rnam thar legs bshad chu bo 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar 'phros dang bcas pa/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dad pa'i gsal 'debs/ rgyal rtse pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar byin rlabs char 'bebs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang lhun grub dpal ldan gyi rnam thar legs byas dpal gyi dga' ston/ dam pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen kha skong dang bcas pa/

de'i sa bcad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas mchog po tā la'i zhing bkod khang bzang gi dkar chag bde skyid dpal 'byor yongs 'du'i tshal/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi man ngag sku gsum lam byed snying gi thig le/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drug cu pa'i gtor chog phrin las char 'bebs kyi go don nor bu'i phreng ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs 'khor paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho'i ngag 'don bkod pa/ bskang gso'i phyag len brjed tho/ gnod sbyin chen po beg tse lcam dral gyi phyi rten zung 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi cho ga 'dod don lhun grub rnams dang*/ ༈ /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*/ yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad/ bla ma la gsol 'debs phur tshugs/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan la bstod pa/ shar pa ye shes bzang po la bstod pa/ yang de nyid khu dbon la brtan bzhugs/ shes rab rgya mtshor brtan bzhugs/ phun tshogs rdo rjer gsol 'debs/ kun legs la bstod pa/ dam chos bsam 'grub la gsol 'debs/ kun dga' dpal 'byor la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bstod pa/ rang bstod kha skong bcas/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la bstod pa gnyis/ shes bya bzang por bstod pa gnyis/ kun rin la brtan bzhugs/ shes rab don bzang la bstod pa/ gser mdog mkhan po la bstod pa/ shes rab rin chen la bstod pa gnyis/ gnam kha'u par bstod pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba la gsol 'debs/ grub thob thang stong rgyal por bstod pa/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis la brtan bzhugs/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bka'i bla brgyud la gsol 'debs/ dril bu pa lugs kyi brgyud 'debs/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong*/ gser mig 'khyil pa'i brgyud 'debs/

rnam dag ma/ rigs lnga'i khyab bdag ma/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ kun rig gshed dmar lha lnga/ kun khyab ma/ lam zab rnams kyi brgyud 'debs kha skong re/ blo sbyong don bdun brgyud 'debs/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rjer bstod pa/ lha mo dbyangs can mar bstod pa/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa/ bka' 'gyur pod grangs/ mtshan nyid skabs kyi grangs chen tho/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka'i gsung zer/ grags pa rgyal mtshan bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang*/ ku sa li'i tshogs bsags kyi ngag 'don/ lus dkyil gyi ngag 'don/ yum bka'i 'pho ba khrigs chag tu bkod pa/ rnal 'byor mar nyer mkho'i reg zig bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug oṃ gsum ma'i sngags don 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung lan/ gnas lugs sgom pa'i lhan thabs yid kyi mun sel/ khrid kyi snying po gnas lugs gcer mthong*/ lta sgom 'bel gtam byung ba'i brjed tho/ rgas po mdzub tshugs kyi gdams ngag kye rdor lam dus la mkho ba'i zin bris/ gzhal yas khang gi cha tshad mdor bsdus/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ rdo rje myu gu'i go don rags bsdus/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le/ yang dmar khrid kyi tho/ spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad dang gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs gnyis/ skyer sgang lugs kyi yig drug nyer mkho/ mgon po khro bcu'i phyi khrid bdud dpung tshar gcod/ de'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tho/ gur mgon lha dgu'i sbyin sreg gi lhan thabs/ gsung ngag lam 'bras 'chad pa'i tho yig gnad kyi lde mig yang lam 'bras 'chad skabs kyi tho chung*/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor dam pa'i zhal lung*/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sdom/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gsung sgros phyag len yid kyi mun sel/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg me shel rab 'bar/ bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig gi gsal byed/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang gi zur 'debs/ gri gug lha lnga snyan brgyud ma dang*/ mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi zur 'debs/ las gshin lha bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang gi spyi bshad/ tshe dpag lha dgu'i sbyin sreg sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg sgrol dkar zur 'debs/ sgrol ma 'don thabs kyi brjed byang*/ mgon dkar sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po/ mgon dkar kyi sbyin sreg bklag pas don grub/ mgon po stag zhon gyi bskang gso phrin las myur 'grub/ phyag drug nag po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ rnam thos sras kyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ rgyun khyer gyi bsangs yig bsdus pa rnams dang*/ ༈ /dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa dbang gi rgyal po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa'i bsdus don/ so thar gyi mdo'i sdom tshigs su bcad pa/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i tho chung*/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug seṅge sgra'i brgyud khungs dang phyag len gyi tho/ ka lā pa'i spyi don nyung ngu*/ e waṃ sgra sgrub/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa spyi'i rnam thar gyi 'phros/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba/ rje btsun pa rang gi rtogs brjod nges 'byung gtam gyi rol mtsho/ rje rang la gros 'debs gnas lugs gsal ba/ rje rang la bskul ba sarga gsum pa/

rje rang la bskul ba brtson 'grus lcags 'debs/ ma yengs dran bskul/ chos la bskul ba'i yi ge yid 'byung skyo ba'i nyams mgur/ dam bca' brtan pa'i gsal 'debs/ gdong bzhi par phrin bcol rang mtshang gsal ba'i me long*/ skyo shas kyi gdung glu/ nyams len chig dril gyi gdams pa/ snyigs ma'i snang tshul la skyo ba'i gtam/ dpal ldan bla ma legs pa'i mtshan can gyi gsung lan/ dge slong dpal ldan rin chen gyi dris lan/ rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyis lam 'bras snang gsum skabs kyi dogs sel/ la stod lha lung gdan sa pas lam 'bras la dris pa'i lan/ shes rab rin chen gyis kye rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs la dris lan gsal ba'i me long*/ 'jigs byed chos skor gyi dris lan/ dge slong dpal ldan phrin las dang ye shes rdo rje dpal ldan rin chen rnams kyi dris lan re/ shar pa ye shes bzang po la phul ba'i zhu shog 'bum rab 'byams pa bkra shis chos 'phel dang*/ rang gi slob ma shes rab lhun grub/ bka' bcu pa kun dga' bsam 'grub rnams la gdams pa re/ rab gling bla mar bskur ba'i smon gsol/ ngor lugs sgrub mchod kyi tshogs skad bca' 'grigs/ bsngo smon sogs khang bris pa'i tshigs bcad bsngo ba'i bstan bcos la dgos rgyu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab don gcod kyi khrid yig theg chen lam gyi gsal 'debs/ theg pa chen po gcod kyi snying po bsdus pa'i lag len/ gcod kyi nyams len mdor bsdus snying po gsal ba/ gcod zab mo don gyi nying khu/ gnyags ston sangs rgyas dpal thang pa bsam gtan 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i zur 'debs/ khros nag lha lnga'i phyag len gyi dogs dpyod/ khros nag bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gi tho/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang chog gi zur 'debs/ tshe dbang lcags gdong ma'i lhan thabs/ bum gter gyi lhan thabs/

sil gtor brgya rtsa'i lhan thabs/ gur drag phrin las kyi gzhung bsdus thabs kyi tho/ ro sreg nyer mkho'i lhan thabs nyung ngu*/ kye rdor la brten pa'i dus tha ma'i cho ga'i lag len gzhan phan mtha' yas las ro sreg zur phyung*/ kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po/ kye rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa dpyid kyi nying khu/ bla ma'i sku rim brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga tshogs gnyis lhun po/ gtor bsngo brgya rtsa sogs byed pa'i phyag len 'dod don lhun grub/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang rab tu gsal ba/ khyung nag gi rjes gnang gsal ba'i sgron me/ mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang bdud las rnam rgyal/ 'dod lha rnams kyi bsnyen pa'i lag len rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i yi ge dngos grub bang mdzod du bzhugs pa ni/ go

1 rams pas mdzad pa'i bsnyen thabs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ sa los stag lung 2 sgrub chen la gnang ba/ dkon mchog dpal ldan 3 pas mdzad pa'i yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen thabs/ brang ti paṇa 4 chen gyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor gzhi bsnyen byed pa'i thabs/ yang 5 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen thabs/ rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen 6 thabs tshogs bsags pas mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen thabs 7 brang ti pas mdzad pa/ yang des mdzad pa'i kun rig gi bsnyen 8 thabs dang*/ tshe dpag 9 med kyi bsnyen thabs/ mi 'khrugs 10 pa'i bsnyen thabs dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ yang seṅge 11 sgra'i bsnyen thabs dpal grub pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam 12 'joms kyi bsnyen thabs/ chos skyong gi bsnyen thabs 13 dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa/ gnyan 14 mgon gyi bsnyen thabs paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ bcu gcig 15 zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba/ a ra 16 pa tsa na dpa' gcig bsnyen thabs/ rigs gsum spyi'i bsnyen 17 thabs tshogs gnyis lhun grub/ bde mchog dril 18 bu pa'i bsnyen thabs/ yig 19 brgya'i bsnyen thabs/ dbyangs can 20 ma'i bsnyen thabs/ gur drag 21 nyang lugs kyi bsnyen thabs/ gu ru drag 22 mthing rgod ldem gyi bsnyen thabs/ las 23 gshin bsnyen thabs/ rang gzhan gyis snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang sna tshogs pa mang rab zhig dang*/ sde dge'i lcags rdzong mgon khang gi dkar chag snyan shal gyi zhal yig brgyad stong gsar bris sum bid kyi dkar chag gdong spras rten bzhengs kyi dkar chag dpon bir thu kha'i bka' 'gyur bzhengs byang*/ sangs rgyas rgya mtshor bstod pa/ bsod nams brtan pa'i ring 'tsho/ rnal 'byor pa g.yos dge bar bsgyur ba'i gdams pa/ rang la bskul ba'i tshigs bcad yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba/ sdom gsum brgyud 'debs snying gi bdud rtsi/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma/

sgrol mar byin rlabs gnad 'bebs kyi smre sngags/ bla ma rgyang 'bod dpyid kyi rgyang glu/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil/ dbang gi brjed byang bklag chog yid kyi mun sel/ sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi'i cho ga bklag chog 'dod don lhun grub/ shes phyin nyams len gyi lhan thabs/ grib ma khrus sel gyi lhan thabs/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i lhan thabs sangs rin gyis mdzad pa la sbyor rgyu/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i bsnyen thabs bris sku'i dmigs bsal bcas/ khyung nag gtor ma'i gsal byed/ dbyangs can nyams len yan lag gsung bsngo/ nā ro mkha' spyod brgyud 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i kha skong*/ sku skye bsod nams brtan par phrin yig chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan gyis kun rig dbang gi dogs gcod/ kun rig skyabs yul gyi tho chung*/ rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma'i tshig 'grel mdor bsdus/ lam zab bla mchod brgyud pa'i kha skong*/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid brgyud pa'i kha skong*/ mgon po'i chos skor brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong*/ rnam rgyal mchod rdzas kyi shis brjod/ sde dge'i mgon khang gi blos slong dang 'chams sku rnams kyi tshigs bcad/ sha chang spang ba'i dam bca' brtan byed/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi mtshan don mdor bsdus/ tshe ring ljongs kyi tshigs bcad/ lam 'bras gser bris bzhengs byang*/ kun dga' rgya mtshos kun rig zhus lan/ brag rdzong ma'i dbang gi sbyin sreg brag rdzong ma'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dgon gnas kyi bca' yig lhag bsam rab dkar/ bskor phyag gi phan yon rnams dang*/ brjed byang lung gi be bum dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal la yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad/ sde dge grwa tshang la gdams pa/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang gi sngon 'gro bsdus pa/ skra sen gyi sbyin sreg man ngag gces pa/ rtag gtor gyi gsal byed/

mi min gcod pa zla ba la gtam du brjod pa/ dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge dbang gi rgyal po rnams te glegs bam rin po che bzhi bzhugs pa'i glegs bam dang po gnyis kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ glegs bam phyi ma gnyis kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// //gnyis pa ni/ de dag kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ston pa'i bka' lung rin po che gangs can pa'i brdar 'gyur ro cog gi skor las rang gi skal ba mchog gi snod du cha shas lhung ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba ste/ de'ang lha klu mi dang dri za la sogs pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal ba la brten nas dbang por 'tsham pa'i drang nges kyi chos so so'i skad dang mthun par bka' stsal pa ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' bzhin rtogs par dka' bas nyan rang gi slob mi slob kyi 'phags pa rnams dang srid pa rgyun gyi tha ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang 'di tsam mo zhes tshad gzung bar mi nus na so so skye bo rnams kyi yul lta ga la zhig 'on te rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig yul dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs su byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum mdzad/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi sa lam mthon por gshegs pa'i grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs skyes chen du mas 'thor ba sdud pa dang 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i mched zlar 'phags pa'i yul du bzhugs pa las byang phyogs gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir mod rgyud chu klung gi rgyun ltar ji snyed cig nye bar babs pa'i thog ma pho brang yam bu gla sgang gi yang thog tu dpal kun du bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri bzhugs pa'i phyag tu nyi zer dang lhan cig par gser shog la bai ḍūr+yas bris pa'i dpang skong phyag brgya pa/

mdo sde za ma tog babs pas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ lag na pad+ma mi'i gzugs can srong btsan sgam po'i dus 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa thu mi sam+bho ṭas rin po che tog gi gzungs/ sher phyin 'bum pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bsgyur ba sogs kyis bstan pa'i srol btod/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sprul pa rje khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan slob gnyis dang bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i bstan pa'i snang byed du gyur pa'i lo paṇa mang po bla'i mchod gnas su bkur te theg pa che chung gi bka' dang dgongs 'grel mtha' klas pa bsgyur nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus ban+de dpal brtsegs/ chos kyi snying po/ de wan+dhe/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la sh+lau ka bam grangs thems byang bkod par dkar chags ṭang thang ma zhes bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yin zhing*/ de rjes ban+de dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang pos bsrungs sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs nas dkar chag ldan dkar ma mdzad/ btsan po khri lde'u srong btsan 'on ldang rdo na bzhugs pa'i dus su nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi/ dā na shī la/ bo dhi mi tra dang*/ bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ dharma tā shī la/ lo tsā ba dzñā na se na/ dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī warma/ nā len+da rat+nen+d+ra shaṃ la sogs lo paṇa rnams la sngon lha sras yab mes kyi ring la lo paṇa rnams kyis chos skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas 'ga' zhig chos kyi gzhung dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa rnams dpyad pa gyis shig par bka' gnang ste 'gyur rnying mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang gzhan pa'i mkhan po chen po nā gārdzu na dang ba su ban+dhu sogs kyis ji ltar bshad pa dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang yang bstun te 'jal dka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/

skad rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra ji bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags par rigs pa rnams kyang don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas lo paṇa rnams kyis rje blon gdan 'dzom pa la zhus nas skad gsar bcad bye brag tu rtogs byed che 'bring chung gsum gyis gtan la legs par phab/ sngar ma 'gyur ba mang po gsar du bsgyur/ bstan pa phyi dar la paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti/ jo bo chen po mar me mdzad/ kha che paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa shākya shrī sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang*/ lo chen rin bzang dang 'brog mi sogs 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu mang du byon te mdo rgyud kyi bka' bstan bcos mtha' klas pa bsgyur zhing*/ bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma 'jam dgag pa shis rgya nag nas bka' 'gyur ro cog bzheng ba'i cha rkyen du dngos po mang du bskur ba la brten nas 'dul ba lung gi ma dpe sngon mchims nam mkha' grags kyis bzhengs pa dang*/ mdo sde'i skor chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog gtsang chu mig ring mo'i mdo mang 'dar phyar bas bzhengs pa/ gru spangs rtsa'i thugs dam 'dzam gling rgyan/ zhwa lu gser khang gi mdo mang mchims kyi thugs dam gser gzhung ma/ phyugs rgyal ma/ dgon gsar ma le tshan/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang na zhugs pa'i mdo mang sogs gung bsgrigs/ sher phyogs rgyud 'bum dang bcas pa dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang pos sgo bstun te go rim 'khrul pa med par dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs/ mkhas pa chen po bcom ldan ral gris dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ ma phyi de nyid las tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros si tu thams cad mkhyen par grags pas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston tshal du bka' 'gyur gyi rab gnas la gdan drangs dus tshal pa dbon po'i kha ya byed dgos yod ces dpe mang po bsnams nas lam du gzigs skad do//

kyis skyid shod tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pas tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes grags che/ bka' 'gyur sngon ma rnams kyi rgyud 'bum du gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal rgya pho ba lung pas brtsams pa sogs rgyud brdzus ma kha yar dang mdo mang nas kyang dogs pa'i gnas su gyur pa rnams phyir dbyung*/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud rnams slar zhus dag cig mdzad bzhed kyis re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag ste shin tu kha gtsang ba snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches dkar chag tu btab nas zhwa lu gser khang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas rim gyi mched pa rnams la them spang mar grags pa ste/ de dag las mched de bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams su bka' 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam lus can bsod nams kyi rten du mang por 'phel te/ de dag yi ger 'dri ba las kyang thos bsam sgom gsum du bya ba ni chos spyod bcu'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu bsngags pa la dgongs nas sngon byon dam pa du mas 'bad pa chen pos nye bar btsal ba'i lung gi rgyun mtshan nyid pa nyan bshad bya ba ni/ chos spyod bcu'i nang nas ches mchog tu gyur par bsngags pa dang*/ bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i bya ba yang nyan bshad sgom gsum las gzhan 'ga' yang med pa la dgongs nas/ bsil ldan ljongs 'dir gang dag byon pa'i bstan skyong gi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos la gzu lum dbang cher spyod pa'i srol ngan thog mtha' bar gsum mar grags pa'i lung dang*/ dba' ba shur mar grags pa'i lung dang*/ 'thor klog mar grags pa'i lung dang*/ lcags ri mar grags pa'i lung dang*/ snga ma'i thob yig gi lung gnang bas der gsal gyi lung mtha' dag thob par 'dod pa dang*/ dpe khang du khrid nas smon lam mdzad pas/ der bzhugs so cog gi lung thob par 'dod pa dang*/ dpon slob ngos kyis ma mjal bar dgongs pa gtad pa las byung ba'i dbang lung dgongs gtad ma zhes grags pa'i rang dga'i lha chos thos lo tsam gyis bstan pa la rma srol 'byin pa'i lugs ngan gyi rgyun mthud lta bu ma yin par/

mthar chags su bklags pa'i lung gi rgyun tshad ldan gang dag bzhugs pa las/ khengs pa bskyungs te 'bad rtsol chen pos gsan pa dang bshad pa'i rgyun mi nub par chu bo chen po'i rgyun bzhin du da lta'i bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs pa las/ rang gis kyang cung zad re mnyan du yod pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi lus las snying po mchog blangs par 'gro ba yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo las rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gis dzam+bū'i gling gi sems can de dag thams cad 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la 'jog cing*/ bzhag nas lha'i lo stong du yo byad thams cad kyis mi brel bar rjed cing mchod pa bas/ gang gi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang nyan pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ 'dri ba dang*/ 'drir bcug pa dang*/ gzhan la rgyas par byed na/ de bas 'di ches bsod nams mang du 'phel lo zhes dang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang*/ gang gis dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa dang*/ gang yi ger 'dri ba dang*/ gang yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang*/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun du rgyas pa mngon par shes pa gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung ngam/ bstan tam/ thos sam/ yi ger bris sam/ yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ glegs bam du byas te bsti stang du byed pa dang*/ btsun par byed pa dang*/ bkur stir byed pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs nas/ rigs kyi bu gang la la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa'am/ klog pa'am/ ston pa'am/ yi ger 'dri ba rung ste/ rigs kyi bu de mig gi yon tan brgyad brgya thob par 'gyur ro// rna ba'i yon tan stong nyis brgya thob par 'gyur ro// sna'i yon tan brgyad brgya thob par 'gyur ro// lce'i yon tan stong nyis brgya thob par 'gyur ro// lus kyi yon tan brgyad brgya thob par 'gyur ro// yid kyi yon tan stong nyis brgya thob par 'gyur ro// de yon tan brgya phrag mang pos dbang po drug gi grong yongs su dag cing*/

shin tu yongs su dag par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la sogs pa mdo sde mang por lan gcig ma yin par bka' stsal pa ltar/ chos kyi rnam grangs re re tsam thos par gyur na'ang*/ bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni nam yang mur thug pa ma mchis so snyam nas yid kyi dbang po der phrogs par brten/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes kyi zhabs zung gi chu skyes dag spyi bos bsten cing gus pas mnyan pa la/ bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor las byung ba 'dul ba lung*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor las byung ba sher phyogs/ mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor las byung ba dkon brtsegs dang phal chen/ 'khor lo gsum po ci rigs par gtogs pa sde tshan phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa mdo mang*/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtser son pa rgyud 'bum dang lnga/ dang po ni/ chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum byung zer ba'i lo rgyus dang mtshungs pa lung zhu ba'i 'grel par bram ze'i rgyal po rgyal shes kyis mchod rten bshig dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba dag me la bsregs/ dge slong mang du bsad/ glegs bam rnams kyang zhugs kyi phung por sbyangs pas bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung bar brten/ dge slong rnams kyis yul gzhan dag nas 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi glegs bam mang du bsdus kyang gzhung bla ma'i glegs bam ma rnyed pas nam zhig na kha che'i yul gyi dge slong zhig gi blo nas 'don pa thos te rtsad bcad pas dge slong des cung zad gcig ni dran cung zad gcig ni mi dran no zhes smras pa na dran pa bzhin du 'don du bcug nas dge slong rnams kyis gzhung bla ma yi ger bkod/ slar rnam par dpyad par bya'o snyam pa'i ngang nas g.yeng bas lus pa yul mang por 'phel zhing*/ de la ma tshang ba dang ma dag pa byung bas bram ze'i btsun pa yon tan 'od kyi 'dul ba'i rnam bshad kyi zhu ba las 'di skad byung ngo zhes dogs gnas su yang yang bkod cing*/

de'i phyir 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa kha che ba zhes bya ste zhes 'byung bas zhu ba rdzogs pa dang bcas pa'i gzhung dam pa ni yang dag par bsdus pa'i gzhi pho nyams pas ma dag cing*/ sngar gsung rab rnams mer bsregs pa'i dus thal ba'i khrod nas rnyed par grags pa'i dang po'i gzhung ma nyams pa yul dbus kyi dge slong 'ga' zhig gi blo la snang ba 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams dang sde snod 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang pos dbus 'gyur 'chang du gtogs pa'i grong khyer chen po bcom brlag tu bsdus pa'i lung zhu ba ma rdzogs pa 'di dag pa yin la/ de'ang gangs ri'i ljongs su 'gyur ro cog gi lung sde bzhi'i bzhugs tshul la snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che sogs mkhas pa mang dag gis pha'i so thar mdo'i tshig gi 'grel pa pha'i rnam 'byed yin pas dang por pha'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ de nas ma'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ de nas so thar mdo'i don gyi 'grel pa lung gzhi/ de gnyis kyi kha skong ba phran tshegs/ de dag gi don zhus lan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa lung zhu ba'am gzhung bla mar mdzad nas rgyal rtse them spangs ma sogs go rim de ltar yod/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu rtsa ba'i lung dge slong pha ma'i so thar gnyis/ de nas lung sde bzhi'i dang po lung gzhi/ gnyis pa lung rnam 'byed/ gsum pa bla ma'am dam pa/ bzhi pa phran tshegs kyi go rims su mdzad/ tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur du sngon gyi ska cog sogs kyi bzhed pa dkar chag phang thang ma sogs las byung ba ltar dang po lung gzhi/ gnyis pa so thar gyi mdo dang rnam 'byed/ gsum pa phran tshegs/ bzhi pa gzhung bla ma'am zhu bar mdzad pa'i lugs gsum ga khungs shin tu btsun par 'dug pas gang gi rjes su 'brangs kyang khyad par mi 'dug na'ang*/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi steng nas lung nos pa dang mkhas grub sman lung pa'i gsan yig kyang de kho na ltar mdzad pa nas de'i rjes su 'brangs te bkod pa la/

'dul ba gzhi sh+lau ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya bam po brgya dang dgu bzhugs pa'i glegs bam ka pa la rab byung gi gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ dbyar gnas kyi gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi'i stod rnams/ kha pa la ko lpags kyi gzhi'i smad cha dang sman gyi gzhi'i stod cha/ ga pa la sman gyi gzhi'i smad cha/ gos kyi gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ kau sham+bhi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ dmar ser can gyi gzhi/ gang zag gi gzhi/ spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i gzhi/ gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/ dbyen gyi gzhi'i stod cha dang bcas pa rnams/ nga pa la dbyen gyi gzhi'i mjug ste gzhi bcu bdun rnams paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa/ bid+yā ka ra pra bha/ dhar+m+ma ka ra/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur cing*/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bid+yā ka ra pra bha dang lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ca pa la dge slong pha'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mdor bsdus te ston pa pha'i so sor thar pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun brgya bam po gnyis pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de rgya cher ston pa pha'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya bam po brgyad

gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang zhing dpe la lar nyi khri lnga stong zhes 'byung ba dpyad/ cu rtsa gsum pa las mi gtsang spyod sogs pham pa bzhi/ khu ba 'byin pa sogs lhag ma bcu gsum gyi bcu pa dbyen byed pa'i stod cha yan/ cha pa la bcu pa'i smad cha man/ ma nges pa'i chos gnyis/ 'chang ba'i spang ltung sogs spang ltung sum cu/ rdzun byed pa'i ltung byed sogs ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i bcu gcig pa skye ba 'jig pa yan/ ja pa la bcu gnyis pa 'cha' ba'i ltung byed nas bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa yan/ nya pa la bdun cu rtsa gsum pa sa brko ba'i ltung byed man so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi/ sham thabs zlum por bgo ba la bslab pa nas bzung shing la mi gang tsam las mtho bar mi 'dzeg par bslab pa'i bar bslab pa'i chos mang po rnams dang rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun rnams sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong dang 'dra ba/ ta pa la dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsdus nas ston pa ma'i so sor thar pa sh+lau ka brgyad brgya tshal pa bka' 'gyur dkar chag na sh+lau ka nyis brgya zhes snang ba brtag bam po gnyis sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong dang 'dra ba/ de rgyas par ston pa ma'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka brgyad rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na bam po drug yan bzhugs gsung ba brgyud pa de la drug man gyi lung ma byung ba 'dra zhing bag ston pa dang dmar ston pa'i brgyud lugs 'di la nyi shu rtsa brgyad tshang mar lung mdzad srol yod par brten rin po che sman lung nas kyi gsan yig tu'ang nyer brgyad rang yod do// stong bzhi brgya dang bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa/ dhar+m+ma ka ra/ bid+yu ka ra pra bha/ lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur cing slad kyi bid+yā gang dang dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/

tha pa la lung phran tshegs sgo brgyad kar rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri bdun stong bdun brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bam po nyer bdun pa yan/ da pa la bam po nyer brgyad nas lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bar rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yā ka ra pra bha/ dhar+m+ma shrī pra bha/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba/ na pa la gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya bam po bcu gnyis/ zhu ba rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa yan/ pa pa la de'i 'phros bam po nyer gsum nas lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i bar/ zhu ba gnyis po 'di la tshal pa bka' 'gyur du lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dus bsgyur mod kyi zhes pa tsam las sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gsal ba ma byung*/ bla ma gnyis bsdoms par sh+lau ka chig khri dgu stong lnga brgya/ so thar gnyis/ bla ma ma tshang ba gsum ma gtogs kun dril bar sh+lau ka dgu khri dgu stong bdun brgya/ rnam 'byed yan chad la sh+lau ka phyed dang bzhi brgya dang rnam 'byed nas bzung bzhi brgya re la bam por mdzad do// gzhung bla ma ma rdzogs pa ma gtogs pa'i khyon bsdoms sh+lau ka chig 'bum chig stong nyis brgya/ bla ma ma rdzogs pa'ang bsnan par bam po sum brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bam po gcig gi sum cha gcig sh+lau ka chig 'bum bzhi stong brgyad brgya'i tshad du yod pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhaḥ ma hā kā sh+yeḥ 'od srungs chen po/ dgra bcom pa bdun ni/ kun dga' bo/ ā nan+daḥ sha na sha na'i gos can/ bstabaṃ/ u pa gup+taḥ nyer sbas/ bha wā nan+daḥ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na dhi dhi ka zhes mchan snang zhing bha shā zer ba 'dug go /srid dga'/ me nag po pa/ tsa kaḥ pūr+ṇaḥ gang po/ ā tsār+ya

slob dpon rta dbyangs/ a shwa gho ṣaḥ rgya gar dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bdun ni/ ku mā ra la lī taḥ gzhon nu rol pa/ shrī ma chos rje dpa' bo'i gsan yig na shrī la lī ta zhes snang ba nor ba 'dra'o/ ti/ blo gros dpal/ ha ri bha draḥ seṅge bzang por don gyis bsgyur kyang rung*/ 'phrog byed bzang po/ shu ra baḥ dpa' bo/ ba su mi dbyig gnyen zhes don bsgyur kyang rung*/ nor bshes/ traḥ ba su liḥ dbyig len/ saṃ gha bha draḥ dge 'dun bzang po/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta brgyad ni/ dbang phyug sī shwa raḥ phung po len/ skamadha liḥ saṃ dge 'dun nor/ gha ba suḥ pūr+ṇa mi gang ba'i bshes gnyen/ traḥ dhar+m+ma dat+taḥ chos sbyin/ bud+dha de waḥ sangs rgyas lha/ dha ra dat+taḥ 'dzin sbyin/ puṇ+ya se bsod nams sde/ naḥ saṃ gha se dge 'dun sde/ naḥ puṇ+ya nan+daḥ bsod nams dga' ba/ dzñā na tsan+d+raḥ ye shes zla ba/ dzñā na so ye shes zla ba/ maḥ a sho rak+ṣi taḥ mya ngan med 'tsho/ sarba rak+ṣi taḥ thams cad bsrungs/ dharma ko ṣaḥ chos kyi mdzod/ dharma yu gur gyi slob dpon nyi shu ni/ rak+ṣi ta/ chos 'tsho/ ka l+yā ṇa rak+ṣi taḥ dge ba 'tsho/ pradzñā rak+ṣi taḥ shes rab 'tsho/ shrī lam nye bar ston pa'i dpal/ margago pa de shaḥ mok+ṣa rak+ṣi taḥ thar pa 'tsho/ ka l+yā ṇa dge legs 'tsho/ rak+ṣi taḥ gang dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di ltar byung zhing dpa' bo'i gsan yig na ka l+yā bha dra zhes snang ba brtag bi rnam par rgyal ba'i 'od/ dzi na pra bha waḥ a mṛ ta wa 'chi med go cha/ rmaḥ pra bhā 'od kyi 'byung gnas sde/ ka ra se naḥ khu sen gyi slob dpon brgyad ni/ dpa' bo'i gsan yig na bha thung byas te 'od byed du bsgyur 'dug go / ā nyi ma'i sde/

di te se naḥ margago pa lam nye bar ston pa/ de shaḥ saṃ gha dge 'dun sde/ se naḥ shī la tshul khrims 'bangs/ dā saḥ ya snyan grags 'bangs/ sho dā saḥ sangs rgyas 'bangs bud+dha dā saḥ shi bslab pa bzang po/ k+ṣa bha draḥ gu ṇa so yon tan zla ba/ maḥ a mya ngan med pa'i bshes gnyen sho ka mi traḥ shu dkar po'i bshes gnyen/ kla mi traḥ shākya mi traḥ shākya bshes gnyen/ shī la tshul khrims bshes gnyen mi traḥ ka yol gyi slob dpon yin/ a tha de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ bho ṭa s+ya bhik+ṣu mi tra ma dh+yā mi ka bud+dha lak+ṣaḥ tri bhū mi nā tha dhar+m+mas+ya rā dzā d+ya rat+naḥ sa gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu dbus pa blo gsal la 'phags pa rin po ches gsan pa'i phyag phyir dbus kyi dga' ldan bde ba can pa bkra shis dpal gyis gsan tshul dang*/ 'bri gung du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag bshes gnyen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad par lo rgyus de ltar drangs pa'i bkra shis dpal la rin chen 'od zer gyis gsan zer ba snang yang*/ brgyud ma gzhan 'phags pa rin po cher bkra shis dpal gyis gsan zer ba'ang 'dug go / gu ru bla ma rin chen 'od zer/ rat+na rasmiḥ ma ho pa dh+ya mkhan chen bzod pa dpal/ ya k+ṣān+ti shrī dga' gzungs pa/ nan+da dhā ra ṇiḥ swā mi puṇ+ya shī laḥ rje bsod nams tshul khrims/ pra barma ho pa pra bar mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ dh+ya ya pradzñā badz+ra/ ma ho dhīḥkā shaḥ mkhan chen blo gsal ba/ rā ga shāsta dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ shrī matrah+naḥ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen/ rā ga shās+t+ra r+ṇa ba rat+naḥ swa mi rje bsod nams rin chen/ puṇ+ya rat+naḥ ma he pa dh+ya ya su ga ti garba

mkhan chen 'gro bas snying po ཿ bi na ma dha ra shrī mad+dh+wa dzaḥ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ la k+ṣam+bar sa ri ta 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang*/ ka rat+na dhar+m+me shaḥ pra sa ri ta shī le shwa raḥ rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug bī ra dharma rā dzār+tha sid+dhaḥ dpa' bo chos rgyal don grub/ spyan sngar dkon mchog 'bangs a gra ta rat+na dā saḥ mū li ka la sho3r+tha sid+dhaḥ drung pa grags pa don grub/ ya ti dwi ga ṇa shrī sid+dhaḥ sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ man+t+ra ban+de sid+dhi rwa dza/ sngags btsun grub pa'i rdo rje/ khyab bdag dgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis 'dul lung sngar nas gsan grub pa dang bcas mdo mang sher phyogs kyi lung 'tshol bar rje sman lung pas byon skabs ma gsan 'dug kyang rjes su sdom brtson bsod snyoms pa 'di la rang ri lung sbug tu ched gnyer gyi gsan par snang ngo*// pra ghu nā tha puṇ+ya wa riḥ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ nir+m+ma kā ya saṃ bha dra kar+m+maḥ sprul sku kun bzang pad+ma phrin las/ pi na ya dha ra wā gīn+d+ra pra tiṣ+ṭhaṃ/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rab brtan/ ma hā bo tsarbar+t+ti ka bud+dha shā sa na s+ya dh+wa dzaḥ bka' 'gyur ba chen po sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ wā gīn+d+rā nan+da sādh+wā ka raḥ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mañdzu gho ṣa dha ra ni rā 'jam pa'i dbyangs bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bho gaḥ pra sa bka' drin mnyam med 'dul ba 'dzin mchog bsod nams blo gros/ dā sa ma bī na ya dha rā gra puṇ+ya ma tiḥ te nāt+ma ban+de shī la rat+na ke pra sa dā pra des bdag btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin stsal to// yats+tshaḥ yang na dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum nas/ ne'u paṇa chen/ brag tshab mkhan po gzhon nu bsod nams/ brag tshab slob dpon bsod nams rdo rje/

dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ bde ba can pa bkra shis dpal/ skyor lung mngon pa ba rin chen 'od zer/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams ye shes/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams bzang po/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang*/ rje 'jigs med grags pa/ bla ma nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ mang thos rgyal mtshan bzang po/ dwags rams pa chos rgyal bstan pa/ dpa' bo chos rgyal don grub man 'dra/ yang na mngon pa ba rin chen 'od zer nas/ skyor lung pa 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ nyang ro ba dkon cog seṅge/ bsod nams ye shes man gong bzhin no// gzhung bla ma dang so thar gyi mdo gnyis kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams bzang po nas/ bla ma dkon mchog seṅge/ rje bsod nams ye shes/ de la bka' bzhi pa grags gzhon dang byang sems pa gnyis kas gsan/ gnyis ka la mkhan bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon dpal ldan bzang po/ mkhan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams rin chen/ rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ dwags rams pa chos rgyal bstan pa man 'dra/ rgyal dbang lnga pa sogs kyi gsan yig las de ltar 'byung zhing*/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i gsan yig tu/ rdor grags sprul sku pad+ma phrin las pas/ dge slong ma'i so thar blo mchog rdo rje dang*/ de min rnams bka' 'gyur ba las gsan pa'i brgyud pa so sor bgrang snang ba ltar na/ ma'i so thar gyi brgyud pa ni gong gi brgyud pa sngon ma de'i nang gi mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi tshab tu blo mchog rdo rje bcug pa sor bzhag de 'phros 'dul ba yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ skyor lung mngon pa ba yan 'dra/ de nas skyor lung mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa/ yang dben mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa/ thang po che'i mkhan po 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan rin po che bzang po/ khu ston bkra shis bzang po/ chos sgo ba tshul khrims bzang po/

gu ru singha'i mtshan can/ spyan snga grags pa don grub/ bka' 'gyur shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ mkhan chen chos grub seṅge/ dol chos 'khor sgang gi chos rje rnam rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rin chen kun ldan/ 'dul 'dzin rdo rje grags pa/ yongs 'dzin dge 'dun legs grub/ dpal 'byor gling ba ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ sprul sku pad+ma phrin las/ zhes 'dug pa/ pad+ma phrin las pas bka' 'gyur ba las 'dul pa yongs rdzogs gsan yod tshe brgyud pa so sor smos pa 'di mi dgos pas slar dpyad// ༈ //gnyis pa bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor las byung ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs la/ yum rgyas pa 'bum pa ni shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyis klu'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe byams zhus/ chos 'phags/ rtag tu ngu*/ yongs gtad de le'u bzhi gdengs can rnams kyi mchod gnas su bzhag pas mi'i yul du ma 'drongs/ deng sang byams zhus dang chos 'phags bsdoms pa'i le'u/ rtag tu ngu'i le'u/ yongs gtad de le'u gsum du snang ba nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa nas kha bskangs pa 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag nas bsgyur ba yod pas dngos bstan du 'khrul gzhi mi bya zhing*/ de'ang lha btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung nas bsgyur bas rlangs kyi thugs 'gyur ma/ rje btsad po'i mtshal khrag dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma sbyar nas bris pa'i dum pa bzhi pa la reg zig dmar po lha sa gong gi so phag mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs la yod par grags/ la la kong po bu chur yod zer ba ni mkhan slob 'tshog gsum gyi shangs mtshal gyi 'bum dmar sprul sku dri med lhun pos gter nas spyan drangs pa dang nor gzhi byung bar mngon/ sbas mañdzu shrī dang nyang in+d+ra wa ro gnyis kyis blangs pa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas lo byad rnams mnga' 'bangs la dpya khral bsdus nas bsgyur bas dpya 'bum du grags pa/

rje'i dbu skra'i gzhob ra mas la bsres te ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas bris pa'i reg zig sngon po dum pa bzhi pa de la lcags thur brgyus pas lcags thur can du grags pa dang por bsam yas su bzhugs par grags kyang deng sang 'dir yod mi gsal/ reg zig sngo dmar gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis yab yob tu bsgyur bas de'i ming du thogs shing bla 'gyur chung bar yang ngos 'dzin/ reg zig ces pa bkas bcad kyi brda rnying du dbus pa blo gsal bzhed pa don du zin bris kyi ming yin pa glegs bam 'di rnams ha cang bsdus pa'i zin bris lta bur song bas/ slar 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu bai ro tsa nas rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhu chen du mdzad par dum bu drug pa glegs shing la gras nas thogs pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi bar du pha wang gi tshang bcas pas pha wang can du'ang brjod pa bla 'gyur 'bring po/ 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis ke tu gling du g.yos mal bcas nas zas sna bcu gsum res sad mi mi bdun sogs rab byung sum brgya la bsnyen bkur te yum rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas pa'i steng nas gdugs tshod thon pa dang tshar re sgrogs pa'i shog dril rnams kyi snod sha sgro zhig yod pas der thogs shing mchims phu na bzhugs par grags/ mnga' bdag khri sde srong btsan gyi dus lo paṇa rnams kyis 'phan yul gyi smad ka ba na mo cher 'gyur bcos kyi zhu chen la brten dum bu bcu drug tu bzhengs/ 'jug snod las gras te sha sgro can du btags pa bla 'gyur chen mo/ 'di sngon mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus byung ba'i sha sgro can dang ni mi gcig gzhan yang nyang dang lce khyi 'brug sogs lo tsā ba khyon bsdoms drug gi 'gyur byang yod par grags/ de'ang yum chen mo bzheng ba rje ma gtogs 'bangs kyis bzheng mi nus pas khri lde gtsug gi bla 'bum skya bo/

mjing yon gyi spug 'bum/ gtsang ma'i phye 'bum/ ral pa can gyi drug 'bum/ gnam lde lha'i zhal dmar can/ dar ma'i shog ser can tsam las ma 'phel ba rjes su 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum tshar bcu dgu tsam byung*/ de nas mi ring bar ru mtshams kyi lcang rdo rje tshul khrims kyis 'bum bcu dgu po thams cad la gtugs nas bzhengs pas shin tu dag cing*/ de las mched pa 'bum tshar drug cu skor dang*/ de'i rgyun las yar klungs jo bos bzhengs pa'i 'bum la ma phyi byas nas dum pa bcu gnyis bam po sum brgya dang gsum le'u bdun bcu don lnga/ sh+lau ka 'bum dang chig stong yod pa/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus gtan la phab pa las rnyed par grags pa'i dpe rgyun zhig kyang 'dug cing*/ bal yul pham thing gi gtsug lag khang gi 'bum la shes rab sgron ma/ snang ba gsal ba/ zla ba'i sgron me gsum lhag por yod pa rngog los gser zho gsum gyi rngan pa byin nas bsnan pas sngon ma rnams la ting nge 'dzin brgya bcu dgu las med par brgya nyer gcig tu mdzad/ sgo gsum/ rnam grangs bcu gcig zhus lan brgya dang nyi shu/ 'gres ring brgya lnga bcu/ phyogs skor bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ mtshon byed kyi chos bdun cu/ 'gres rtsa bdun brgya dang bcu gcig 'gres thung bsnan pa'i 'gres rtsa khri dang bzhi brgya nyer dgu/ bam po sum brgya dang le'u don gnyis byung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu'ang rngog 'gyur gyi le'u dang bam grangs kyi rjes su 'brangs 'dug pas gtso che bar mngon no// de ltar yum rgyas pa'i lung legs par mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen rig pa'i khu byug 'grel mdzad mche ba'i sde/ kha che bzang po'i zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kha che gaṃ gā dha ra/
paṇ+ḍi ta ka na ka shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ya shrī mi tra/ kha che dgon pa ba spyan gcig kha che dhar+m+ma shrī/

rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na rgya mtsho dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar byung bas dpa' bo'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis gcig tu byas pa yig skyon no// ba reg lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de sras ba reg ston skyabs/ dge bsnyen dga' ba rā dza/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ bla ma 'od zer shes rab/ stag ston spyil phu ba/ bla ma dar ma 'od zer/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ slob dpon jo btsun/ slob dpon bsam gtan grub/ 'dul 'dzin se'u blo gros bzang po/ mañdzu gho ṣa rat+na/ 'dul 'dzin stan gcig pa blo gros byang chub/ slob dpon shī la bha dra/ slob dpon bsod nams seṅge/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thugs sras thu btsun kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang*/ rab 'byams chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug mang thos chos rgyal don grub/ spyan snga dkon cog 'bangs/ drung pa grags pa don grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ dhī tsha sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ kun bzang pad+ma phrin las/ skad gnyis smra ba dge slong ngag dbang rab brtan/ bsam yas pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bka' drin zla med 'dren mchog bsod nams blo gros dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can la stsal to// yum 'bring po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa gang dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang tshal ba bka' 'gyur dkar chag dang rin po che sman lung pa'i gsan yig tu bam po bdun cu don brgyad ces 'dug bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum sh+lau ka brgya le'u bdun cu don drug pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

slob dpon dbyig gnyen yan gong ltar la/ de nas 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dpon seṅge bzang po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu ṇa mi tra/ rat+na bur+pa tha/ slob dpon shān+ti pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo tsa ba blo ldan shes rab/ 'bro shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ khu shes rab brtson 'grus/ slob dpon dkar chung ring mo/ zhang ye ba chen po/ gnyal zhig 'jam rdor/ rgya shes rab dbang phyug chu mig pa seṅge dpal/ bshes gnyen lho brag pa/ mkhas pa dben dge ba/ rgyud bla ma rdo rje rin chen/ mthar rtsa'i slob dpon/ chos sgo ba tshul khrims bzang po/ rje bsod nams seṅge/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen zla ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje/ nyi khri ma gtogs bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs gsan mtshams rje shākya rgyal mtshan zhing brjes pas mnal lam du bka' 'gyur ba phebs nas nyi khri tshar gcig gsungs pas des go chod mdzad nas gsan yig rgya mtsho phyag bris mar nye gnas mi 'dug rung sngar gdul bya thun mong ba rnams kyi sgro skur spang phyir bka' 'gyur ba'i nye gnas rin chen zla bar bklag lung gsan pa yin zhes khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po gsung ngo*// gdan pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes nas/ slob dpon dpal sbas/ slob dpon rat+nā kā ra shān+ti/ slob dpon wa la tsan+d+ra/ paṇa chen dhī ra pā la/ rngog lo man 'dra/ yum bsdus pa brgyad 'di sngon la byed pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig ltar byas pa yin tshal pa bka' 'gyur du shes rab khri pa'i 'og tu yod/ stong pa la 'phreng ba can dang bzo sbyangs dang sde can te gsum du byung ba snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos rgya dpe tha dad pa gsum po de se niṣ+ka zhes byung ba'i tshe sde can/

prak+niṣ+ka zhes pa'i tshe 'phreng can/ sha niṣ+ka zhes byung tshe bzo sbyangs su bsgyur ba yin la/ mdor ming mi gcig pa gsungs pa gang zag gcig la ming mi gcig pa sna tshogs 'ong ba lta bu las tha dad pa min zhing*/ 'phreng ba can la lha'i me tog lha'i bdug spos zhes pa bzhin 'gyur rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan gnyis la lha'i me tog dang bdug pa dang zhes tshig nyung bar grags gsung ba ni khungs shin tu btsun par snang*/ yum rgyas 'bring gnyis la 'phreng can dang*/ khri brgyad stong pa dang sdud par gzo sbyangs su bsgyur ba sogs nas sher phyogs phal cher la lugs gsum po 'di'i rnam gzhag don gyis thob pa zhig yod 'dra'o// de ltar yum bsdus pa paṇ+ḍi ta shākya se na dang dzñā na sid+dhi/ lo tsā ba dharma tā shī las bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta su dha ṣi ta dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/ yang dpal mar me mdzad dang lo chen rin bzang gis yul dbus kyi 'grel pa la gtugs nas bcos shing*/ skyid shod snye thang na mo cher jo 'brom yab sras kyis brgyad stong pa gsungs pa'i tshe che long zhig gtan la phab/ slar yang byang rwa sgreng du 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya dpe gsum la gtugs nas lan gnyis su zhus dag cing*/ de rjes rngog lo tsā ba chen pos kha che'i dpe dang yul dbus kyi rgya dpe du ma bsags nas zhus chen du mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi le'u so gnyis pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon seṅge bzang po yan nyi khri ltar la/ de nas yon tan bshes gnyen/ rin po che'i ri bo/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa nas bzung chos rje bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan gyi bar yang nyi khri ltar las/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ yangs pa can pa rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ mkhyen brtse'i dbon po tshe dbang kun mkhyen/

kun bzang rtse ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ sprul sku pad+ma phrin las/ dge slong ngag dbang rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin lhun grub dpal bzang po/ bka' drin zla med bka' 'gyur ba chen po chos rje bsod nams blo gros/ des bdag la'o// mkhas grub sman lung pas bkra shis chos sder rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po la lung gsan zin pa dang rjes su lho brag nyi lder dhī tsha sprul sku la sher phyogs gsan skabs sprul sku spyan bsnyun pa'i 'o brgyal ba 'byung bar brten brgyad stong pa sngar gyi de gas go bcad pa'i bskyar nas ma gsan 'dug yang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel la tshar gcig thob pa spag shong chos rje rin chen rgya mtshor gsan gsung ba las brgyud pa ma byung*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po drug cu le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa gong dkar ba dang rin po che sman lung pa'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung yang tshal pa bka' 'gyur na rtsa bdun zer ba snang*/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa yan nyi khri ltar la/ de nas dzñā na kīrti/ rong zom chos bzang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba dkar chos can/ mnga' ris pa tshul dbang shes rab/ la stod pa dbang rin/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ spong khrod 'dul 'dzin pa chen po/ 'jad ra snga ba shes rab 'tsho/ bla ma dar ma 'od/ bla ma blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa byang chub 'bum/ mtsho dkar ba khams pa byang rgyal/ bla ma yar klungs pa bsod nams shes rab/ mthar rtse'i bla ma gzhon nu dar/ rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa man yum rgyas pa dang 'dra/

yang brgyad stong pa kho na'i lung brgyud zur pa e waṃ pa'i mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa las brgyud pa ltar na/ slob dpon seṅge bzang po yan chad sngar bzhin las/ de nas yon tan bshes gnyen/ rin po che'i ri bo/ zla ba bzang po/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo tsā ba/ 'bro shes rab 'bar/ byang chub ye shes/ 'dul 'dzin dkar mo/ gtsang 'bre/ g.yar nyi/ 'jam gsar/ bo dong rin po che/ rin chen rtse mo/ zhang sngon grwa pa/ bla zhig pa/ bde ba can pa/ ye shes mgon po/ bla ma seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon 'od zer ldan/ bla ma grub chen pa/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ chos dpal legs grub/ rje sangs rgyas bde legs/ bla ma chos kyi blo gros/ chos gter dkon mchog legs pa/ rin po che dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid nam mkha' bsam 'grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yang na rje bsod nams dpal ldan nas/ glo bo ba puṇ+ya'i mtshan can/ rje nam mkha' bsam 'grub dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen pa man 'dra/ lugs gcig la/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho yan btsal dgos/ de nas 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ slob dpon don grub shes rab/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ sangs rgyas seṅge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang nas dpal ldan don grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa bam po sum cu dang sh+lau ka tshal ba bka' 'gyur na bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi zhes pa las sh+lau ka brgya'i sgros mi 'dug brgya le'u sum cu so gsum pa paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ pradzña warma/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

slob dpon seṅge bzang po yan nyi khri ltar la/ de nas ku sa li che chung*/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo a ti sha dge bshes 'brom ston pa/ nam mkha' go cha/ chag dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ la stod pa dkon mchog 'bar/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ spong khrod 'dul 'dzin/ rta nag pa sgom she bla ma dar ma 'od zer man khri brgyad stong pa dang gcig go /sher phyin sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ sher snying ma gtog tshal ba bka' 'gyur sor bzhag bris pa yin rdo rje gdan pa dang rin po che sman lung pa'i gsan yig na tshul brgya lnga bcu sogs kha shas 'dug kyang ma thos pas ma bris/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa bam po gcig brgyad stong pa'i le'u mtha' ma'o// pa bid+yā ka ra singha dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi rtsal gyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i gsan yig na bam po drug dang le'u bdun pa zhes snang ba dpyad/ bam po bdun dang sh+lau ka drug cu shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang dzi na mi tra/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 'di dkon brtsegs kyi 'dus pa zhe drug pa las byung zhing bka' 'gyur ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i gsan yig na bam po gnyis zhes snang ngo*// phyin pa bdun brgya pa gsar bcad kyis bcos pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sum brgya pa rdor gcod skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sher phyin lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ 'di gnyis rgyud 'bum nang na bzhugs/ sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po sh+lau ka nyer lnga pa slob dpon bi mā las dag par mdzad nas bsam yas dge rgyas kyi skor khang gi gdong yar blta la gleng gzhi'i bkod pa dang bcas bris shing tshal ba bka' 'gyur du 'di'i gras su med par rgyud 'bum gras su bcug 'dug go

/paṇ+ḍi ta bi mā la dang lo tsā ba rin chen sde'i 'gyur/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun du bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po nas sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bar dpe tshan lnga po'i lung ma thob kyang slar thob re'i phyir brgyud pa bcas bris/ phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams thob pa las shes rab snying po ma gtogs pa'i gong gsal chos bcu bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam par snang mdzad bzang po/ seṅge bzang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu ṇa mi tra/ rat+na sarba thā/ slob dpon shān+ti pa/ kha che dzñā na shrī/ su ma ti kīrti/ smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti/ rong zom chos bzang*/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang gi yab nyang ston chos 'khor gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs las bi mā la'i slob ma nyang ting 'dzin bzang po ni min no// lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'di rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dngos slob yin cing smṛ ti jo bo rje dang dus mtshungs pas ting 'dzin bzang po de dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhugs na ma gtogs par 'dir bla ma gcig gnyis shig chad dam yang na lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub la lho pa thams cad mkhyen par grags pas de yin na dus 'grigs pa 'dre'o zhes dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu bris 'dug pa dkon brtsegs kyi brgyud par rdo rje gdan pa chung ba dang lho pa kun mkhyen gyi bar na bla ma bzhi tsam 'dug pas hol khongs shig byung ba 'dra'o// zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsan yig tu snang ngo*// bla ma grags pa seṅge/ spyil bu ba 'od zer shes rab/ bla ma dar ma 'od zer/ bla zhig byang chub rdo rje/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ bde ba can pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/

gar thig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod nams seṅge/ tshal rin chen grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ thu btsun 'jigs med dpa' bo man 'bum gyi brgyud pa bzhin no// bsil ldan sman ljongs mkhas dang grub mchog rnams// ji snyed byon pas bkral ba'i bstan bcos dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' lung 'gyur ro cog gzhung las// sher phyin skor sogs thos pa'i rim pa'o// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyi bstan bcos dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skor yongs rdzogs sogs ston pa'i bka' lung rin po che kha shas thos pa'i sarga ste nyer brgyad pa'o// //spyi don bzhi pa thos bsam don yod ched du rang gzhan don gnyis ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar gong du smos pa'i skyabs mchog bka' drin mtshungs bral de rnams las chos kyi bdud rtsi mang dag thos pa de nyid kyang tshe 'di'i grags 'dod sogs lhur blang gi bgyi ba ma yin par sbyor ba kun mkhyen shākya'i sras kyi ring lugs 'di la gsang ba bsam mi khyab par/ 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam ste// mi yi lus kyi tshogs kyi rnyed pa yin// kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa// 'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'// zhes gsungs pa ltar bcos min gyi dad pa brtan pos kun nas bslang*/ dngos gzhi mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon de rnams sgo gsum gus pas gtsug tu bsten cing*/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pas mig gis blta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// rab tu dang las dri med blos// nad pas sman pa'i ngag gnyan bzhin// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig

/ces 'byung ba ltar gyi 'du shes rtse gcig pas don du gnyer/ rjes mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog gang 'khos dang khyad par du'ang*/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ dbang thob man ngag zab mo 'tshol ba yis// sa stengs rgyas pa kun tu btsal byas kyang*// phan pa'i don po man ngag dam tshig ste// 'di med 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khong rul bzhin// legs par smin pas dam tshig bsrungs byas na// skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub bo zhes// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag phan par mdzad pas gsungs// bdag ni thos nyung shes rab mig bral yang*// dri med rgyud las legs gsungs mthong bas na// dbang blang dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod cig ces// kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa ltar gyi dam tshig gi gnad rnams la rtogs dpyod ma brjed tsam bgyid khul byas par brten gnas skabs kyi rten 'brel legs tshogs 'ga' zhig kyang rang 'grigs lta bu byung zhing*/ thos don nyams len skor sogs kyang*/ yi dam chos srung tshe lha nor lha'i skor sogs kyi gzhi'i bsnyen pa du ma mthar phyin bsags pa dang*/ rgyun du yang sgo gsum tha mal ngang la ma 'byams par dge sbyor ci 'grub bgyid khul dang*/ rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel rin po che'i gtsos pusti sum brgya skor gyi zhu dag gi zhabs 'degs bsgrubs pa dang*/ gtso cher bstan 'gror sman 'dogs lhur blang gi 'chad brtsams sogs lus sems kyi gang lcogs 'bad rtsis bcas de skor zhib pa rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa skye ba phal ba'i rkang 'thung dge sdig 'dren ma'i las kyi yal ga phan tshun tu 'dzings par bde sdug dus kyi rgyal mos re mos su bsgyur ba'i tshul zhes pa rang nyid kyi brtsams chos ta pa'i mthar 'khod pa der gsal bzhin las 'dir smos ma dgos pas de dag gi thos bsam don yod ched du rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub tshul gyi sarga nyung tsam ste nyer dgu pa'o//

//slar smras pa/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rgyal tshab chos tshul 'dzad med smra ba'i rdo rje slob dpon che// du ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gus bsnyen gang thugs yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas las// dad gus ku sha'i sdong bus nyer blangs rang nyid blo yi yol gor rim bsags pas// don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter 'grub 'di sngon bsags skal ba mchog tu go /gang zhig snying pos dben pa'i nor dag dka' ba du mas 'bad la spro byed na// thog mtha' bar gyi dge ba gsum ldan 'chos skyob yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas che// 'di dang phyi ma'i gtan bde lhun grub 'byung phyir tshad ldan gcig nas gcig brgyud pa'i// khungs 'brel drang po'i rnam thar 'di 'dra dkon pa'i 'du shes bskyed la cis mi brtson// ka ye grog dag 'dir snang srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal na kra'i grong khyer la// bsgral nas byang chub rin chen gling du bgrod la dka' ba che snyam gyi nar ma bsgyur bar// bla med bshes gnyen ded dpon bzang po gtsug gi rgyan du legs bsten nas// brtson 'grus gru chen zung dang don gnyis yid bzhin bsam 'phel rnyed par the mi tshom// tshe sngon legs byas sa bon dge btab mthus// rgyal bstan sman gyi dga' tshal yangs po la// nyer skyes thos bsam sgom pa'i bcud bzang gi /bstan 'gror sman pa'i snye ma khur du dud// dbyar dus chu 'dzin gzhon nu 'khrigs khrod nas// 'brug sgra dal bur ldir tshe mdongs mtha' can// dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa 'os yin mod// phal pa'i ca co'i sgra la de lta min// da phyir rang zhe rang la mi khrel ba'i// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan la sman re dang*// gzhan rgyud thar pa'i sa bon gdab pa'i ched// smin grol chos kyi skal bzang brtson pa'i dge'i// 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seṅge yi// lung rtogs spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa// kun dga' rnam gnyis lung mchog srid pa'i khongs// bskal pa'i bar du bshad sgrub gang 'phel shog

/thar pa dam pa'i don ldan rgyal gsung dang*// nyer 'brel rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam// ston mdzad yongs 'dzin 'phags dang so skye'i tshul// zhi dbyings mnal rnams thugs dgongs rdzogs 'gyur cig /rgyal gsungs sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// bzhed gzhung ma nor so sor 'chad byed pa'i// mkhas dang grub par gang dag 'tsho gzhes rnams// sku tshe bskal pa'i bar du brtan gyur cig /phul byung sde bzhi'i rtsa ba brtan po las// khrims gnyis dge bcu'i lo 'dab cher rgyas shing*// phun tshogs phan bde'i 'bras bzang g.yur za ba'i// rgyal rgyud sa la'i rkang 'thung rtag brlan shog /yangs pa'i sar 'khod mchog dman 'gro ba kun// na 'chi rgud pa'i gdung ba kun bral te// ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// rdzogs ldan dga' ston gsar par longs spyad shog /bdag cag slob 'bangs ltos bcas byang chub bar// dam chos sgrub pa'i dal rten nyer 'tshe kun// bral zhing gnas skabs mthar thug dpal 'byor pas// 'di dang phyi ma kun du bde gyur cig /de ltar nam mkha'i nor bus bsil ba ster dang kun phan zer gyis tsha gdung bskyed// lha lam ut+pal phon po 'khrungs dang kai la sha las gser gyi khu ba sogs// mi srid de bzhin bla ma lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul ba'i 'dod gsol re bskul nam yang mi bslu ba'i// bden pa des kyang gang smras bsam don gegs bral myur du 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces yul mchog tu gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyis legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i 'tsho ba ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen nam/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ban+tu//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
